tei:titleStmt.tei:title: rgyal dbang rin chen phugs tshogs kyi bka' 'bum ka pa'i kar chags bzhugs so/
rgyal dbang rin chen phugs tshogs kyi bka' 'bum ka pa'i kar chags bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: rgyal dbang rin chen phugs tshogs kyi bka' 'bum ka pa'i kar chags bzhugs so/ ༈ /rgyal dbang rat+na'i bka' 'bum ka par (ka)spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa'i rnam thar snyan pa'i 'brug 13sgra/ (kha)dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rnam par thar pa snyan grags lha yi rnga chen tshangs dbyangs kyi sgra brgya pa zhes bya 34ba/ (ga)'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyi skye rab mos gus dran pa'i lcags kyu zhes 26bya ba/ (nga)'bri gung pa rat+na'i mang can gyi rnam thar 'og ma 31gsang ba/ (ca)mchog gi spru pa'i sku zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin lnga pa gar dbang chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar dang ldan pa'i yid kyi gdung sel bstan pa'i nyin byed ces bya 17ba/ (cha)snye mor gsal snang byung 4tshul/ (ja)dbu skra'i lo rgyud/sa dkyil 'khor gsal rdzogs zhes bya 3 ba/ (nya)rnam thar ji bzhin sgrib bral zhes3 bya ba/ (ta)dag snang mkhar thog ma zhes bya ba cung zad ma tshang ba'i 4'phro/ (tha)gter yig 'bebs pa'i bskul byang byung tshul 3la/ (da) dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las dag snang gdung sel ut+pa ta'i dri bsung zhes 5bya ba/ (na)lam zla bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bskor rnams dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshig bcad ma/ dzo ki la gdams pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor yon tan kun 'byung*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma ngo bo nyid du bsgrub pa'i thabs dang bcas 8par/ (pa)bla ma'i rnal 'byor legs 3la/ (pha)gsol 'debs kyi skor rnams las/ thog mar phyag chen chos drug brgyad pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ yang phyag chen chos drug rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ mos gus dran pa'i gsol 'debs/ o rgyan rin po che ba gtso 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsol 'debs/ rig 'dzin brgyad kyi gsol 'debs/ bla ma rgyang bod bzhugs*/ gsol 'debs bde legs kun 'byung*/ rje btsun mnga' ris paṇa chen la gsol 'debs/ gu ru ā nan dhā tsha la gsol 'debs/ dge slong ngag dbang rin chen gyis bskul ba'i bla ma'i bstod pa/

gu ru drag po brgyad pa'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma o rgyan gling pas bskul ba'i bstod pa sh+lo ka gcig pa/ bla ma khro phu bas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam/ byes mchod kyis bskul ba'i bstod pa/ sprau sngags chung gis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ mkhar mo bas bsku'i ja mchod/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang brgyud lha tshogs la mchod pa 'bul ba/ 'dan ma bsod dpal gyis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ rgya ston dge slong la gnang ba'i gsol 'debs dang bcas par/ (ba)bstod pa'i bskor la sangs rgyas kyi skye rabs brgya rtsa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi go rim dang bcas pa'i tshigs su 8bcad pa/ (ma)'bri gung du dngul gdung rin po che la na bza' phul ba'i tshig bcad dang*/ bsam yas bar khang pa'i dus gsum sangs rgyas la snyan dar chen yug gcig gi kha yig sprul sku rin po che zhwa dmar 'dzam gling rnams rgyal grangs pa gshegs dus lha sar snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig chos bdag bkra shis 'od 'bar la snyan dar kha yig bsam yas lcog tu mda' dar zhig gi kha yig la/ bsam yas bu tshal kun gzigs pho brang du chos skyong chen po la mdung dmar ru dar zhig la kha yig brtan bzhugs/ bsam yas byang chub chen po'i snyan dar la/ bsam yas su chos skyong gi gnod sbyin chen po'i stod pa dang bcas 4la/ (tsa)'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed tshe bdag zhal gzigs dus bstod pa dang*/ 'jam dpal king ka zhal gzigs dus bstod pa bcas2la/ (tsha)brtan bzhugs kyi skor rnams las/ thog mar rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can la phul ba'i brtan bzhugs/ mkhan chen shes rab dpal ba la phul ba'i brtan bzhugs/ kun dga' rab brtan rgyal mo la brtan bzhugs/ 'brug pa gcung rin po chen khri thog pa la brtan bzhugs phul ba/ dpal ldan bla ma ā nan dh+wa dza la brtan bzhugs phul ba/ nyid rang gi brtan bzhugs kyi rim pa 'ga' bzhugs/ brtan bzhugs rigs lnga ma bcas 6la/

(dza)bca' yig nyis 'ching kun grol dri bral shel gyi ri bo4/ (wa)rwa bsgreng 'od 'jo gdan sa ba shes rab nyi ma la gdams pa'i rdor dkar gyi phan yon2/ ka kha'i tshig bcad rang gi spyod lugs/ khyon grangs brgya dang dgu bcu go brgyad bzhugs/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// / spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa'i rnam thar snyan pa'i 'brug sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ na mo rat+na gu ru bh+yaḥ 'jig rten mgon po dri med chos kyi rje// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa// 'bri gung gling pa zhes byar yongs grags pa'i// 'gran med 'phags mchog de la spyi bos 'dud// de yang mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan pa'i 'phags mchog klu sgrub de nyid/ 'gru rgyal skyu ra'i gdung rigs su sku skye ba bzhes nas/ dpal 'bri gung rdo rje'i gdan gnyis pa ru sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzhi btsugs/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos pa/ rat+na shrī zhes bya ba de nyid kyi rigs dang chos las skyes pa'i bdag nyid chen po/ 'bri gung gling pa zhes yongs su grags pa 'di ni/ skyu ra'i rigs las sgos kyi gdung ni 'o phrom/ de la lha sgra dang lha rgod gnyis las/ gong ma de'i nang tshan/ dpal chen dang lha rgod gnyis las dpal chen po/ yab ni rje mar pa'i rnam 'phrul ston pa sangs rgyas dpal zhes bya ba sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po/ rim gnyis zab mo'i don la dbang 'byor ba de nyid dang*/ yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i mtshan dang ldan pa rin chen sgron zhes bya ba'i khab tu/ spyan snga ba/ thub pa bsod snyoms pa/ gcung po gcig slob dpon gzhon nu/ spyan snga sgam po pa/ yang lcam dral gnyis te/ lcam dral bdun 'khrungs pa la/ spre'u zhes pa me mo lug gi lo la spyan snga nyid bltams pa'i dus nas bzung*/ sku rab tu ma byung gi bar du yang*/ kha na ma tho ba'i nyes pa'i dri mas ma gos shing*/ dkon mchog gi rten la mchog tu gus pas/

nang mi ma mthong bar yul gyi mchod pa'i yo byad dag gis mchod pa mdzad cing*/ dgung lo brgyad nas bcu gcig gi bar 'bri klog mkhas pa'i phul tu phyin pa mkhyen zhing*/ bcu gsum pa la/ yab mes kyi rigs sngags las byung ba bzhin ser ba bsrungs pas/ kun las khyad par du gyur pa bsrung nus pa dang*/ gsung tshangs dbyangs kyi sgra lta bus drang nges kyi mgur dbyangs phun sum tshogs pa du mas/ skye 'gro du ma yang*/ yang dag gi lam du blo 'gugs pa nus par gyur to// dgung lo bcu bdun pa la dpal ldan ngad phu ba yul phyogs der byon pa la/ dad pa thob te/ phyis ngad phu ba las rab tu byung ste/ lha rin chen rgyal po zhes bya bar mtshan gsol/ thos bsam kyang mang du mdzad/ der bzhugs pa'i dus shig nye gnas kyis bgam pa'i tshig btang ba la/ dpal ldan ngad phu ba'i zhal nas/ de skad ma zer ces bka' bkyon te/ 'di la sang bod 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon 'jig rten na dpe zla med pa zhig 'ong ba yin pas brnyas su mi gtub ces gsung bzhin lung bstan/ lo bzhi drung du bzhugs shing*/ phyag rgya chen po'i khrid zhus pas spro bral gyi rtogs pa phul tu phyin pa 'khrungs te/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan par gyur to// de nas me mo glang gi lo'i sos kha 'bul skyel ba dang 'grogs/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa la dbus su byon pa'i tshe/ ngad phu ba'i grwa pa btsun chung shes rab can 'bri klog mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa zhig yong bar yod pa 'dug ces pa'i grags pa chen po yang byung*/ 'bri gung du phebs/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dang mjal zhing*/ gling gseb du lo gsum bzhugs so// de'i bar la 'jig rten gyi bya 'brel thams cad spangs te/ yon tan gzhan gang yang ma bskyangs par/ rje'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos la tshig gcig tsam yang ma chad par gsan pa dang*/ de'i don thugs dam la mnyam par 'jog pa 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad/

de nas skabs shig 'jig rten mgon po tshogs su byon nas chos gsung pa'i dus su/ sku gnas su byon pa'i stobs kyis/ tshems phal cher mi mnga' bas/ gsung yang cung zad ldib pa lta bu gyur nas/ go dka' bar gyur te/ thugs cung zad ma tshim pa'i tshe/ skad cig ma gnyis pa la/ khyod la gtad pa zhig yod/ dpal ngad phu ba la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams kyang 'di las byung ba yin dgongs te/ gnyen po de ma thag tu sleb ste/ de'i yon tan skye ba'i bar chad kyi snga ltas su go'o// zhes kyang gsungs/ re shig drung du shog gsungs nas byon pas/ thugs rtsom gyi yi ge zhig 'brir bcol ba'i tshe myur bar bris te yang yang bskul bas/ shin tu dgyes par yang gyur to// de nas mi 'gyangs par bzhugs sa yang mchod khang dang gzims spyil du mdzad cing*/ 'phral gyi bdag gnyer thams cad ston pa shes rab 'bum gyis mdzad do// phyag phyir bzhugs kyi bar/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs tog tshul bzhin bsgrubs pas thugs kyang shin tu mnyes so// skabs shig mtshan nyid pa'i ston pa 'ga' la 'jig rten mgon pos snang ba rang sems kyi chos shig gsungs pa'i tshe/ tshad ma rnam nges kyi lung drangs pa'i tshig thugs kyis bsnyel ba la/ nyid kyang yol ba'i phyi rol na yod pas lung de shar gyis sprad pa la thugs shin tu dgyes te/ deng phyin chad nas nga'i chos mdzod thams cad kyi gnyer khyod la gtad pa yin gsungs nas/ gdams ngag thams cad kyang ma lus par gnang zhing*/ gsung gi gdams pa yang mdzad do// de ltar yang zhal snga nas/ sngon tshe bsod nams tshogs bsags pas// da lta 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// bla ma rin chen spyan sngar phyin// thugs rje chen po'i lcags kyus gzung*// mthar thug mchog gi mos gus phul// gnyis med rtogs pa'i pha phogs thob// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i grogs dang 'grogs// chos dang zang zing bde skyid spyad// ces pa dang*/

sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// rang 'dod log ltas ma bkab ste// gsungs pa'i bka' la tshad mar bzung*// mnyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs gyur pas// bdud rtsi'i chos mdzod chen po gtad// ces kyang gsungs so// de nas mi ring ba nas/ nye gnas nyid du mdzad pa'i skabs shig rje'i zhal nas/ 'dir zhag 'ga' tsam sdod pa la/ gyong nge byed pa de mi 'thad pa yin gsungs ba la/ nyid kyi mnyam med bla ma dam pa yi/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las la/ zhag 'ga' cha tsam gnang ba'i tshe// gyong nge byed pa'i 'os ma yin// bya ba zhig bris te phyag tu bzhag pas/ 'jig rten mgon po mnyes te mtshan shes rab tu btags so// re zhig spyan snga dang dpon slob gsum bzhugs pa'i dus shig 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zhal nas/ 'bri gung gi ri 'di la shing rigs du yod grangs thon zhes gsungs ba la spyan snga bas/ shug pa sogs grangs tshe/ sher 'byung la bgrongs dang gsungs pas/ nyid kyi dgongs par/ 'jig rten mgon pos 'bri gung 'di bya rgod phung po'i ri yin par thugs kyis dgongs par mkhyen nas/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa sdom pa gsum bstan pa sogs kyi mdo'i bya dang shing rigs sogs bgrangs pas shin tu mnyes te/ 'bri gung gi ri la shing rigs de rnams yod pa yin zhes kyang gsungs so// de phyin nas gzim g.yog la'ang*/ slob dpon yang dgon pa dang*/ nyid gang phebs kyis ngo ri med par bsgrubs shig par bka' yang gnang ngo*// de skad du yang*/ da mi 'bral sku dang grib ma bzhin// spyan sngar 'dug pa'i nye gnas gnang*// bzang po rnams dang blo gros bstun// chen po rnams dang phebs par smras// 'dzam gling 'dus pa'i 'gro ba la// sangs rgyas mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsgrubs// zhes gsungs pa yin no// de ltar zhabs drung der ji srid bzhugs kyi bar la yang thugs la btags pa rnam pa gsum gyis bskyangs te/

gcig tu nor dang rten gnyer ma gtad/ gnyis su mjal sna dang zhu ba ma bcol/ gsum du bka' bkyon gyis bka' babs te/ nye gnas grwa slob su la thugs ma dgyes pa la/ nyid rang la bka' bkyon phebs kyang*/ log rtogs dang skyo ngal gyi dri ma ring du bor ba'i tshul ni brjod pa las 'das so// nyid rang la grwa slob rnams kyis mthong snang mang du byung bar gda' ste/ mkhyen pa ba) ma ba ??dge bshes 'tshal nag bya bas/ spyan ras gzigs su mthong ba sogs kyang bgrang bar mi nus so// gzhan yang 'jig rten mgon pos tshogs su chos gsung ba'i tshe yang*/ spyan zur gyis gzigs pa tsam gyi gang bzhed pa'i chos mus kyis gsung sprod thub par mdzad pa dang*/ yang ston pa 'ga' la/ dam pa'i chos kyang zhang lcam rjes bzhin thal// zhes bya ba'i don rnams shod gsung bas/ kun gyis ma nges pa la/ nyid kyis gsungs pas shin tu yang dgyes par gyur to// zhag 'ga' bser ma'i snyun byung bas gling gseb du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ khams kyi ldan yul yab yum dang bcas pa ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs/ sku khams dwangs nas g.yu khang du byon/ spyan sngas dbu mdzad 'gro mi mang po zhig yod pa'i dus/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ slob dpon gdan sa ba dang*/ khyod gnyis shes rab gang che gsungs ba la/ spyan snga bas/ shes rab khong che zhus pas/ 'o de yin/ nga 'bu la yang*/ bsgom byung gi shes rab chen po skyes pa ma gtogs/ lhan cig skyes pa'i shes rab ni nga 'bu dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhabs drung du yod pa'i dus kyang 'chad pa dang rtsom pa klog bris la sogs gang la'ang kho yi 'di 'dra yod pa min gsungs/ dgung lo bdun cu phyin chad nas/ yol ba gnang nas rje nyid nang du bzhugs nas ngo sprod tsam gnang ba ma gtogs/ khrid thams cad nyid kyis mdzad pas/ gsung gi 'debs de phag mo gru pa 'dra ba zhig byung gsungs bas shin tu mnyes pa dang*/ gzhan nye gnas thams cad pas zhabs tog tu 'gyur bar byung bas thugs kyang shin tu mnyes par gyur to// de skad du yang*/

ci mnyes bsgrubs shing mi mnyes rnams spangs pas// dpal ldan bla ma lhag par dgyes pa mtshar// zhes pa dang*/ tha mar bzhugs pa'i sku de la/ deng sang bsams kyang de dag las// lhag pa'i bya rgyu ma rnyed pas// snying tshim zhabs tog dus der phul// ces so// de ltar gzim g.yog mdzad pa'i dus der/ gser khang rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po can du gzigs shing*/ nang gi gdung sna dang lcam sna re re la yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dpag tu med pa zhal gzigs shing*/ zhing de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug dpag tu med pa rnams ting nge 'dzin gyi rol pa 'ba' zhig gi phan tshun rtsed mo mdzad pa dus rgyun du gzigs pa dang*/ yang dus der/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo rgyal po'i khab kyi lho phyogs dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs nas/ 'dus pa'i tshogs bgrang ba las 'das pa la gzhon nu gser mdog gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i mdo gsung ba gzigs pa la/ dbu'i gtsug gtor med pa zlum hril le 'dug pa ma gtogs/ 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi las lung ston pa'i chos gsungs pa rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang khyad par mi 'dug gsungs/ gzhan yang mchod khang steng dang*/ nag tshang steng la sogs pa na phan tshun bzhud pa'i dus su 'ang*/ sa gzhi thams cad ar mo li ga'i rdo leb ltar mnan na nem pa dang bteg na spar byed pa/ zhabs shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba byung ste/ zhal snga nas nga 'bu la sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'di ji lta ba mngon du gyur pas phyi rol gyi snang ba la rtag brtan gyi snang ba 'char ma myong*/ sdang dgra dang gnod bgegs kyi gtses na'ang zhe sdang dang khong khro skye ma myong*/ byams pa'i gnyen gyis phan bde bsgrubs na yang de la rjes su chags pa skye ma myong*/ de la sogs pa dus nam yang gzhan la khro ba dang mi dga' ba 'ong ma myong*/

bzang po la phrag dog dang ngan pa la zhe brnyas kyang byed ma myong gsung ste/ ji skad du/ bzang la phrag dog bsam pa yis// smad cing bskur pa ma btab ste// ngan mthun phyogs bskyod byed pa dang*// dman la brnyas pa'i 'du shes spangs// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ zhabs phyi der ji ltar bzhugs kyi bar der/ ji skad du/ chos dang dpe la 'dod pa ma byas shing*// rdzas dang nor la 'dod pa ngas ma byas// lha dang rten la 'dod pa ma byas te// 'bri gung mthil du bzhugs pa nyid la bsams// zhes dang*/ phyogs cha can gyi skye bo yis/ kha da smras pas rgyab tu bskyur// spus sdug ka ca'i dngos po dang*// sku gsung thugs rten gang la yang*// rang gi nom pa ma byas par// 'bri gung gi gdan sar ci 'gro byas// bla ma dge 'dun dkor nor la// gtan gyi tshe phyis bsgrub pa'i phyir// tshogs tshad gsog 'jog ma byas par// blo phugs sprang po zhig la gtad// rang yul gnas gzhi dgon pa la// gtan khang gi 'du shes ma skyes par/ khe phogs rtsol sgrub ma byas te// ri khrod gangs khrod 'grim par bsams// zhes sogs gsungs te phyag phyir bzhugs kyi bar du'ang*/ slob dpon zer yin thams cad kyis bkur yang*/ che khyer dang*/ deng ya med par bka' blo shin tu bde bar mdzad cing*/ rang nyid la ka ca'i dngos po ji ltar byung ba thams cad bla ma la phul ba min pa/ dpag nor dang sgos skyongs gang yang ma mdzad pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po yang mnyes te/ da ltar bstan bcos dgongs pa gcig pa sogs/ khyad chos su grags pa 'di rnams kyang*/ tshogs su ma gsungs kyang*/ skabs gzhol nas zhu ba phul ba'i lan dang*/ bzhugs 'gram dang gdugs la bzhugs pa'i skabs su zhus pa la brten te gzhan la ma grags pa de yin gsungs/ gzhan yang*/ ji skad du/ bla ma dge 'dun zhabs tog la// lus ngag yid gsum gang gis kyang*// bar chod phyi bshol ma bgyis te// 'grub tshad lus pa med par bsgrubs// che 'dod 'gying ra ma bgyis la// rang 'dod ngoms spyod ma byas so// 'chor 'dod sgeg chos ma bgyis la// shes 'dod shes ldan sun ma phyung*// zhes gsungs shing*/

'jig rten mgon pos/ khrid chos/ tshogs chos/ zab chos/ ri chos/ dpag chos/ las chos sogs gang gnang ba thams cad kyang go yul du ma bzhag par/ thugs nyams su bzhes te/ ji skad du/ zab cing rgya che dam pa'i chos// be bum po tir legs bris te// sems rten phugs su ma bzhag par// sems dang chos su 'dres par byas// zhes so// re zhig bzhugs me'i 'gram du/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ 'bri gung 'di ngas cis kyang khyod la gtod pa yin pas khyod rang nga'i gdan sa gyis/ zhes sogs bka' nan che bar phebs na'ang*/ gdan sa'i khur ma bzhed cing*/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam chos kyi snying pos thugs rgyud gtams par gyur te/ nyid kyi zhal nas/ mnyam med lhun grub dgon pa der// dri med chos sku'i spyan snga ru// 'od gsal rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis// 'khor 'das gnyis su med par bgyis// zhes dang*/ rje bla ma'i thugs dang sems su 'dres// don nyams rtogs kun gcig tu gyur pa yi// sems gnyis med kyi rtogs pa nang nas shar// yul mtshan ma'i rnam rtog rang sar grol// blo mnyam byed kyi 'dzin pa mkha' la dwangs// ngas sgom yul gyi rjes su ma 'brangs kyang*// sgom 'di yi gar 'dug tu ma bcags pas// dus da lta rang gzhan snang srid 'di// sems skye med chos sku'i dbyings su thal// 'di gzhan sus kyang lan pa ma yin te// dpal 'bri gung pa dang mjal bas lan// zhes gsungs so// de nas 'jig rten mgon po dgung lo bdun cu don lnga bzhes pa'i dus su/ thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs pa'i phyi nang gi dkar chag ma lus pa bsgrigs shing*/ rab gnas kyi phyag bzhes kyang nyid rang gis mdzad do// dus der 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i gdan sa'i khur yang dpon sgom pa la gnang zhing*/ dgung lo bdun cu don lnga bzhes pa'i sa ga zla ba'i nyer bdun gyi srod 'khor la dgongs pa zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus/

sku gdung rin po che la sku khrus gsol ba dang*/ zhabs tog phul du phyin par mdzad cing*/ gdung zhugs la zhen pa'i tshe/ thugs mchog nyams pa med par nyid phyogs kyi thab sgor phebs pa'ang phyag tu byon/ gzhan yang gdung gi rnam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams/ nyid kyis ma god ma nyams par mdzad cing*/ gling rin po che'i mchod pa'i gnas su bzhugs pa las/ gzhan du mi 'khyar bar mdzad/ dus der dgung lo so gcig bzhes so// skyob pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i zla ba de'i phyi ma'i tshes bcu gsum la g.yu khang du/ spyan snga ba rnam pa gsum gyis gtso mdzad nye gnas rnams dang*/ grwa pa byings kyi rgyu mtshan rnam pa gsum la dgongs/ spyan snga nyid kyis dbu mdzad chos dang mthun pa'i khrims bcas te/ rab dpal gyi 'bri gung du thod pa 'jog pa/ tha ma yang lo bcu tshun chad du khams su mi 'gro bar dbus gtsang du sgrub pa byed pa dam bcas pa'i nyin par ring bsrel gyi char kyang bab par gyur to// de rjes sku 'bum 'dzam gling rgyan bzhengs pa'i zhal bkod dang*/ nang bzhugs kyi bye brag ma lus pa phyag len du btab ste/ da lta 'bri gung gi gdan sa 'od lham me ba 'di nga 'bus bgyis pa yin zhes dang*/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i yon tan ma lus pa sgo mang 'di la 'byon snyam tsa/ sku 'bum 'di la bzhugs par 'dug 'di ni skyob pa dngos su bzhugs pa dang khyad par med cis kyang gsung ngo*// dbyar de nyid gzims mal gyi gser sku dang*/ tshogs kyi dar sku yang bzhengs pa dang*/ rab gnas rnams kyang legs por grub par mdzad de/ gnam mtsho'i do la gshegs pa na gnas la bstod pa yang mdzad cing*/ nyin gcig skyob pa nyid gsal bar gzigs shing gsol ba btab/ khyad par sngar gong sku tshe'i tshad ring bar zhal gyis bzhes/ thung pas bdag cag bslu ba ci lags/ zhes zhus pas/ zhal nas/

nga'i sku tshe'i tshad ni sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag bcu'i sku tshe'i tshad bas ring*/ nga'i mtshan yang de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen dpal gyi mgon po zhes bya ba yin gsungs/ des thugs dbugs phyung zhing thugs dam la bogs kyang shin tu thon par gyur/ de ltar gnam mtshor lo gcig bzhugs nas ti ser 'byon par bzhed de/ phug pa'i ya them la/ na ning deng sang 'bri gung mthil na yod// do gcig deng sang gnam mtsho'i do la bsgom// sang phod deng sang ti se'i gangs la'ang bgyid// gzhi phod deng sang phyogs med ldom bu byed// bya ba bris te bzhag pas// ru ba rnams 'dus te/ byang sgyid ??'jag ma mi skye ba'i yul der nas kyi brgyad 'bul sogs/ 'bul ba'i bye brag kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul ba rnams/ 'bri gung mthil du skyos ma yang gnang*/ de nas nyid kyi phyag phyir rdor blo dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ 'dan ma chos seng dang*/ dpon slob bzhi gshegs te/ dus der ni dgung lo so gsum bzhes so// de nas byang lam brgyud stod du phebs pas/ jo bo a tig can du phebs/ jo bo 'khor bcas la/ sems bskyed dang dbang bskur gnang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i khrid btab pas ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'khrungs te/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan par gyur te/ gzhan yang jo bo 'bum rgyan dang*/ mnga' bdag stag tsha'i sring mo/ jo jo dge slong ma la sogs la'ang dbang bskur zhing gdams pa yang gnang*/ de nas dpon slob rnams spu rangs kho char du bzhugs pa'i tshe/mnga' bdag ya tse ba lcam dral 'khor g.yog tu bcas pa rnams/ mtsho ma gros pa la yum gyi dur 'debs su 'ongs pa dang mjal/ de'i tshe jo bo'i phyag phyir sngags dang mtshan nyid la mkhas pa'i paṇ+ṭi ta gnyis byung ba dang*/ lo tsā'i sgo nas 'bel gtam mdzad pas shin tu yang dad par gyur cing*/ jo bo ya tse rang yang chos la shin tu mkhas pas/ dri rmed phul ba'i lan gnang ba tsam gyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan par gyur pa la/

sems bskyed dang*/ bde mchog gi dbang bskur shin tu rgyas par gnang ba'i tshe/ sngon skyob pa nyid kyis lung bstan pa thugs kyis dgongs te/ rje sum ldan ma'i gsol 'debs kyang dus der mdzad pa yin no// de nas spu rangs kho char du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rnam thar phyogs bcu dus gsum ma'i lha bris thugs la 'khrungs pas gtsug lag khang gi gyang logs la skya bris su btab nas bzhag pas phyis 'bri gung yang dar ro// dus der gar log dang bod kyi mtshams byang gnye gong du byon pas/ gar log gi gung blon sin thig bheg gis bsu ba rgya chen po dang bcas nas spyan drangs te mjal ba'i tshe/ byang phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas gar log dang sog po'i rgyal po'i bla mchod paṇ+ṭi ta dang*/ blon po la sogs pa rnams mjal bar 'ongs pa dang 'dzoms pa la chos kyi gtam gyis tshim par mdzad pas/ shin tu dad par gyur te 'bul ba yang rgya chen po bgyis so// de'i dus su rnam thar rma bya seng ma yang mdzad/ de nas yun mi ring par/ ka ba dar gyi seng ge la sgrub pa la bzhugs te/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung ji lta ba nyid kyi thugs rgyud dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i gnas lugs kyi rang babs chen por bzhugs pa las/ gzhan pa'i spros pa thams cad rab tu bcad/ ji skad du/ dbang che gzi che mthu che ba'i// gnyen po rin chen mi bzhugs pas// klad pa rdo leb gsal ba bzhin// ngan spyod lhug par ma spyad cing*// dngos su bzhugs pa'i dus tshod pas// brtson 'grus 'bad pa'i me chen sbar// gnyen po mthu dpung cher bskyed nas/ brtul bzhugs go cha stobs su gyon// 'jig rten mgon po rgyal ba las// chen po gzhan dring ma bzhag cing*// gdams chung zer mchu ma btsal bas// ci byed mdun bgros sems la dris// zhes gsungs te/ sku srog la ltos pa med par dka' ba dang du blangs nas sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i tshe/

thog ma med pa'i bag chags kyi sa bon ma lus pa slongs te/ phyi nang gi mi mthun pa'i rkyen ngan sna tshogs pa thams cad dus gcig la langs par gyur pa la/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos mtshams sbyar te/ gnod byed kyi dgra bo la'ang*/ 'jig rten mgon por bsgom gyin yan lag bdun pa phul zhing*/ log lta'i skabs na yang ma 'khrungs te/ ji skad du/ mi mthun sgrub pa'i dgra bo la// bsam ngan dug mda' ma btang ste// gang la'ang ngan lan ma sgrubs pas// mnyam nyid ngang du goms par byas// rang gzhan phyogs ris sder bcas nas/ kha smras rtsod pa'i 'khrug long gis// rgya mtsho'i dge 'dun ma dkrugs te// sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes ci skye byas// zhes pa dang*/ yang*/ gangs dkar ti se'i dgon pa der// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs drung du// lus srog gdon gtor btang nas kyang*// 'bad pa med par nyams len byas// zhes gsungs pa yin no// dus der skyob pa nyid dang rmang lam du mjal zhing gsung gi gdams pa yang gnang*/ mang rje'i sgom chen zhig zhabs phyir yod pa sogs kyi nyid kyi sku rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mthong ba sogs dag pa'i snang ba yod pa rnams la sku lus kyi bkod pa'i mthong snang yang mang bar bstan zhing*/ gzhan yang der bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sngon gyi sku skye ba bzang ngan kyang mang bar dran gsung ste/ 'dir gsum tsam la mtshon na/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi slob ma che shos shig dang*/ bar pa phyi rol pa'i drang srong zhig tu skyes nas/ gzhan drang srong lnga brgya dang lhan cig 'tshogs shing shing lor bris pa'i gzhung bam po re yang klog pa dang*/ bram ze'i rig byed thams cad kyang shin tu byang bar mkhas par bslabs pa zhig kyang yin/ zhes pa dang*/ de'i 'og tu slob dpon zla ba grags pa de nyid yin par yang zhal gyis bzhes gsungs/ mdor na kun gzhi 'di yang ji lta ba bzhin du mngon du gyur te/

byang chub sems dpa' blo gros chen po dang*/ lha mo dpal phreng ma dang khyad par med pa/ phra zhing phra ba sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad du ji ltar yod pa thams cad kun gzhi la mngon du gyur pa yin gsungs te/ ji skad du/ zung 'jug bde chen dgon pa der// mkhyen gnyis ye shes spyan snga ru// 'dzin pa'i dri ma rnams spangs pas// rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur par gyis// zhes gsungs te/ sku la gser ma'i snyun nad byung kyang rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig gi sgo nas 'di 'jog dgos pa zhig yin gsung ste/ zhal snga nas/ ngas rlung dang dmigs pas nad sbyong na 'di ltar byas chog ste gsungs nas/ rdo leb steng du phye spungs pa la zhabs sor bstan nas rlung gcun pas/ phye rlung gis spur ba byung ngo*// 'on kyang*/ nga ni nad 'di la brten nas/ yar bla ma dus gsum gyi dkon mchog thams cad mchod cing*/ mar khams gsum gyi sems can smin par byed/ skabs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams kyang sbyong bar byed de/ dge bsnyen dri ma med pa'i snyung dang 'dra gsungs/ gzhan yang dus der sangs rgyas 'od zhi spos snang dpal zhal gzigs/ de nas ni bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong dang*/ mthar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad zhal gzigs shing*/ rgyal ba de dag gis chos gsung ba yang*/ chos nyid rang bzhin ngo bo nyid med cing*// sgra dang tha snyad spros pa'i mtshan ma spangs// rtag tu zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa de// gang gis shes la bde bar gshegs zhes bya// zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pa yang thugs la gsal lo// gzhan yang sngon 'jig rten mgon po'i drung du bzhugs pa'i dus su yang*/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po rnams dang 'bral ba med cing*/ de dag gis gsungs pa'i chos kyang dpag tu med do// ti ser bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gangs ri de nyid la pho brang gi sgo yod par gzigs te/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus der/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bzhugs pa gsol ba/

gzhan yang ku ku ri pa sogs grub chen brgyad cu dang*/ dgyes rdor sogs gsang sngags phyi nang gi lha dpag tu med pa yang gzigs shing*/ nyin gcig mtsho ma dros pa'i dbus drang por pad sdong chen po'i dbus na/ 'jig rten mgon po bzhugs pa'i thugs nyams shar te/ ma dros mtsho 'gram ma'i bstod pa yang dus der mdzad/ gad pa gser gyi bya skyibs su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dgra bcom lnga brgya'i gaṇ+ḍi brdungs pa'i sgra yang gsan cing*/ lar der ni tshe gcig gi skyon med yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtshan nyid pa de mngon du byas pa yin gsung ste/ ji skad du/ chos dbyings rnam dag dgon pa der// mi zad 'khor lo'i spyan snga ru// byang chub sems gnyis mthar thug pas// sangs rgyas byang chub thob par bgyis// zhes pa dang*/ gangs khrod ri khrod nags khrod du// 'jig rten bya ba blos btang nas// sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs gyur pas// nyams myong dang mngon par rtogs pa dang*// yon tan gyi bang mdzod gter kha phye// dus deng sang phyogs lhung skye bo rnams/ kha gnyer dang sna gnyer zhe gnyer bgyis/ gdugs pa'i tshig ngan smra na yang*// gtugs kyis thug pa'i dus tshod der// zing zing gi nor gyi stong 'bul dang*// cal col stong tsho bskyangs pa las// lhag bsam rnam dag spyod pa des// pha mnyam med rin chen dgyes sam snyam// grogs dge 'dun gyi dbu 'phang bstod dam snyam// dpal 'bri gung gi zhabs tog che'am snyam// phyogs bcur 'gro don yang 'grub bam snyam// bdag cag gi spyod pa 'di 'dra ba// dus deng sang phyin chad dga' 'am snyam// da snyam tsam 'di bden nam mi bden pa// khyod skye bo phyi mas snyan gyis gson// ces gsungs so// de ltar ti ser lo bdun bzhugs nas bya lor 'bri gung du byon te/ dus der dgung lo so dgu bzhes pa yin no// tsog sna'i mdun mthil gzigs par phebs pa'i tshe/

ri bo mchog rab ma'i bstod pa mdzad/ sku skyos kyi 'bul ba rgya chen po tshogs su phul/ dbyar de gser khang steng du bzhugs nas/ thugs dam gyi lha mang po bzhengs shing*/ khyad chos dang zab chos du ma'i gsung rgyun gyi rtsom pa yang mdzad/ lo de'i ston dpon slob bcu bzhi mdzad nas/ lho brag tu phebs pa'i lam bar du gsung chos kyi thun kyang ma chag par mdzad nas rim pas bsam yas kyi phur phebs pa'i tshe/ grwa pa kun la gsang bar gdams te/ phebs pa na/ bla ma sa skya pa dpon slob bsam yas kyi yo 'bog thang la gso sbyong mdzad cing 'dug pa'i bar du/ phyi ltag zhig tu then nas bzhugs pa la/ grwa pa zhig gis 'phrig tshud de bla mar zhus nas/ cung zhig lon pa na nang du spyan drangs/ sa skya ba dpon slob rnams dang mjal zhing*/ bsnyen bkur kyang dpag tu med pa mdzad/ zhag gnyis bzhugs shing*/ gru la byon te dgon dkar du phebs pa na/ dgon dkar ba dang mjal zhing*/ dgon me tog dang bcas pa phul/ lha khang nas mkhar chur byon pa dang*/ 'bri gung du 'bul ba bskur ba dus mnyam du mdzad de/ chos po ti brgya sum cu so lnga dang*/ rje nā ro pa'i phyag dril gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad de/ spyan snga nyid kyis dgung lo bzhi bcu bzhes pa'i dus so// de ltar lho brag mkhar chur dgun smad dang dbyar de bzhugs/ de'i ring gtso bor thugs dam dang*/ zhar la rje sgam po pa'i jo mo lha lnga ma gsungs pa'i dus su/ rje sgam po pa'i rnam thar rang la nyi ma bdun gsungs shing*/ kun dril zla gcig tu gsungs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum ma'i bris sku yang bzhengs/ bkra shis byams khang gi mkhar len kyang mdzad/ 'bul skyel ma 'khor ba la/ phyag rgya bzhi'i khrid kyang gsungs te/ ji skad du/ bkra shis byams khang bsod nams gter// grogs gzhi byes 'dzoms pa ngo mtshar che// pha phogs zab mo'i phyag rgya bzhi// bu ngan yang smra ba ngo mtshar che// bya ba la sogs pa mdzad/

dbyar smad gro bo lung nas gdan 'dren byung bas phebs te/ nag tshang du bzhugs/ lho phu pa thams cad kyis sems bskyed zhus/ slob dpon sgom sang bas gro bo lung phul ba bzhes/ de'i dus/ pha gcig chos rje rin chen yin// zhang nye'i rjes su mi 'brang 'tshal// bya ba sogs kyang mdzad de dbyangs byed du bcug de nas lho phu chu khyer du gdan drangs nas phyir byon te/ sku khams cung zad mnyel bas zangs phug tu bzhugs pa'i dus/ sku khams mnyel ba'i rgyu rkyen ji ltar yin tshul kyang byon/ bslab khog gi rtsom pa yang mdzad/ der kyang sku khams dwangs par ma gyur te/ gro bo lung gi stag tu sgar mdzad nas bzhugs/ de'i dus zhal snga nas/ de ring mkhan po chen po de byon nas byung zhes gsung te/ de'i nyin par mkhan po sku gshegs par 'dug gsungs/ ston de dgon du phyir phebs/ nag tshang steng gi bya khang na bzhugs te gso sbyong mdzad pa na/ bcom ldan 'das bstan pa'i bdag po'i sku gro bo lung gi pha ri'i de dang mnyam pa zhig byon nas bzhugs pa gzigs pas/ der sku khams kyang dwangs/ yon bdag zhig gis 'bul ba chen po bgyis te/ 'di gsol gyi bar sems bskyed rgyas pa zhig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ yon zhig sems bskyed rgyas pa'i nga la tshe yod dam/ sems bskyed chen po 'chad na phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar yang zad par mi 'gyur gsungs/ de nas dgun phyir byon/ mkhar chu bzhugs pa'i dus khyad chos brgya dgu bcu pa yi ger bkod/ de yang tshur bsdus te brgya lnga bcu mar mdzad/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das grong khyer sna tshogs rdul du bsod snyoms la byon nas/ cung zad phar gshegs pa'i dus su/ kun tu rgyu dang bur mas bu mo dpe med ma khrid nas bcom ldan 'das la 'bul bar brtsams pa rnams lam gyis gzigs gsungs/ dbyar ya rgyal du byon nas bzhugs/ thugs bskyed chen mo nyi ma gsum gsungs pa'i tshe/

yul de'i gzhi bdag phu thang 'brong rgyu bya ba 'khor bcas chon nyan du byung ba byis pa zhig gis mngon sum du mthong bas dad pa skyes nas rab tu byung*/ dbyar smad sgang thug sgor byon/ g.yul ma thon bar bzhugs pa'i dus/ grwa pa bcu la so sor bstan bcos re mdzad/ de gnang bas gangs pa'i chos bcur grags so// mkhan po shong bde bas zhus pas theg pa chen po'i snying po yang mdzad/ dbu skra bzhugs pa'i tsha tsha 'bum ther kyang gnang*/ de nas mkhar chur byon nas dgun smad bzhugs/ khyad chos tshar gcig gsungs shing*/ ri chos gnad brgyad ma la zla chos su gsungs/ dur der lha sgom phul nas mkhar len mdzad/ dbyar de sdom gsum gnad gcig la zla chos mdzad/ de'i skabs su mnga' ris stod nas mnga' bdag gi gdan 'dren byung kyang*/ lho brag pas phebs su ma bcug spyir bar der dbus gtsang du phebs lam stod pas mkhas pa thams cad nyid kyi zhabs 'bring du 'dud par yang gyur to// dgun smad de song nas dpyid kyi dus/ gtsang nas thub pa bsod snyoms pa dang*/ 'bri gung nas spyan snga sgam po pa byon pa dang sku mched gsum gdan 'dzom zhing*/ nangs par yul por ston mo la dge 'dun 'dus par bcas pa phebs/ 'bul ba yang bzhed/ de nas gro bo lung du phebs 'gan 'jir che chung 'bring gsum bsgrubs te/ che ba lho brag pa'i sku 'bum steng du phul/ 'bring po sras kyi sku mkhar la phul/ 'gan 'jir chung ba gro bo lung gi sku mkhar la btsugs/ khyad chos tshar gcig gsungs/ ri chos dang sdom gsum gnad gcig kyang gnang*/ de nas skur du byon/ sgo mang la gzigs mo mdzad/ de nas yun mi ring bar sku mched rnams bka' gros nas/ spyan snga sgam po pa 'bri gung dang*/ spyan snga ba dang bsod snyoms pa gnyis ya rgyal du yar byon/ dbyar smad bsod snyoms pa gtsang du bzhud/ spyan snga nas 'bri gung du byon dgongs pa la gro bo lung pas mthil thel ?du mi bzhud pa'i zhu 'bul la sku mkhar phul/

der kyang lo ngo bcu tsam bzhugs kyi bar gtso bor khyad chos nyid gsungs te/ rgyal ba gcig pa mtshungs med 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma/ dgongs pa gcig pa'i chos tshul gcig pa'i phyag rgya chen po/ chos tshig gcig pa'i chos kun gzhan med 'khor 'das rang sems/ yod na yod la med na med pa'i ber ka gcig brten zhes/ ber ka gcig brten ma zhes pa yang mdzad/ de ltar bzhugs kyi bar tshogs pa chen po ni ye skyong pa'i dgongs pa mi mnga' yang*/ gar bzhugs su sgom chen pa gtsang ma lnga brgya skor re 'dus par gyur te/ ji skad du/ snyigs ma'i mchod 'os skyes bu rnams// gtong phod thabs mkhas ma bsdus shing*// chos min mthu brten ma byas par// rtag tu go 'phang bar ma bsten// 'khor tshogs skyong bar mi gda'o// zhes gsungs/ de nas spos dkar du phebs rgya phag gi yon bdag rnams kyis 'bul ba byas shing*/ mgur ma yang gsungs/ de nas yar klung la shul lam phyung nas phag mo grur phebs/ spyan snga rin po che dang mjal zhing*/ 'bri gung du phebs bar tsha thang nas dpon slob gsum mdzad de gsang thabs su mthil du phebs/ spyan sngar phyag 'bul mdzad/ gsung rab kyi rtsigs pa shin tu che ba gcig phrug sna ma stong phrag lnga/ rta brgya cu rtsa gnyis/ khrab bcu/ shog gu 'bum cha gsum/ g.yu bre gsum rnams kyi 'bul nod kyang mdzad/ dbyar de spyil mo cher bzhugs/ dus der sku mched gsum gdan 'dzoms pas/ yum dang mjal/ bstod pa'i dbyangs kyang mdzad/ dbyar smad sgam po nas gdan 'dren ltos che bar byung bas/ dbyar mchod snga sgyur te sgam por phebs te/ ri bo mchog rab ma'i bstod dbyangs kyang mdzad/ sgam po ba rnams kyis kyang bsu ba'i bkod pa du ma dang bcas nag tshang du gdan drangs/ bkra shis sgang phul/ zangs lung du sku 'bag 'od zer ma la mchod pa phul zhing*/ dpon slob gsum gyi dbyangs shig kyang mdzad/ sku 'bag las 'od zer 'phros pas sgam po'i sa steng thams cad khyab pa dpon slob bzhis gzigs/

rmang lam du rje phag mo gru pa dang mjal/ ston der sgam po gsol 'debs ma dang*/ 'og min ltar bstod pa/ bde ba can ltar bstod pa rnams mdzad/ ring por ma lon par mthil nas gdan 'dren byung bas/ dpon slob dgu phebs/ sme'u ti grags pa rin chen gyis khang par phyag phebs/ spyan snga gcung rin po che dang mkhan slob sgom pa dpon las dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs pa'i dus te/ de res mthil du zla ba gcig dang zhag gsum bzhugs/ dgun smad de rang la dgongs pa gcig pa tshoms bdun du byas nas gsungs/ de'i dbyar sku khams cher bsnyung*/ yi ge brgya pa'i thun byed pa'i bzhi sde zhig yod pa bos te/ zhal snga nas/ nga 'bus mthong thos dogs gsum gyi sgo nas gzhan nyes pa byas pa ma dran/ 'khor re re gnyis gnyis kyis sdod mi sdod zer ba la brten te mtho dman cung zad byung srid pas/ khyed rnams la bshags pa yin gsung ste bshags pa dang*/ spyi bshags kyang mdzad/ bsod snyoms pa dang yang mjal zhing zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs/ ston khams cung zad dwangs pa dang*/ grwa dgon pas mdo li la gdan drangs/ zla gcig bzhugs/ chos 'khor kyang bskor/ de nas yang sgam por byon/ dpyid dus theg pa chen po'i tshul dang*/ rab gnas sa bcu ma mdzad/ ston de yang grwa dgon pas gdan drangs/ tsin+ta ma ṇi dang 'phrang bdun ma gsungs/ dgun kla mdar dge bshes ci'i gdung khang rab gnas dang*/ dbye'i thang mgor byon/ lha khang rab gnas kyang mdzad/ dgun de rang la jo bo ya tse bas bcom ldan 'das bde mchog bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung sogs 'bul ba chen po 'ongs shing*/ la stod thang chung nas gser gyi mdo lis gdan 'dren zhes zhus pa la/ 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes zhe steng stag tu byon pa dang*/ sgam po bas gdan drangs te bzhud thabs ma byung*/ dgun de yang dgongs gcig tshar gcig gsungs/ lho brag nas spyi sgos kyi 'bul ba ltos che bar byung ba dang*/

grum mdar mjal bas/ zhal snga nas gzhan gyis 'bul zan gyi dod po nga yi chos yin gsungs nas/ chos sku rang la yod pas dus yun rings kyi gzhan nas ma tshol/ sogs rdo rje'i tshig dgu las rgya cher bshad de chos thun mang po'i bar du gnang ngo*// de nas 'o ler byon/ nam mkha'i phyag rgya la chos zhag nyer bdun mdzad/ de nas sgam por byon dbyar de dgongs gcig zla ba bzhir gsungs/ zhal snga nas/ nga'i chos 'di lho brag tu bshad pa'i dus ni phyogs snga rgyas par bstan pas/ gser gyi ri bdun kha nas bltas pa dang 'dra/ da res ni rang bzhed rgyas par phye bas ri yi rgyal po ri rab kyi rtse nas bltas pa dang 'dra ste/ nga 'bu gdugs kyi dkyil du bsdad nas rtsib ma skye ba lta bu yin pas/ khyed tshos bzung zhig phyin chad 'di 'dra 'byon par dka'o// zhes sogs rjes su gdams te/ khyad chos shin tu rgyas par gsungs so/ de nas spyan snga sgam po pa 'bri gung du btang*/ dgun grwa dgon du spyan drangs nas phebs/ yan lag bdun pa'i khyad chos rang la zla ba gcig gsungs/ gzhan yang phyag rgya chen po'i khrid dang*/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i tshig bcad ma/ thabs lam tshig bcad ma/ dgongs pa gcig sdom gsum la sogs pas mtshon pa gsungs/ der yum grongs pa snyan du zhus pas/ a ma ma shi a ma 'phur// a ma sangs rgyas kun gyi yum// a ma shes rab pha rol phyin// a ma 'khor 'das yon tan gter// zhes gsungs te dbyangs byed du bcug de nas mdo li la gdan drangs/ sgam por byon/ sos dgongs gcig tshar gcig gsungs pa'i rjes la/ da res nga'i dgongs gcig 'di don bsdus te bstan pa yin gsungs te/ dpe brgya byin la grangs nas gsungs pa las/ gtsang ston hral chung gi zhu ba phul ba la brten/ zhus lan gnyis pa yang dus der mdzad/ ston kha rin po che dam pa grum mdar byon pa mjal bar phebs/ phan tshun 'bul ba yang che bar mdzad/ chos gcig gis gcig la zhu bar mdzad pas/

snga phyi re mos su mdzad de/ spyan snga'i zhal nas/ nga 'bu la gzhan gyi gnyer med/ 'on kyang nga rang gi ngo skal dwags po lung pa 'dir/ hor gyi gnod pa lo skor gcig tu mi 'ong ba'i rten 'brel byed gsung ste/ sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ma zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad cus bskor ba'i zur bzhir phyogs kyi khro bo bzhi bri bar mdzad/ bshes gnyen la gdams pa'i gsal byed ye shes kyi sgron me yang mdzad/ ston mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba nas/ slob dpon jo btsun gyis spyan snga nyid ni kun tu bzang po dngos yin pa la/ 'khor 'di rnams ye mi mthun pa ci lags/ zhus pas/ mi mthun pa kho nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'di 'dra ba rnams kyi nang du skye ba bzhes pa yin cing*/ 'di lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'byon dgongs pa yin gsungs/ sku gshegs khar khams nas dar dkar po kha gang la nyid kyi mtshan bris pa zhig phyag tu phul byung ba la/ zhal snga nas 'bul ba'i phyi ma bzhes pa 'di la rten 'brel yod pas/ nga'i rgyud 'di dar dkar po 'dis mtshon/ yi ge nag po ming du yod pa 'di da dung nga'i rgyud la sgrib pa 'di tsam cig yod bya ba yin/ skye ba phyi ma 'di la de yang sangs kyis dag nas 'jig rten mgon po dang dbyer med du 'gro bar 'dug gzhan 'phrin las ni 'gro ba rnams kyi mthong snang du 'ong ba yin/ zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang bdag gis khyed rnams la snying gtam zhal chems su smra ba yin pas zung cig de la spyir 'jig rten mgon pos chos ji snyed cig gsungs pa de thams cad kyi don hril gyis dril nas nyams len du byed na/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis ma gtogs pa gcig kyang med pas 'di kho na gdams pa yin/ 'o na tshul khrims ma gdams sam snyam na/ tshul khrims kyi gegs sel dang bogs 'don yin pas logs su med de/ de skad du yang*/ byang chub sems kyi mi mthun phyogs// 'gal rkyen spong zhing mthun rkyen sgrub// 'bras bu stobs bcu thob pa des// tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin// ces gsung zhing*/

dpang po'i tshul du 'jig rten mgon po'i sku 'dra byin can zhig yod pa'ang spyan drangs te/ zhal nas byang chub kyi sems gnyis po 'di ma gtogs pa/ de las gzhan pa'i logs su 'jig rten mgon po'i chos mdzod yod re gsung ba sogs dbu snyung dang bcas/ rjes 'jug gi sras rnams la legs par gdams nas/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga bzhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo ston zla 'bring po'i skar ma tha skar gyi nya ba'i zla ba la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa rlabs po che bstan pa'i dus/ tshes bcu bdun gyi nam gyi cha stod la/ rnam grol zhi ba chen po'i pho brang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bzhugs gnas dam pa mthar phyin pa'i de bzhin rtag pa'i dbyings su gshegs te/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur gyi bar du/ ji snyed nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can gyi khams rgyud las/ dus rtag par mnyam pa nyid lhun gyis grub par bzhugs so// de yang 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zhal nas/ sngon gyi rgyal ba snyen bskur bas// da lta mchog gi rigs su skyes// 'jig rten mgon gyi sras gyur pa// mos gus pad mo kha phye ste// gnyis med ye shes bdud rtsi yis// thugs kyi dpal be'u rab bkang zhing*// mtha' yas 'gro ba smin par mdzad// skyes bu chen po khyed la 'dud// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dbang bskur mchog thob rgyud 'dzin cing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i bdag /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs tshe// 'gro kun smin par mdzad la 'dud// ces bla mas slob ma la bstod par gyur pa 'di nyid nges pa yin no// de ltar mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma yi// rnam thar rgya mtsho dpag par dka' ba las// skra rtse'i chu thigs ji lta'i tshul du bris// dge des 'gro kun rnam mkhyen sa thob shog /chos kyi rje spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa'i rnam par thar pa tshig nyung ngur bsdus pa zhig

dgongs pa gcig pa'i lhan thabs su bri bar rigs zhes/ lung rigs kyi gnas la thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa'i rab 'byams pa/ bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po'i blo can/ dgongs gcig pa shākya chos 'phel zhes bgyi bas yun ring po nas bskul ba las/ 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyis/ shing mo lug lo zla ba bzhi par gnas chen gter sgrom du sbyar ba'o// lan gcig kho na zhus so/// /maṅgalaṃ/

༄༅// rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi rnam par thar pa snyan grags lha yi rnga chen tshangs dbyangs kyi sgra brgya pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa tshad med thugs rje'i gter du gyur pa thams cad kyi mkhyen rtse dang nus mthu ma lus pa kun/ gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid/ ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur gyi bar du/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang chen gyi rol pa chen pos gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul du/ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i yon tan bkod pa kun las khyad par du gyur pa'i ston pa/ skyabs mchog mtshungs pa thams cad kyi dpe las yongs su 'das pa/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la sgo gsum gus pa chen po'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// dpag yas bskal par tshogs gnyis sa chen spyod pa'i rgya mtsho'i mthar son zhing*// dad dang 'dun dang snying rje'i dgongs pa rab brtan mngon du gyur pa las// brgal dka' srid pa'i 'ching ba kun grol bde chen snang ba'i mig gcig pu// gang de rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan zhes sa gsum grags pa'i ba dan g.yo// ji ltar rnam rgyal khang bzang rtser// lha rnams dge ba'i mthu yis ni// chos kyi shugs 'phyang zhes bya'i rngas// bag med spyod las bskul byed ltar// bsod nams bye bas bskrun pa'i skus// gdul bya dag pa'i rna dbang du// brgyad khri bzhi stong chos rnga sgrog /thabs kyis bla med lam la sbyor// de ltar sku gsung thugs kyi gsang*// snyan grags lha yi rnga chen 'di// tshangs dbyangs brgya yi sgra lta bur// srid mtha'i bar du sgrog par spro// zhes mchod par brjod pa dang bri bar spro ba'i dam bca' sngon du song nas/ spyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ de rnams kyis lung bstan zhing rjes su gnang ba'i skyes chen dam pa kun gyi chos nyid ni/

phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i zhing du mchis pa'i gdul bya sems can thams cad kyi don du/ sngon gyi dus nas phyi ma'i dus kyi mu mthar thug gi bar srid pa'i gnas su 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba'i snang brnyan gyi 'phrul pa du mas/ las nyon shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus pa sbyangs pa'i tshul/ rgyu 'bras zab mo'i 'khor lo rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba/ che ba'i yon tan gyis snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad mnyam pa chen po zhi ba chos dbyings stong pa nyid kyi ngo bor thugs su chud de/ rang don dam pa chos kyi skur sangs rgyas/ de bzhin nyid la g.yo ba mi mnga' bzhin du/ slar yang*/ sngon gyi thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' chen po yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ zhing de dang de dag so sor/ bsam bzhin nying mtshams sbyar nas/ 'khor ba'i duḥkha 'jigs su rung ba'i ra bar 'khor zhing gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sdug bsngal gyi 'tshe ba du mas gtses par gyur pa'i sems can rnams la thugs brtse bar dgongs te/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis sam/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo nas gzugs kyi sku rnam pa gnyis kyis/ gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul du/ don mdzad par gyur pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams ni/ gang gis bskal pa'i bar du brjod par gyur kyang*/ rdzogs pa'i mtha' las 'das pa kho na nyid do// de lta na'ang 'dir skabs su bab pa gleng bar bgyi ba 'di ni rje btsun yongs 'dzin dam pa de nyid kyi skye ba 'di yi rnam thar mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed par byed pa'i lung du bstan tshul dang*/ rmongs pa tshu rol mthong ba'i mdzad pa rnams la/ rang bzo dang sgro bskur gyi dri ma ring du dor te/ rang bzhin brjod pa nyid du bgyi'o// de yang rang re thams cad kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhi chen po/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs mchog gi yul du gyur pa/

dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i gsang chen zab mo'i don la dbang bsgyur zhing*/ mnga' brnyes pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ā nan+da rat+na dharma dh+wa dza shrī bha dra gang de nyid/ sngon gyi dus su me tog spungs pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams su/ de bzhin gshegs pa klu rigs sgrol mar sangs rgyas te sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshe/ sku de nyid las 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig rigs drug gi gnas su spros te/ lha yi gnas su ston pa dpa' bo rtsal rdzogs dang*/ lha min gnas su ston pa mtshon chen rtsal rdzogs/ mi yi yul du ston pa ting 'dzin rgyal po/ yi dwags gnas su ston pa me tog rdzogs pa/ byol song gnas su ston pa gnyen bzang byed po/ dmyal ba'i gnas su ston pa bsil byed 'od 'phro/ de rnams su byin gyis brlabs shing sprul te/ thugs zhi ba chen po'i ngang du gshegs so// de'i 'og tu zhing khams 'od zer stobs ldan zhes par/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer mtha' yas su bstan te 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ slar zhing de nas mya ngan las 'das nas/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid du gzugs sku gsum du sprul te/ sku'i sprul pa byang chub sems dpa' gsal mchog ni chos sku mngon du gyur nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ gsung gi sprul pa li tsa bī dri ma med pa ni longs sku mngon du gyur nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ thugs kyi sprul pa kun dga' bo ni sprul sku mngon du gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' bsdu ba po mdzad do// de'i 'og tu/ 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya'i grangs snyed kyi zhing khams su/ bka'i dgongs pa thams cad la rgya cher 'grel pa/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub ces pa'i mtshan 'chang bas/ nyid dang sprul pa lnga'i sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni/ sku yi sprul pa ḍoṃ bhi he ru kaḥ gsung gi sprul pa nus ldan blo gros rtsal/ thugs kyi sprul pa bram ze chen po sa ra ha/

yon tan gyi sprul pa dzi na 'byung*/ phrin las kyi sprul pa gsung byed bden smra/ zhes bya ba rnams su rnam 'phrul bstan te/ grub pa brnyes pa dang rab tu byung ba'i cha byad kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do// de nas de dang de rnams su mi snang ba'i tshul bstan pa'i rjes su/ bod khams kyi sa yi cha 'di nyid du/ chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dang*/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ khri gtsug ral pa can sogs su skye ba bzhes te 'gro kun dge ba bcu'i khrims la bkod do// de nas ri bo gan+dha ru zhes bya bar longs spyod rdzogs sku he ru ka'i rnam pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyis gdul bya'i tshogs grol bar mdzad do// de yi phrin las yongs su rdzogs nas/ chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du/ slar gangs can gyi khrod 'di nyid du 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rat+na shrī zhes pa'i mtshan 'dzin pas der gnas pa'i 'gro ba 'dul zhing*/ de nyid kyi bstan pa 'byung bar lung bstan pa rnams ni/ mdo sde dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang rgya che rol pa dang*/ phal chen nag 'gyur rnams su blta bar bya zhing*/ gong gi skyes rabs rnams kyi lung khungs zhib tu mnyan par 'tshal na/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang lha sras zhus len gyi skor brag dmar zangs yag tu sbas pa/ phyis gu ru snye mdo bas gdan drangs pa dang rgyal po bka'i thang yig rnams las rtogs par byos shig de ltar 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma de ni/ slar snyigs ma las kyang snyigs mar gyur pa'i dus 'dir rgyal dbang kun dga'i mtshan can du bsams bzhin srid par nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshul bstan par mngon te/ rje de nyid kyis lung bstan pa ni/ gser khang sgo bcad ma las gsungs pa bzhin/ chos snying po lhur mi len pa dang*/ dus snyigs ma'i dus dang*/ gang zag log rtog dang*/

rdzas te mi 'gyur ba'i rtags bzhi gsal bar gyur pa rnams ni/ yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas 'dir ma bkod do// khungs nyid du blta bar bya'o// de ltar bde gshegs klu rigs sgrol ma sogs// sangs rgyas gyur kyang slar sangs rgya ba'i tshul// la lar longs sku'i ston pa he ru kaḥ /la lar grub chen la lar rgyal po'i tshul// ma nges thabs kyis sna tshogs gdul bya la// dus las mi yol tshad med snyoms pa'i thugs// srid mtha'i bar du ngal med brtson pa'i go// gnyis med ye shes rtogs pa'i mtshon 'dzin pas// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i g.yul kun pham mdzad de// bde chen rgyal ba'i mnga' srid rab rgyas sogs// mdzad pa dpag med rlabs chen snang ba ni// dpa' chen snying rje'i stobs kyi 'phrul pa'i gar// zhes 'di na smra'o// de dag kun ni mkhas pa dga' ba bskyed pa'i sngon gyi skyes rabs dang*/ lung du bstan tshul gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i skabs te dang po'o// ༈ //gnyis pa rmongs pa tshu rol mthong bar gyur pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa cha tsam brjod na/ gling gzhi las mchog tu gyur pa lho phyogs dzam bu tri shas mtshon pa'i yul gyi 'dzin ma'i khyon las/ chos kyis phye ba'i dbus su gyur pa gzho stod sa'i thig le u rgyan gyi sgrub gnas ti sgro brag dkar dang nye ba/ mkha' 'gro du ma 'du ba'i sbas lung sgru zhes bya ba bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan ma tshang ba med pa dag gis legs par brgyan pa'i pho brang*/ bkra shis steng khar grags pa der/ yab rigs rus cho 'brang gi dpal gyi mngon par mtho ba/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan ma lus pa'i pha mthar son pa/ mtshan dngos/ rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang*/ yum dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa skyed par byed pa'i gsang chen mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde stong zag med kyi mthus/

mngon par gtams par gyur pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyi rnam par 'phrul pa/ rin chen dpal mo zhes bgyi ba'i khab tu/ sku mched gsum 'khrungs par gyur pa las/ 'brug gi lo la gcen po/ rin chen rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ khyi yi lo la gcung chos kyi rgyal po bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ de dag gi bar du/ lug gi lo la skyes chen dam pa 'di nyid bltams par gyur pa'i ltas bzang dge mtshan gyi tshogs rnams mdor bsdus te smras pa/ de tshe yab gyur gsang bdag sprul pa mchog /rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i// 'od gsal ngang las g.yo med rang mdangs su// sku yi cha las dpal ldan dus 'khor lo// 'od zer dang bcas phyogs su spro ba dang*// yum gyi mnal lam mkha' dbyings rten med du// rnga chen bskul med rang sgra sgrog pa dang*// mdun du rkyen bral mtsho chen rdol ba la// kun gyis 'thung zhing ngoms med mnyan pa gzigs// gser khang chos rjer grags pa'i sku 'dra yi// thugs las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pa las// sgrib med pho brang bar du sbrel ba ni// phyogs der gnas pa kun gyis gsal bar mthong*// gzhan yang yul phyogs der gnas sems can kun// phyi nang 'tshe ba'i tshogs ni ring du byer// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i dpal ni yid ltar 'dus// 'jig rten skyong ba rang rang sder bcas te// zhabs 'bring bsgrub phyir nyin mtshan dbyer med srung*// chu 'dzin dbus las lus phyed 'thon pa yi// lha yi bu dang bu mo kun gyis kyang*// 'dab brgya ldan pa'i me tog char chen 'bebs// kha dog sna lnga bkra ba'i 'od phreng ni// bkra shis rtags dang bla re ba dan dbyibs// phyogs rnams kun tu bkram pas yongs su bskor// zhes so// de ltar skyes chen 'di nyid/ rgyu skar gyi bdag po tshes kyi dpal 'byor thob pa lta bu'i sku gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas te/

lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mgon du bltams par gyur pa'i dge legs 'od dkar gyi snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur pa dag gis bskul ba las/ yul gru tha dad du 'khod pa'i sa chen skyong ba gang dag mchis pa rnams kyang*/ yid kyi ut+pal rab tu rgod par gyur cing*/ longs spyod kyi bcud kyis gtams par gyur pa'i pho nya dag kyang phyogs der thams cad 'dus par gyur te// de yi tshe bshes gnyen bkra shis rgya mtsho zhes bya bas rig sngags kyi mthu las/ rgyal sras 'di nyid/ btsas pa'i cho ga legs par bsgrubs shing*/ mtshan yang rin chen lhun po zhes bya bar gsol to/ de nas bdag nyid chen po de rim gyis skyed drags par gyur pa las/ gzhon nu rtse ba'i dus la bab pa na'ang*/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang*/ byis pa'i 'khor dang rde'u'i tshogs la chos 'chad nyan gyi tshul du gzhan la ston pa dang*/ nyid kyang thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i snang brnyan ston par mdzad do// gzhan yang*/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa thugs las rang byung du sgrog cing*/ bkra shis sgo mang dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog tu gyur pa bzhengs pa'i bkod pa sogs ma 'ongs ji ltar 'byung ba ston pa'i tshul dang*/ shin tu gtsang zhing bsil ba'i shing gi grib ma la/ sku drang por srang zhing dkyil mo krung bcas te dgongs pa rtog ge rig pa'i dpyod pas mi dmigs pa'i mnyam par 'jog par bstan pa sogs mdor na tha mal gyi byis pa kun gyi spyod yul las 'das pa nyid do// tshogs gnyis dpal las 'khrungs pa'i sku de nyid// de nas dgung lo bdun du bab pa na// bshes gnyen sbyin grags pa zhes yi ge yi// 'bri klog pha mthar son pa'i bcud kyis gtams// ngag gi tshal bzang rab tu mdzes pa las// don bzang ro nus bdud rtsis rgyas pa kun// 'gro ba'i dga' ston slad du rin chen gyi// rkang drug rtsol med thabs kyis blangs par gyur// skabs shig 'bri stag sde chen 'khrugs pa'i tshe// skyes bu dam can rdo rje legs pa ni// mig sman lta bur nag pa'i kha dog la// ldul ldan chu yi zar bu thur du gnyer// thun mtshams mdog can ral dmar gyen du gzings// me bzhin 'bar ba'i sma ra smin ma g.yo// gangs ltar dkar zhing glog chen 'khyug 'dra ba'i// so yi phreng ba myur mgyogs ljags kyang bskyod// rab bsgrad mig ni khro tshul blta bzhin du// ber nag gyon pa'i lag gis ri bong gi// mgo mang drung du spungs te slar yang ni// drag po'i tsha rngam gsod la brtson pa gzigs// nyid kyi thugs rje bzod glags med pa yi// da ni mchog ces yang yang gsungs pa'i tshe// de dang dus mtshungs rang srid dpung tshogs kyis// pha rol sde bcas ma lus pham par byas// 'di yang 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kyis// bskul med drag po'i phrin las bsgrubs par mngon// de nas dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i tshe/

yab kyi thugs dgongs chos dbyings zhi ba chen po'i ngang du gshegs shing*/ sku 'di yi snang ba'i dkyil 'khor sdud pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ yum la'ang zab rgyas kyi gsung gis dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rnam dkar gyi bya ba rlabs po che rnams la'ang bka'i bkod pas khyab par mdzad do// de dag gi skabs shig tu/ sku cung zad snyung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das sman gyi rgyal po'i sku gsal bar gzigs shing*/ de dag las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phros par gyur te/ nyid kyi sku la thim pa'i snang ba la brten nas/ mnyam rjes 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i rtogs pa mngon du mdzad do// de nas dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes pa'i dus/ sngon gyi dam bca'i rtsa ba brtan po dang ldan pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbyer mi phyed pa'i dpag bsam gyi ljon pa chen po/ gzhan phan ston ka'i dus la bab pa/ brtson pa'i dri gzhon gyis rab tu bskyod de/ don gnyis kyi 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i dgongs pa 'khrungs pa'i tshul bstan te/ rgyal ba ma lus pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba chen po'i mkha' dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor las thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyi sprin phung bsdus te/ dam chos bdud rtsi'i char chen rgyun chad med par 'bebs pa'i spyod pa gong na ma mchis pa dag gis thabs mkhas pas/ gdul bya rnams kyi dad pa'i sa gzhi la/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba ma lus pa skyed pa'i pad tshal/ yon tan dang phrin las mi zad pa'i ro bcud kyis gtams par gyur pa'i skyes chen dam pa/ dbang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs drung du/ thos bsam gyi bya ba la ngal ba med pa'i spro ba 'khrungs te/ yar la phebs pa'i lam bar du sngon gyi rten 'brel gyi che ba du ma dang ldan pa'i drug rtsa'i byis pa rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi yid dang 'tshams pa'i mchod rdzas du ma thogs pas bsu ba'i bkod pa dang bcas te rim gyis phebs par gyur pa las/

mi rtag pa dang nges par 'byung ba'i gtam gyis yang dag par bskul zhing*/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun dam pa des kyang*/ thun mong du gyur pa'i drang nges kyi rgyud lung man ngag ma lus pa gdams par mdzad pa'i tshul rnams ni/ gsan yig chen mor blta bar bya ste/ 'dir ni yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so// de nas dgung lo bcu gnyis la bab pa na/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i snyigs dus kyi phrin las pa karma pa zhes zhwa nag gi cod paṇa 'dzin pa bdun pa mtshan dngos chos grags rgya mtsho zhes bya ba klung shod kyi sa'i cha las khyad par du byas pa zu re bkra shis thang du phebs pa dang mtshungs par/ bdag nyid chen po 'di yang sa phyogs der sku'i dkyil 'khor sprul pa'i 'khor dang bcas te phebs par gyur pa las/ phan tshun longs spyod kyi skyes kyi 'bul ba'i glog gi phreng ba dag gis myur du sbrel ba'i tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' dpag par dka' ba las legs par 'khrungs pa'i chu 'dzin gyi phung po dag gi sku ni so sor 'khrigs te/ der gnas pa'i srog chags bye ba khrag khrig rnams kyi dad pa'i sa gzhi la/ dam chos bdud rtsi'i char chen dag kyang 'gran pa bzhin du phab pas/ yang dag thar pa'i lo 'bras ma lus pa ches cher rgyas par gyur to// slar yang rgyal ba'i dbang po 'di nyid ni/ gsung rab kyi don la chog 'dzin gyi drwa ba ma mchis pa'i thugs mnga' bas/ rje btsun dam pa de las/ theg chen bstan pa'i snying po sogs/ spyi dang rang gi gzhung lugs kyi gdams pa'i bdud rtsi mchog gi bcud la ngoms pa med pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin par mdzad do// de nas kyang slar nyid kyi khu bor gyur pa mnyam med dbang rin po che'i drung du phebs te/ khyad par du gyur pa skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zab rgyas kyi chos mdzod ma lus pa'i don la thos bsam sgom pa'i brtson pa la thugs la ngal ba med par sbyangs so// de'i tshe nub gcig gi rmi lam du sku lus las rnag khrag gi rgyun mang du thon pa zhig byung snang ba/

nangs par zhus pa'i dus/ khyed kyi las nyon shes bya'i sgrib pa ma lus pa byang ba'i tshul gyi ltas yin no// zhes gsung zhing rje btsun de nyid la dus mtha'i mos gus kyi rtsal rdzogs par gyur to// de nas dgung lo bcu bzhi pa spre'u'i lo la/ lha khang chen mor mtshungs med dbang rin po che nyid kyi thugs dam du shākya'i rgyal po'i sku gser gyi ri bo ltar brjid cing skye 'gro du ma'i tshogs gnyis kyi zhing du gyur pa bzhengs par gnang ba'i rab gnas kyi skabs su bab par/ rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa spyan drangs te/ rab gnas mdzad pa'i nyin/ rje btsun lhun po'i mtshan can 'di nyid kyi gzigs snang mchog tu gyur pa ni 'di lta ste/ de tshe kun khyab 'khor lo'i rang gzugs ni// bai ḍūr bzhu 'dra'i sngo bsangs 'tsher ba'i dbus// tsha zer byed po'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar zhing*// rten med nam mkha'i mthongs nas lha rnams kyis// ca co ga zha'i sgra dang bcas bzhin du// me tog char chen phyogs kun khyab par phab// 'ja' tshon 'bar ba'i 'od phreng bkra ba ni// kho ra khor yug yol ba bla re'i dbyibs// de dbus gser zangs mdog can thub dbang po// dgra bcom nyan thos 'khor gyis bskor ba ni// dam tshig ye shes sems dpa'i tshul lta bur// rten la thim pa dngos su gsal bar gzigs// zhes so// yang de yi dus su rgyal ba'i dbang po karma pa las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam chos gsan pa mdzad cing yon mchod phan tshun thams cad longs spyod kyi dga' ston spel bar gnang zhing*/ slar yang lo de nyid la sgar chen byang du phebs pa'i tshe mjal bar gyur pa las/ rje 'di nyid 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po nyid du ngos 'dzin par yang mdzad do// de nas dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa na/ rab tu 'byin pa'i spro ba 'khrungs pa la khu bo dang yum rnams kyis kyang*/ dgyes bzhin du gnang ste/

paṇa chen shākya shrī'i ring lugs las 'ongs shing*/ mkhan po'i chos gsum gyi pha mthar son pa'i skyes chen kun dga' blo gros kyi zhal mnga' nas dang*/ slob dpon blo gros brtan pa/ dus sgo ba legs pa rin chen sogs/ dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du spyan drangs pa'i dbus su/ bar ma rab tu byung ba dang*/ dge tshul yongs su rdzogs pa grub par mdzad de/ mtshan yang kun dga' rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ zhes sa gsum du grags par gyur pa la/ dpal 'bri gung gi chos grwa'i mkhan slob chos gsum sogs khur du bzhes pa kun gyis kyang*/ legs cha'i skyes kyi 'bul ba'i khyad par du mas mchod do// slar mkhan chen rin po che'i drung du/ gsang sngags kyi dbang rjes gnang du ma dang*/ slob dpon brtan pa ba la'ang mdo 'dul sogs kyi gsan pa mang du mdzad cing*/ dpon slob dge 'dun 'khor dang bcas pa la/ mchod pa dang bkur sti du mas mnyes par mdzad de tshogs gnyis kyi bsil zer yongs su gang zhing rgyas par gyur to// gzhan yang rje btsun yongs 'dzin dam pa 'di ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus pa'i snying po sgrub pas len par bzhed nas/ klung shod spangs kyi phu/ mkhar rdzong zhes bya ba'i dben gnas su/sa bcu yi don la dbang brnyes pa'i mtshan dngos 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin chen gyi drung du/ nā ro'i chos drug gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i tshe/ bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par du gyur pa 'khrungs shing*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar/ 'od dang 'od zer rab tu 'khrug pa'i dbus su bzhugs pa'i zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs pa'i tshe/ mgur bzhengs pa/ gtum mo 'bar bas nyon mongs bud shing bsregs// 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa'i ngang nyid nas// snang srid sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol par shar// rmi lam nam mkha'i dbyings su rnam par dag

/'pho bya 'pho byed blo byas chos las grol// bar do zung 'jug dbyer med 'dzin pa stor// zhes gsungs so// yang mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rdzogs rim 'khor lo lnga ma gsan pa'i dus su/ dgong thun la bab pa'i tshe/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu ras chen pas/ rje 'di'i ngo mtshar sku yi bkod pa bstan pa'i tshul gzigs pa tshigs su bcad de 'dir smras pa/ bskal chen dus mtha' brgya yi me lta bur// rab tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrug pa'i klong*// mi'u thung khros 'dra char sprin mdog mtshungs pa'i// nyid sku ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa// che zhing brjid la dpa' brtan sgeg pa'i sku// myur du bskyod pa'i mtshon chen char du 'bebs// drag sngags 'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug sgrar sgrog /tsha rngam drag po'i rnam 'gyur ston pa gzigs// zhes so// gzhan yang dpal mgon po'i chos bskor rnams gsan pa'i tshe zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las grub pa'i rtags mtshan byung tshul rnams ni yi ge mang bas 'jigs nas 'dir ma bris so// de nas dgung lo bco brgyad bzhes pa byi ba'i lo la/ khang sar nang so'i mi dpon dpal grags zhes bya ba dus las 'das pa'i gshegs rdzongs kyi gral dbu la spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ sku lus kyi bkod pa du mar snang ba ni/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i 'khor la/ zab rgyas kyi gsung gis chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ de dang mtshungs par/ bka' gros kyi dbus su bzhugs pa/ khrom mang tshogs pa'i gung la yas ('bel )gtam dang bsngo ba gnang ba rnams dus cig car du gyur pa ni der gnas pa kun gyis ya mtshan gyi gnas su gyur par bstod do// de nas slar yang 'bri gung byang chub gling nyid du phebs par gyur te/ gdan sa ?chags pa'i dgung lo bcu dgu la bab pa na/ dben gnas tha ba kha zhes bya bar slob dpon gtsang pa nyid kyi drung du/ bka' gtad rjes gnang gi tshogs du ma dang*/

rgyud dang rgya gzhung gi tshogs la rgya cher 'grel pa'i bshad sbyang gis gtan la 'bebs par mdzad cing*/ khyad par zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa nyams khrid du gsan pa'i tshe/ rtags bcu dang yon tan brgyad sogs kyi pha mthar son pa'i tshul ni/ stegs bu mchod rdzas du ma bkram par gyur pa'i dbus su sku gar stabs su bzhugs shing nyams mgur lhang lhang gsung ba drung du mchis pa'i ras chen pas gzigs shing gsan par gyur pa las/ slar zhib tu bsnyad pa'i tshe/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bdag gi lus kyis khyab pa'i snang ba zhig gi mod la mgon po phyag bzhi pa gser gyi mdog can dpag tu med pa dag gis gar mdzad pa mthong ba snyam nas de'i lad mo bgyis pa yin/ da lta mchod pa'i yo byad kun ma nyams par 'dug pa mthong bar gyur tam gsungs so// yang thugs dam de nyid kyi ngang la bzhugs pa'i dus gcig tu/ gsal nyams chen po'i ngang nas mchod gshom la gzigs pa'i tshe/ rdo rje 'chang nas bzung bka' brgyud bla ma rnams rab tu gsal zhing*/ mnyam med sgam po pa/ slob dpon rin po che nyid dang dbyer med par gzigs pas/ de yi rgyu mtshan zhu bar gnang tshe/ zhal mnga' nas/ kho bo mnyam med sgam po pas rjes su bzung ba zhig yin/ zhes sogs zhib rgyas kyi gsung gis brda khrol phul ba la brten/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa thugs la 'khrungs par gyur to// yang spang zung gi gnas su/ rje btsun de nyid las/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid gsan pa'i tshe/ nyin phyed kyi thun la bab pa na gzigs snang byung tshul dag ni 'di lta ste/ mdun gyi nam mkha' rten med 'od zer dbus// gser ri'i mdog mtshungs thub dbang rgyal po'i sku// sa gnon mnyam bzhag phyag gis lhung bzed bsnams// yun ring bar du snang ba rab tu gzigs// zhes so// gzhan yang bka' brgyud spyi dang bye brag gi man ngag gi gsang mdzod du ma'ang gsan zhing*/

snying po grub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po/ gang gi blo gros mkha' ltar rab tu yangs pa dag gi dbyings las/ don gnyis dpal gyi tsha zer rab tu 'bar ba dang ldan pa'i rgyal ba rta bdun dbang po zhes bya ba la u rgyan bsnyen sgrub cha lag dang bcas pa sogs gsan pa dpag tu med pa mdzad cing*/ grub chen des kyang*/ rje 'di la 'bri gung pa'i chos skor mang du gsan no// de nas slar yang rgyal ba'i gsung rab mang du thos pa'i lus stobs rab tu rgyas shing*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rab brtan gangs ri'i rtse la mngon par 'gying ba'i// rin chen lta bur dgos 'dod dpal gyi 'byor pas khengs par gyur pa'i ngar skad drag pos/ lta ngan wa tshogs 'jigs shing 'byer bar byed pa'i 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyal po zhes bya ba la/ rngog pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi dbang du ma dang*/ de rnams kyi rgyud 'grel sogs la'ang gsan pa mthar phyin par mdzad cing*/ smra ba'i dbang po des kyang*/ rje btsun dam pa 'di la rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung ngo*// de ltar yongs 'dzin dam pa de rnams las gsan par gyur pa'i gdams pa ma lus pa kun thugs nyams su bzhes te/ rnal 'byor bzhi yi rim pa chung 'bring chen po'i tshul du 'khrungs par gyur pa las/ tshig tshogs yi ge rtogs shing spros pa thams cad kyi dpe las 'das pa'i don mngon du mdzad do// de nas dgung lo nyi shu son pa stag gi lo la/ slar yang chos lung pa'i tshogs par spyan drangs te/ mkhan slob las gral dang bcas pa'i dbus su bsnyen par yongs su rdzogs par mdzad de/ mkhan chen de nyid kyi drung du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel dang*/ paṇa chen gsum gyi man ngag sogs gsan cing*/ tshogs pa dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pas kyang*/ rje 'di yi zhabs pad dbang po mchog gi spo la bcings par mdzad do// lo de nyid la dpal 'bri gung gi gdan sa chen por mnga' gsol ba'i tshul/

'dir tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ log smra'i wa skyes zil gnon seng ge'i khri// zab dang rgya che'i nga ro sgrog pa'i gzhir// rgyal ba'i spyod ldan dpa' chen de gshegs te// kun gyis bkur zhing blta ba'i gnas su gyur// de dus de tshe sems med rgya mtsho chu chen chu phran 'bab chu la sogs kun// rang dang rang gi dpal dang ldan par g.yas dang g.yas min 'khor ste sgra yang 'byin// ri dang ri min thang du skyes pa'i me tog me 'dra 'bar ba kun kyang ni// rang dang rang gi dri ngad ldang bzhin phyogs dang phyogs mtshams bar med kun tu bkram// nyi zla nyi zla'i 'od kyang 'phrog pa'i legs byas legs pa'i 'od zer khrag khrig rnams// rang dang rang gi mdangs kun gsal bar gang dang gang der khyab par rab gnas gyur// lha rdzas lha yi bdud rtsi zil gnon 'bras bu 'bras ldan bcud kyis gtams rnams kyang*// rang dang rang gi nus pa bskyed cing kho ra khor yug phyogs kun yongs su bskor// dri med dri za'i dbyangs kyang 'gong ba'i sgra snyan sgra tshogs rnam mang grags pa yang*// rang dang rang gi sgra kun 'byin zhing phyogs dang phyogs bral bar med 'khor zhing khyab// de lta de lta'i bkra shis rtags kyi cha shas cha tsam ma lus rdzogs pa'i dbus// dge legs dge ba'i rgyu las bskrun pa'i mchog las mchog tu gyur pa rgyal ba'i sras// dpal ldan dpal mdzod mtha' dag dbang bsgyur theg gsum theg mchog don ldan kun dga'i zhabs// dregs ldan dregs gyur lhar bcas kun thod lan gcig la min dus rnams 'bral med bsten// zhes so// de ltar rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid khri thog bcu gsum gyi dus la bab par gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi lugs gnyis phrin las gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i srid la mnga' gsol ba'i nyin de nyid nas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyi 'byor pa mtha' dag ni rdzogs ldan gyi sprin bzhin du 'dus par gyur to// de yi dus su 'bri gung gi gling rin po che 'di nyid bar skabs su rang lugs chos srid kyi 'byor pa'i mnga' thang cung zad ngal bso'i dbang du gyur pa la/

yongs 'dzin dam pa 'di ni/ rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor chen po rab tu 'bar ba las/ phrin las rnam bzhi'i tsha zer 'phros te log rtog byed po'i bsil zer gyis bskyangs pa'i nyon mongs dug lnga'i 'dab ma dang ldan zhing*/ phrag dog drag po'i rlung gis bskyod de kun tu g.yo bar gyur pa gang dag ku mud da'i tshal du gyur pa rnams kyi kha zum par mdzad cing*/ theg pa mchog gi snod dang ldan zhing yang dag gi don du sbyangs pa sngon du bsags pa drag po'i stobs dang ldan par gyur pa'i skyes bu skal pa mchog tu gyur pa smon lam gyis bskrun pa'i mthu brtas pa rnams kyi pad tshal bye ba grangs las 'das pa rnams kyi lang tsho bya ba'i dus la babs par dgongs te/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa yos kyi lo la babs pa na/ chos kyis mngon par mtho ba'i thog kha gser khang du/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu la/ zab pa'i gting mtha' dpag par mi nus shing*/ rgya che ba'i gsung rab kyi tshig don ma lus shing lus pa med pa/ mnyam med skyob pa rin po che yab sras rnams kyis/ zab pa'i chos su gdams par gyur pa rnams/ zhum pa med par tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis sgrog par mdzad do// lo de nyid la/ khang gsar chen mor nā ro chos drug gi dgun khrid gnang ba'i tshe/ dus la bab par ras pa brgya phrag lhag pas bla yel chen mor ras 'bud mdzad cing*/ rje nyid kyang*/ ras rkyang gi tshul 'dzin pas kun gyis mthong bar drod kyi che ba ngom par mdzad pa'i dga' ston gyi gral du/ rten med nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'thor ba'i nas kyi rdog po kar+ṣa pa na chung shos tsam mang du bab par gyur pa yang*/ thams cad kyis snang bar gyur pa ni rgyal ba rgya mtsho dgyes pa'i mchod sprin gyi me tog 'thor bar mngon no// skabs de tsam na/ hor gyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis zhes bya bas spyan 'dren zhus pa la brten nas*/

rje btsun kun dga'i nyi ma 'di ni 'bab rom dang*/ sgom khyung rong sog la sogs pa'i 'brog sde'i gling bzhi rim par bgrod de/ hor rnams kyis mdun sar phebs pa'i tshe/ der gnas pa kun kyang dad pa'i me tog gsar pa skyes shing*/ sdig pa'i las la 'gyod pas gdungs pa'i dri bzhon gyis/ yid kyi 'dab ma rab tu bskyod bzhin du/ rang rang gi 'byor pa'i bcud kyi bu nor longs spyod gang dag mchis pa kun kyang 'chang 'dzin gyi blo dang bral bas/ rje 'di'i drung du phul bar gyur to// de nas slar yang gdan sa chen po nyid du phebs te/ gdul bya blo ldan pad mo'i tshul bzang gnas shing 'dus pa rnams la/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi 'od zer mngon par spro bar bzhed de/ slar yang yang dgon khang gsar du dgun chos gnang ba'i dus su/ ras pa sum brgya tsam gyis bde drod kyi lang tsho ngom par mdzad pa'i gral dbu la phebs shing*/ de'i tshe yum drung gis khur bzhes pa'i ras ston kyang rgya chen gnang ngo*// de nas slar yang mtshe'u kha bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du gdan chags par gyur te/ mthing shog dri ma med pa'i ngos la/ gser dngul gyi 'bur du bris pa'i gsar rnying gi rgyud sde 'gyur ro cog ma lus pa thams cad zla ba gcig gi nang du yongs su rdzogs par grub cing*/ rab gnas mnga' gsol gyis byin chags par mdzad pa'i nyin/ me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od kyi gur sogs skye bo du ma'i ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur to// de nas slar yang dgon khang gsar du phebs nas/ nges pa don gyi chos kyi 'khor lo gsum pa bskor te/ der 'dus pa phal che bas tshe mtshams dang*/ lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi sgrub pa'i dam bca' phul ba la brten/ da res gling kha dar rgyas rtser bsam gtan khang bu bcu phrag lnga'i grangs ldan dag kyang gsar du 'debs par mdzad pa'i chos 'chad kyi khur 'dzin du/

snying po grub pa'i rnal 'byor bla ma ras chen pa rin chen rgya mtsho dang*/ gling stod smad gnyis char gyi cho ga lag len dang chos spyod ngag 'grig gi slob chung du/ ka bcu ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho rnams bsgrags shing*/ gling smad du'ang bshad pa'i srol chen gtod par mdzad do// de ltar yongs 'dzin kun dga' rgya mtsho ni// nyon mongs rnyog ma'i dri nga ring dor zhing*// rab tu zab cing mtha' bral rgyar yangs chos// snyan brgyud sbu phreng dkar po'i rlabs kyis phyug /sdom gsum gser gyi sdong bu la brten pa'i// tshul khrims rkang 'thung 'dab yangs phyogs su rgyas// nyes gdung tsha zer 'jigs skyob lo ma ni// bser bu'i ngad ldang kun nas g.yo zhing lding*// de ltar kun mtsho'i yon tan rgya mtsho yi// bsngags pa'i sgra dbyangs phyogs kun rgyas par ni// gdul bya rkang drug bung ba'i sgra yis bkram// stod smad bar gyi yul khams kun gnas pa'i// sa skyong sde phran rang rang 'khor bcas kyi// yid kyi ngur pa gdung ba'i lus g.yos te// dngos dang pho nya brtson pa'i gshog rtsal bskyod// zang zing 'byor pa bye ba'i rgyan ldan par// 'dod yon rin chen rgya mtsho'i drung du lhags// zhes pa ltar/ de'i dus su/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum nas kyang*/ rigs rus kyis mngon par mtho ba'i dbon po gnyis sogs 'bul ba'i bye brag du ma dang bcas pa'i phrin las pa dang*/ shel 'bul dpon rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs/ dal du'i pho brang chen po nas lhags par gyur pa'i/ dbon chen brgyad dang grwa pa stong tsam gyis kyang rang rang gi zang zing 'byor pa'i 'bul ba du ma dang bcas drung du sleb par gyur pa'i tshe/ slar yang sgrub sde thar pa'i gru chen nyid du bsam gtan khang bu sum brgya bas mi nyung ba 'debs par bka'i bkod pas khyab par mdzad pa'i rjes su/ 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan rin chen pa'i phyi rten du byang chub chen po'i mchod rten dpangs dang rgyar yangs pa/

gser gdugs gser 'phru dang bcas pa myur du grub pa dang*/ zangs gser gyi rgyu las thub dbang sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dpag tu med pa dang*/ bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i rnam thar sogs/ rgya dang zhing du tha gru yangs pa'i gzhi/ dri ma med pa'i ngos la tshon rtsi bkrag mdangs mchog tu gyur pa dag gis bris par gyur pa'i zhal thang gi rigs byed du ma dang*/ gzhan yang grub chen gong ma rnams kyi bka'i glegs bam grags che ba rnams gan shog la gser dngul gyis bzhengs par gnang ba rnams kyang*/ mthar phyin pa so so'i skabs su/ rab gnas kyis byin chags par mdzad do// yang de yi dus su khams skyo dbon po gnyis kyi thog drangs 'dan ma'i phrin las pa rnams kyang sleb pa'i 'bul ba dang*/ grwa pa brgya tsam gyi gtsug phud kyang bzhes so// de ltar yongs 'dzin dam pa 'di yi phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor ni srid mtha'i bar du mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo kho na nyid do// de nas dus kyi pho nya zhes bya ba rta'i lo la/ gcen po rin chen rnam par rgyal ba sgom pa'i khur bzhes pa dag gi thugs dam du byams chen gyi sku/ rgyu dang bzo 'bras mchog tu gyur pa bzhengs par gnang ba'i rab gnas kyi gral dbus su spyan drangs pa'i tshe yang*/ ngo mtshar ba'i snang brnyan phul du phyin pa dag gis skye dgu du ma'i yid kyi dga' ston du gyur to// de nas slar yang 'bri gung byang chub kyi gling du phebs te/ bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas bstan pa rin po che'i lam bzang gsal bar mdzad do// de nas lug gi lo la stag lung hor khang pa'i nang so tshe dbang grags pa sku gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu yul tha dad nas 'dus pa'i spo la/ yang nas yang du spyan 'dren zhus pa'i tshe/ rim gyis phebs par gyur pa las/ chos rje dang zhal ngo rnams kyis kyang*/

bsu ba'i bkod pa du ma dang ldan pas mjal bar mdzad cing*/ dus tshes gza' skar 'dzom pa la bla yel chen mor rgol ba dang 'jigs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i khri mchog mngon par mtho ba la/ zhabs kyi pad mo bkod de/ 'dren pa rnams kyi gtso bor bzhugs pa'i drung du/ lha mi'i longs spyod ma lus pa 'dus pa lta bu'i 'byor pa mtha' dag phul bar gyur pa'i tshe/ snga dro'i dus su smon lam rgya mtsho'i sprin phung rab tu 'khrigs shing*/ phyi dro'i thun la bab par zab rgyas kyi chos char kun la snyom par phab ste/ der 'dus pa rnams so sor rang rang gi dad pa'i sa gzhi la/ dge ba'i lo 'bras rab tu 'phel bar gyur to// rje btsun dam pa 'dis kyang*/ zhal ngo rnams la 'bul ba dang dge 'dun byings la mang 'gyed kyi gnang sbyin kyang grub par mdzad de/ slar 'bri gung du phebs nas/ drag po zhes bya ba lcags pho sprel gyi lor/ skyid shod du nad yams bar med mched par gyur pas/ der gnas pa'i sems can kun gdungs shing*/ mkha' las char gyi rgyun kyang chad de ring zhig 'das pas/ lo 'bras kun bsregs par gyur pa'i tshe/ sa skyong don yod rdo rje dpal bzang pos/ rje 'di yi snyan grags don dang ldan par gsan pa la brten/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog yan lag gi rnam par 'phrul pa spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa spyan drangs pa dang mthun par/ rje 'di nyid la nan gyis phebs dgos pa'i pho nya dag gis bar mtshams med par bskul te/ phebs par gyur pa'i lam bar du/ brag dkar gyi rdzong dpon sri chod pas kyang zhabs tog dang 'bul ba dpag tu med pas mchod cing*/ de nas rim gyis 'brom 'brong ?smad glang ra zhes bya bar phebs pa'i gong du/ mi bdag de nyid kyis mngags pa'i/ ja 'dzin gyi pho nya ba dag kyang drung du lhags pa dang mjal te/ ngag gi zhu bar/ da lta dus snyigs ma'i dbang gis/ sems can rnams kyang nyon mongs pa bab col du rang dgar spyad par gyur pa la brten/

dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu mthu dang ldan pa rnams kyang bag med pa'i dbang gis srung ba'i dus las yol te/ rgyal khams byings dang khyad par yul gru 'di kun la nad yams kyi 'tshe ba chen pos 'gro ba kun la mnar bar gyur zhing*/ char gyi rgyun kyang chad nas ring zhig song ste/ mu ge'i bskal chen gyi 'jigs pa chen pos nyen par gyur pa la/ rgyal dbang skyob pa gnyis pa khyod kyi thugs rje chen po'i gzigs pa mchog gis rjes su bzung du gsol zhes sogs gnad la dbab pa'i zhu ba mang du phul bas/ rje btsun dam pa 'dis kyang*/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phrin las bcol zhing*/ klu chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la rang rang gi yid dang 'tsham pa'i 'dod yon dag gis tshim par mdzad pa'i mod la phrin las bsgrubs pa'i tshul tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ de lta'i rgyal dbang kun dga'i nyi ma des// thugs rje'i zer gyis bskul ba'i klu dbang tshogs// yid kyi pad mo dga' ba'i ze'u 'bru dgod// gus pa'i 'dab ma brkyangs shing thal mo sbyor// dus las yol ba'i rlung chen kun 'khor bas// phyogs su gnas pa'i sprin tshogs zhing der 'dus// nam mkha' sngo bsangs 'tsher ba'i gdungs byed ni// dkar bsil mdog can bkra ba'i yol ba bres// de las gnag pa'i chu khur bzhon pa ni// 'brug gi sgra chen drag med dal bus sgrog /glog gi phreng ba g.yo ba'i lcags kyus ni// char 'dod skye bo'i yid nas 'dzin pa bzhin// de rjes dal bar 'bab pa'i char rgyun ni// bar med zim bur g.yo ba'i sgra ldan pas// lo ma 'bras bu rang rang gnas las ldang*// de las nad yams bdag po bgegs tshogs kun// sdig ldan yid kyi sbrang bu yul gzhan bros// mdor na sa phyogs der gnas srog chags kun// re ba'i chu snod don ldan bcud kyis gtams// zhes pa ltar/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyi thugs rjes dang mthu thogs pa med pa'i dpal gyis/
