dbu skra gzhan dag kha dog dbyibs mtshungs su byas pa phyag tu phul ba la ma nor bar ngos 'dzin gnang zhing*/ rje rang byung pa'i rnam thar dang*/ zhabs drung gi rnam thar thor bu pa gnyis phyag tu phul te/ ngos 'dzin zhus pa na/ ma 'dres par tha dad du na bza'i phyi nas ngos 'dzin mdzad/ gzhan yang bdag cag rnams kyis kyang sngon rje drung gong ma mjal myong ba'i dge slong rin chen bkra shis sku mdun du btang ba dgyes pa'i rnam pa dang*/ spyan gyis gzigs nan che ba mdzad cing*/ zhal gyi mdzod spu'i mtshan yang mthong ba byung 'dug rgya ston nas bya bral ba'i tshul can sbrel pos mjal bar slebs pa na/ gsol ras gnang zhing*/ karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho dang*/ spyan snga ba rin po che gnyis kyi bka' shog so sor ngos 'dzin mdzad/ de nas phag lo zla ba lnga pa'i nang du/ zhabs drung gong ma'i dben gnas chu mig lung du phebs pa na'ang*/ dge mtshan gyi ltas dang bcas/ re zhig mchod rten rnams la zhabs skor gnang ba'i tshe/ mchod rten rnying pa gnyis la zhabs bskor gnang zhing*/ gsar bu rnams la gdan drangs kyang bskor ba mi gnang ngo*// de nas sna mor chab tshan khar gzim gur phub pa la/ 'di sngar shul de kha yin par 'dug gsungs ngos 'dzin gnang*/ de nas phag lo zla ba drug pa'i nang du yangs pa can du phebs pa'i dus/ chu sbug tu bzhag pa gnang ba na/ zhal nas bdag la rta gling bzhi nor bu dang*/ gling bzhi kun dga' zer ba yod gsungs/ sngon gyi bka' stsal mang bar phebs 'dug cing*/ rim gyis yangs pa can nye ba na/ chos rje mkhan chen pas thog drangs gzhis byes kyis bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas/ glas tshor mjal ba'i tshe/ sgom chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba ngos 'dzin gnang*/ der phebs pa'i bsu ba pa rnams la'ang shin tu dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dpag tu med pa mdzad/ nam mkha' dwangs shing nyi ma la 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa/

me tog gi char sogs dge legs kyi ltas du ma dang lhan cig par dpal bde chen yangs pa can gyi chos gra chen por phebs pa'i nyin nas bzung*/ mchod khang so sor gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ sngon du dngul gdung rin po che la phyag nas 'thor ba gnang zh-ing*/ slad nas phyag gnang ba dang*/ gzhan yang ston pa sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung*/ mu tig dmar po'i mchod rten/ jo bo rje'i zhal thang shangs tshal ma/ gzims chung du bzhugs yul/ zhabs drung gong ma'i dbu skra bsil pa rnams slob dpon sam bha dra dang*/ bhak+ṣi rat+na shrī dz+wa la sogs la ngos bzung ba'i bka' lung gsal bar thos pa dang*/ slar yang bla ma lha khang du slob dpon dge bzang pas/ zhabs drung grub thob nyi ma sbas pa yin par grags nas/ de'i sku 'dra gang yin zhus pas/ 'di yin zhes phyag mdzub kyis gsal bar gnang*/ yang thugs 'ur ba'i skabs shig na zhal nas/ nga zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa yin/ nga la zhwa dmar ser mdongs gnyis dang*/ shel tham gser tham 'bar bam yod pa sogs khyer nas gdan sa mthil la 'gro ba yin/ rta sngo chen khrid shog gsung ba dang*/ skabs shig tu 'og min du phebs te sngar gyi sgom khang 'bubs pa dang*/ mchod gral du 'gro ba'i mgon po dang*/ rje yid bzang rtse pa/ stag lung ngag gi dbang po/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyi sku rnams ngos 'dzin mdzad cing*/ khyad par 'gro mgon gyi sku la thugs rtsis che bar mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang rgyun ldan du/ rdo rje 'chang nas bzung*/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma spyi dang*/ bye brag tu sku skye gong ma rnams la gsol 'debs kyang ma chags par gnang ngo*// yang yum gyi gsol ba mdzad pa'i dus shig a ma dang rgyal po in+t+ra bu dhi gsol ba lhan du mdzad kyin 'dug gsungs/ yang dgong kha spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas/ a ma shākya thub pa ya gi na bzhugs 'dug mthong e byung gsungs nas phyag mdzub kyis ston par gnang ba dang*/

yang nyin gcig yum la/ a ma gdan sa mthil na rdo leb chen po zhig yod pa/ de'i khar khri brtsigs nas ngas chos mang po bshad dgos pa yod gsungs*/ yang zla ba bcu pa'i nyer gcig rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i nyin/ bum pa'i nang du bdun phrag bzhi'i bar du bsdad/ de'i dus/ 'khor ba rnams kyi lcags sgyed btsugs nas e btang*/ 'chi ma ston/ phyogs kyi sgo rnams bcad de bsdad 'dug pa la/ me tog gi char chen po phabs pa yin gsungs/ de nas hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gnyis kyi nyin/ kong po nas tsha bo mgon po byung ba dang mjal ba na/ khong gis bdag yid ches pa'i rtags shig gnang dgos zhus pa'i tshe/ mgo thog der ga nas byung cha med par shog dril chung ngu zhig 'dug pa mdun du ril ba la phyag mdzub btang nas nya ra gyis gsungs ba la zhal phye nas ltas pas/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pas gnam ?rnam thos kyi ri bor bris/ zhes pa gsal bar byung pa la yid ches nas/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po dang ldan no// gzhan yang de dus su mi re'i mdun du phebs nas/ rnam rtog chos sku yin nam/ min zhes gsung ba dang*/ sems nyid chos sku 'gyur ba med/ de yin nam min gsung ba dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma gong ma dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems bstan srung chos skyong sogs kyi bstod pa ni rang shugs kyi thugs su byon zhing 'bad med du gsung ngo*// de nas kun 'dzin zhes bya ba'i sa pho byi ba'i lo dgung lo bzhi bzhes pa/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nyer gcig gi nyin/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo su yi sprul// sprul pa chen po sku yi bdag /ces lan mang du gsungs shing 'di nga'i rtsom pa yin gsungs/ de'i phyi nyin sgrub mchod pa rnams la gzigs te/ dus 'khor gyi gral dbu la 'gro ba yin gsungs kyang*/ sku na phra bas gdan 'dren ma nus/ rjes su dkyil 'khor gzigs mo la phebs pa na/ dkyil 'khor yang re legs byung 'dug gsung ba dang*/

bzhugs khri'i khar phebs nas phyag ḍaṃ dang phyag dril yang phyag tu bzhes nas dkrol ba gnang*/ 'di nga'i yin gsung nas ngos 'dzin mdzad dus sngon gyi dkrol lugs ji lta ba gnang*/ dge slong rgyal bzang bas/ zhabs drung sku skye gong ma rnams kyi bstod pa kha bton du bgyis pa 'di su'i bstod pa yin zhus pas/ 'di nga'i bstod pa yin gsung bas shin tu ngo mtshar bar gyur to// de dag gi skabs re zhig gsung mgur du bstsal ba ni/ a pa mdang gsum rmi lam de// dus da lta'i snang tshul ngo sprod mkhan// mdang dang de ring la khyad med kyang*// yin min yod med kyi 'dzin pa 'khrul// snang tshul ji ltar snang yang rung*// snang ba'i rang babs chos kyi sku// bcos bslad dgag sgrub mi dgos pas// rnal 'byor snang ba'i steng nas bde// zhes gsungs/ yang tshes bco lnga'i nam sod cig pa'i ne seng gcig gi ??dus sku rdzi dbang phyug bkra shis pas/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs shig byas pa na/ spyan chab mang du gnang ba la ci yin zhus pas/ rdo rje 'chang gi sku zhig mthong ba yin gsungs/ de kha'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin/ ka gzhi mar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ spyan nam mkha' la gzigs nas/ sku gzhog na drung yig pa yod pa la/ ya gi na nor bu rin po che 'od 'bar ba zhig 'dug gsungs/ yang skabs shig phyag dpe bas mkha' spyod glu phreng klog glog ?pa gsan te/ spyan chab mang du phyung zhing*/ sngon gyi skye ba dran skyo ba skyes pa yin zhes gsungs/ de nas dgung lo lnga bzhes pa 'gal ba zhes bya ba sa mo glang gi lo hor zla lnga pa'i nang du/ stag lung du dbu skra bsil bar thegs pa gnang ba'i tshe/ tshes brgyad kyi nyin spag mda' bye dkar du/ stag lung chos rjes bsu bar phebs pa dang mjal thog stag lung chos rjes tshur phyag 'bul ma mdzad gong*/ phyag lan mi gnang zhing*/ phyag dang po song rjes phyag lan kyang ji lta ba gnang ba dang*/

mjal dar brje ba sogs sngon gyi dus kho na ltar gyur pa/ ya mtshan gyi gnas kho na ltar gyur to// zla ba de'i ngo bcu gza' lhag pa dang*/ skar ma sa ri sbyor ba grub pa/ byed pa ga dza ra dang ldan pa'i nyin mor byed pa gnas pa'i dus der sgar du chos rje rin po che phebs/ dbu skra bsil dus bdag gi bla ma rnam rgyal grags pa khyed/ zhing 'dir rtag tu bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang de'i nyin/ lhag pa'i lha du ma'i mngon rtogs dang*/ snyan dngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i mtshan nas brjod pa'i smon lam sogs mang du gnang bas/ der gnas pa kun ya mtshan zhing bstod pa'i gnas su gyur to// de rjes stag lung gi gling rin po che mdzes par byed pa'i rgyal khams pa spyi pas dgong ja'i bur ston la gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ zhabs drung gong mas bzhes pa'i dbu zhwa zhig sku rdzis phyag tu phul bas/ 'di nga rang gi sngar gyi zhwa yin par 'dug gsung zhing*/ pha rin po che'i sku 'dra zhabs rjes ma la ngos 'dzin gnang*/ rjes su dge rgan rta mchog dang*/ dkon gnyer dpon dkon rgyal la ngos 'dzin mdzad cing*/ gsol ras yang gnang*/ bzhugs gral grol rjes zhal nas/ a tsa ma 'khor ba 'di rnams snying re rje/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub gyur cig gsungs/ slar stod lung bde chen gyi lcang khrod du sgar mdzad nas bzhugs thog sprul skur grags pa khyod la 'dud// 'phrin las 'od 'bar khyod la 'dud// 'dzam gling grags pa khyod la 'dud// ces gsungs/ de nas yangs pa can du phebs nas dngul gdung drung du gzims pa'i rnal lam du/ mi dkar po ral gri 'dzin pa gcig gis/ khyod yang 'jam dbyangs yin/ nga yang 'jam dbyangs yin zhes gsung ba dang*/ yang gzims chung rin chen bkod par gnang ba'i nub cig rnal lam du/ mi nag po zhig gi rta 'ol ba zhig phul ba chibs ma thag de nyid chibs kha byas nas rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga yin zhes par phebs te/

brgyad stong pa'i po ti phul ba bsnams nas yangs pa can du phebs pa dang*/ yang ch-ibs dang chibs kha de nyid kyis byas nas gdan sa mthil du phebs nas/ de yang zhabs drung gong ba'i rnam thar yin zhes po ti gcig phul ba dang*/ de nyid las rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi gnas yin zer phebs pa na/ sku skye gong ma zhig gis rnam thar yin zhes dpe phul ba sogs byung ba'i skabs su mnal sad pa'i tshul bstan/ de nas skabs shig drung gnas phyag mdzod pa dpon slob kong por theg pa gdong dbon po spyod pa rgyal zhes pa la shis brjod kyi thugs rtsom gsar pa zhig 'phral du gnang dgos zhes zhus pa la/ de ma thag tu zhal nas/ gsang sngags brgyud pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ dngos grub mchog gi bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas byin rlabs dpag med pas// rin chen mchog gi bkra shis shog /sprul sku'i byin rlabs sngags pa yis// rin chen brtan pa'i bkra shis shog /chos nyid zab mo las byung ba'i// mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes bya ba gsungs/ yang dngul gdung rin po che la zhabs skor gnang ba'i dus shig dngul gdung la dbu dpral sbyar nas spyan chab byung pa la/ khang dpon gyis ji ltar lags zhus pas/ sngon gyi skye ba dran pa yin gsungs/ yang skabs shig skye med kyi don rtogs/ 'gag med kyi stsal 'byongs/ snying rje'i ngo bo nyid de yin no// zhes dang*/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su 'dres// ye shes thams cad de la 'dus// zhes dang*/ chos sku spros bral dag pa la// longs sku sgyu ma'i skur ston pa// zhes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge min/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge yin// yin kyang yin la min kyang min// de ston la shog /ces kyal ka'i tshul rang byon kho nar stsal lo// de nas rnam 'gyur zhes bya ba lcags pho stag gi lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du chos rje mkhan chen pa la/ dus 'khor gyi dbang gsan pa'i tshe/

gzims chung rin chen bkod par sna tshogs yum gser mdog gi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul ba'i 'od gsal gyi rtsal yang shar ro// de 'og dga' ba zhes bya ba chu mo 'brug lo'i tshes bco lnga zhig gi nam phyed la gzims chung de nyid du/ zhing skyong smug po rta nag la chibs pa'i zhal nas/ 'di ni log par lta ba rnams la ma smra zhes zer/ yang gnas de nyid du mgon po bya rog gdong gis kha btags dkar po dri ma med pa phyag tu phul te/ legs nyes kyi lung ston pa'i tshul dang*/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan yan lag 'byung phyag na lhung bzed dang*/ dar sham bsnams pa'i zhal nas/ bu khyod 'chi bdag las rgyal te/ kong po smad kyi phyogs su ni/ bu'i bstan pa dar ba yin/ zhes pa dang 'phags pa gser be'u/ phyag na dpal be'u dang*/ dung 'dzin pa zhal gzigs/ lo de nyid la gong ma mi'i dbang po chen po dang*/ nor bu sgang du mjal ba'i tshe/ zhing skyong dbang po 'khor bcas kyang*/ skya rags bsgrigs pa'i tshul gyis mjal 'dzom ma grub bar la mtha' bskor nas bzhugs pa gzigs/ de nas dga' ba zhes bya chu pho 'brug gi lo'i tshes brgyad kyi dus shig gzims chung 'phrul dgar/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa blos bslangs kyi tshul du gzigs/ de 'og rnam rgyal zhes bya ba chu mo sbrul gyi lo dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i hor zla gsum pa'i nang du/ gzhis kha bde chen gyi phun tshogs bkod par rgyal chen rnam thos sras/ sku mdog gser btso ma'i gser ltar bzang zhing*/ bzhon pa spangs pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ne'u le 'dzin pa zhal gzigs/ de nas zla ba lnga pa'i nang du/ yangs pa can du phebs pa gnang nas/ gzims chung 'phrul dgar gnang ba na/ mgon po ber nag can na bza' gser ma'i ber sum brtsegs bzhes pa zhal gzigs/ de nas rgyal ba zhes bya shing pho rta'i lo hor zla dang po'i tshes brgyad la/

yangs pa can nas chibs kha bsgyur te/ bde chen gzhis khar phebs nas/ zla ba de'i phyi ma'i tshes lnga la phun tshogs bkod du/ dzam bha la gser mdog phyag gnyis nyi zla 'dzin pa zhal gzigs/ de nas mi 'gyang bar chu mig lung du phebs/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin lcang gseb du bzhugs pa'i dus/ spyan nam mkha' la yun ring du gzigs pa'i tshe/ sku mdun der dge slong sangs rgyas rgyal po zhes bya ba 'khod pas ji ltar lags zhus dus/ da res nyi ma'i thad 'od zer gyi rtse la/ phag mo mkha' spyod ma phyag na me tog dang dril bu g.yer kha bsres pa'i 'phreng ba thogs pa zhig byung nas/ bdag la thim pa'i snang ba byung*/ zhes gsungs/ de nyid nas/ slar bde chen lcang khrod du sgar gnang nas bzhugs pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin mo/ dpal ldan lha mo rang byung rgyal mo phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis me long dang thod pa/ 'og ma gnyis ral gri dang shak+ti 'dzin pa/ 'ja' sprin gyi rnal ma'i bya la chibs pa dang dag gis dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas g.yas su bskor ba lan gsum mdzad pa gzigs slar gnas de nyid kyi skyed tshal 'bab chu'i 'gram/ stegs bu'i steng du bzhugs pa na/ sku mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' sprin kha dog gsum ldan la gnas pa'i dbus su/ dbus ma dkar po/ g.yas su pra ta ra ser po/ g.yon du ma ta ra sngon po/ de gsum gyi yar snar pad ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa dang ldan pa'i dbus ma'i steng gi dbus su/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod dbang po phyag gnyis shes rab kyi be bum bsnams pa la/ til+li nā ro/ mar pa mi la bzhis bskor ba'i zhal nas/ shes rab phul tu phyin pa yis// 'di nas 'phos nas rgya nag yul// dkon ting gur shrī'i las kha len// skye bo rnams la chos ston byed// rgyal po'i mgo la bum pa 'jog /sgrol ma dkar mo dngos su mjal// 'bar ba gsal ba glog 'khyug byed// de nas tshe'i dus byas te// bal bod mtshams su skye ba len// seng ge 'dra ba gangs khrod 'grim// phyag rgya che la rtsed mo rtse// mkha' la rgod ltar 'phur bar byed// ces gsungs pa la/

lan phul ba/ e ma bla ma dkyil 'khor dbyer med la// mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs// sprang po nga la byin gyis rlobs// sgrub pa'i bstan pa dar bar mdzod// ces gsol bas/ 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim/ bla ma nyid kyang dbus ma la thim/ de yang 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur to// pra ta ra pad+ma can dang bcas pa'i steng du/ tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag na tshe'i bum pa bsnams pa/ bya rgyud kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zhal nas/ nga ni tshe dpag med pa yin/ bu yi 'chi bdag nga yis bcom// bu khyod bde bar gnas gyur cig oṃ a pri ḍaṃ/ snyigs ma thams cad nga'i 'dul// bu khyod nad las thar bar byed// bskal ba stong du 'phel gyur cig /oṃ h+ya ya gh+ri wa hūm̐/ nga ni shes rab 'phel ba'i lha// tshe ring nad med bde ba yis/ khyod la shes rab ldan par gyur// tsaṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ sbrul nas sprel gyi bar la ni// rin chen chaus kyi ming 'dzin pas/ brgya 'bul phun sum tshogs pa 'byung*// chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor// bu yis de ltar go bar gyis// zhes pa lan gsol pa/ a sprang pos rdo rje'i lus ni thob// rma bya lta bu'i nyams gcig shar// mgon po khyod dang 'bral med shog /ces zhus pas/ 'khor rnams pra ta ra la thim/ pra ta ra yang gtso bo la thim/ de nyid kyang nā da phra mo'i rnam pas mi dmigs par gyur to// g.yon ma ta ra pad+ma bcas pa'i steng du/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa la chos skyong srung ma du ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i zhal nas bu khyod kyi dgra bgegs ngas ni bsgral// bar chad sel ba'i lha mchog yin// mi mthun phyogs las rgyal gyur cig /zhes gsung pa la/ lan phul ba/ re sa gzhan na med pa yi// bla ma mgon po dbyer med la// mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs// zhes gsol ba na de nyid 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ ma ta ra rnams kyang mi snang bar gyur pa'i mod la/

gnas de nas 'od zer kha dog dkar dmar mthing kha'i rnam pa bun bun byung ste sku la thim par gyur to// de nas zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad la bzhugs yul ka drug mar spo ba gnang ba'i tshe gnas de nyid du gnod sbyin kra ma hri phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang*/ 'og ma gnyis beng bsnams pa dang*/ las mgon spu tra phyag gis thod pa 'dzin pa gzigs so// de 'og myos byed ces bya ba lug gi lo hor zla lnga pa'i nang du/ yangs pa can du phebs/ zla ba drug gi bar du bzhugs shing*/ slar zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la yangs pa can nas bteg chu sbug tu phebs pa'i nyin/ dom ra 'phrang gi thang gi nam mkha' na bun thibs pa'i dkyil du/ grub chen til+li sku mdog dkar po g.yas sa gnon mdzad pa'i dkyil mdzub kyis nya'i sked nas bzung ba'i gru khug tu hūm̐ rang byon yod pa/ phyag g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa'i steng du mu men gyi thod gzugs zhos bkang ba'i nang du/ rin po che'i skyogs kha dog lnga ldan dang*/ zung du 'brel ba bsnams pa/ dbu skra spyi bor bcings pa'i skra bseb du glegs bam dang*/ dgyes rdor gyi bris sku'i rnam pas brgyan/ rus pa'i sgom thag gsol ba/ 16711935(chad)00000000bsnol can/ dar gyi smad g.yogs dang ldan pa'i zhabs phyed skyil du bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su rje btsun nā ro pa phyag g.yas pad+mas mtshan pa'i rdo rje snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thod pa lcang lo can bsnams pa'i lcang los sku smad khebs pa/ sku li kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dar gyi na bza' dra phyed ris su+u gsol ba'i bar bar gyi sne nas dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol ba/ zhabs phyed skyil can/ shing n+ya gro ta'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ g.yon du mar pa phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon pad mas mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ srid pa spyi lugs kyi na bza' bzhes pa/ zhabs phyed skyil gyis bzhugs pa/

rgyab tu sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon thugs kar mtheb mdzub kyi ut+pal bsnams pa/ g.yas skor gyi mgul la lan gsum mdzes par 'khril zhing*/ dbu'i steng gi nam mkhar 'dab ma dang bcas pa'i me tog gi ge sar rab tu g.yo ba can gyes pa'i dbus su/ nor bu in+t+ra ni la'i mdog can 'od zer cher 'bar bas spras pa/ mdun du chos skyong ma hā kā la phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi btegs cing*/ gnyis pa gnyis gri gug dang mi mgo 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis rkang gling la dar nag gi cod pan 'phur ba dang*/ nad skyal bsnams pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis rngams pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thod skam gsum gyis dbu brgyan zhing*/ mgo rlon sna tshogs dang*/ sbrul kha dog lnga'i se ral dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan cha du mas sku la brgyan pa rnams mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gzigs te/ de rnams kyi zhal nas/ ma hā sa ma dhi shu kran+tu gu ru sa ma ya ma hā su kha de na ma te/ zhes gsung zhing*/ til+li pa'i phyag gi bdud rtsi nas skyogs kyis bcus te nyid la phul ba'i thugs snang yun ring bar gyur to// slar yang gdong ngan zhes bya ba me pho spre'u'i dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i dus/ tshes brgyad zhig gi dus phag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma sku mdog ljang gu dang po gnyis kyi gri thod/ 'og ma gnyis nor bu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa gzigs/ lo de nyid kyi zla ba lnga pa la yangs pa can du phebs nas 'phrul dgar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ hor zla drug pa'i tshes lnga la/ thub pa'i dbang po sa gnon dang mnyam gzhag mdzad de bzhugs pa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu ni bstan pa dang*/ zhes pa dang*/ zla ba de'i phyi ma'i tshes gsum la mgon po gur zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas na beng dang*/ g.yon ghun dhe bsnams pa gzigs so// tshes brgyad la bde chen du 'degs par gnang ba'i tshe/

stag mgor dbyangs can ma phyag bzhi ma'i dang po gnyis shes rab kyi po ti dang*/ pi wang rgyud gsum pa/ 'og ma gnyis g.yas pas pi wang bzung zhing*/ g.yon na po ti zhig nyid la phul te 'jam dbyangs kyi yin zhes pa gnang ngo*// lo de nyid las hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin/ ngos cag kyang drung du son pa na/ mtshan ltas kyi dge mtshan du ma ni bkram pa lta bur gyur/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog nyid kyang sngon dus kho na ji lta bas shin tu dgyes pa'i mdangs bstan te/ brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur du mas dbugs phyung zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid la bka'i 'khor lo glegs bam du stsal nas kyang*/ de nyid mtshon par byed pa bla ma bsten tshul lam bzang mi nyams shing snang bar bya ba'i phyir/ thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan gyis rgyud dben pa'i nyams chung bdag lta bu las kyang*/ gdams pa'i rgyun bzhed pa'i thugs kyi dgongs par rang shar de bka' phebs pa na/ rten 'brel gyi sgo mi dman pa'i phyir/ bka' bstsal rgyun du byas te 'bri gung pa'i chos bskor tshang ba/ bka' lung dmar khrid kyi rim pa bar chad sel ba'i zab dgu'i gdams pa/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa gong ma dag gi bka' 'bum bskor/ mkha' 'gro'i snying tig dang yang tig sogs bka' gsar rnying gi gdams pa rnams phul ba na/ lo de nyid kyi hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du bcom ldan 'das ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gdams pa/ yid bzhin nor mchog gi thugs dam gnang ba'i tshe/ nub gsum pa'i tho rangs kyi char rnal sad pa'i gzigs snang la sku mdun gyi thad sor/ rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyi yar snar pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ rdo rje 'chang sku mdog ser po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa'i zhal nas/ bu khyod ma nyal da ni longs// kong po smad kyi phyogs su ni// dung skad gnyis kyi dgon pa 'debs// bu yi bstan pa der dar ro// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// rin chen chos kyi rgyal po zhes// de la gsol ba lam me thob// gsol ba btab na byin rlabs 'byung*// zhes dang*/

dbu ma'i sked pa nas/ pad+ma ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ mar pa sku mdog dmar po lus gnad me thab drug bcings su bzhugs pa'i zhal nas/ ut+pal la yi sgra brnyan gyi// srid pa gsum na lham me ba// ngas ni khyod la byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa dang*/ dbu ma'i rtsa bar/ rje btsun mi la ras pa sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas nyi lde'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'i zhal nas/ sems can rnams la phan pa mang po sgrub par gyur cig ces gsung ste/ mi la'i phyag sor rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ mar pa'i phyag zhabs la thim/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros rdo rje 'chang gi thod par thim/ de las kyang 'od 'phros/ thugs kar thim pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ de nyid kyi thugs khar thim pa rnams gzigs so// yang zla ba de'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin/ sku mdun gyi thad steng gi nam mkhar 'ja' sprin kha dog so sor rtsegs pa'i rim pa lnga la khang brtsegs re res spras pa'i steng ma'i dbus su rdo rje 'chang*/ g.yas su mar pa/ g.yon du mi la ste gtso 'khor gsum mgrin gcig tu/ ka ma la ltar rab tu 'thar// kha ba can du nga ni 'ongs// ga sha yis ni mkha' la 'gro// ngas ni khyed la byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs so// de'i 'og gi khang brtsegs kyi dbus su rdo rje phag mo zhal gcig ma g.yas su zhal gnyis ma/ g.yon du ku ru kul+le/ de'i 'og gi khang brtsegs kyi dbus su rnam sras/ g.yas su dzam+bha la/ g.yon du sngags bdag de'i 'og gi khang brtsegs na/ dbus su phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas su ber nag can/ g.yon du gur/ de rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan spyi dang mthun par bzhugs pa rnams kyi gsung 'gyur sgra gdangs gsal ba dang bcas yun ring du bzhugs pa gsal bar gzigs so// de nas hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin/ bdag cag gis kyang zhabs phyir bgyid de chu sbug tu phebs pa'i nyin/ g.yu thog steng zhes bya ba'i grong gi thad ka'i steng gi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi gru bzhi lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad mu khyud se ral dang bcas pa'i lte bar/

'khor lo'i gdan la dgyes rdor thod pa can yab yum/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma la/ rdo rje rin po che/ pad ma ral gri'i gdan la/ shar du dgyes rdor mtshon cha can phyag drug gi dang po gnyis nyi zla 'dzin cing*/ sku mdog phyag mtshan gzhan dang mthun pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ lan gcig zhus/ maṅgalaṃ/// /

༄༅// snye mor gsal snang byung tshul// snye mo phun tshogs rab brtan du 'dug pa'i dgong dus shig yid 'phyo ba'i ngang nas bltas pa'i dus/ lho phyogs thag shin tu ring pa'i phyogs zhig na/ ri khrod brag phug la sa phibs sbyar ba'i khang chung gi rnam pa yod pa zhig tu/ bla ma bai ha ra zhes pa nye gnas gcig dang bcas 'dug cing*/ de dang mi ring bar sbyin bdag gi yul grong yang yod pa la/ grwa pa de chos bzhin mi spyod cing*/ ya ga sna tshogs sgrog pa la/ bla mas brtse bas bskyangs kyang*/ bla ma la phrag dog skyes te/ mtshon rnon pos bla ma'i snying gar bsnun pa la/ khro ba mi mnga' bzhin/ las 'bras mi myong ba'i smon lam byed pa'i ngang nas thugs 'od gsal chos dbyings su bsdud pa'i snang ba la/ 'od dkar po me long tsam pa zhig bdag gi snying gar thim pa la/ bdag gi snying gar a dkar po zhig tu gyur te/ yun ring du 'khor ba mthong bas/ yid 'byung ba zhig byung zhing*/ de nas yang bltas pas/ bla ma dkrongs zin pa dang nye gnas de la khag byung gi dogs nas des yon bdag rnams bos nas bla ma rang gi rang la gnod pa byas te/ grongs zhes smras pa na/ de dag gis bltas pas/ nye gnas kyis dkrongs par shes nas/ der kho rang la'ang der 'dug pa kun gyis mtshon bsnun te bsad nas/ yon bdag ram bha zhes pa sogs kyis thog drangs rnams kyis bla ma'i sku gdung la mchod pa sogs mthong lags/ lcags pho byi ba'i lo hor zla drug pa'i tshes bco brgyad snga ma la phun tshogs rab brtan gyi gzims khang kun bzang du/ mtshams mal bcad rgya zhig bgyis pa'i nub gnyis pa'i srod thun yol ba la/ mi nag po dar nag gi ral gu gyon pa zhig dang*/ sbrul gyi ga sha can gyi mi dmar po skyes pa dar ma'i chas can dang*/ mi dmar rta dmar can g.yas su mdung dang*/ g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa dang*/ bud med nag mo khrag gi grod pa khyer ba zhig bdag gi mdun du byung ste/

na ning phan phyogs 'di bdag rnams kyis dbang byas te/ ci dgar longs spyod pa zhig yod pa la na ning tshun nas/ khyod kyis dbang byas te/ bdag rnams longs spyod kyang bkren zhing*/ gar phyin pa'i sar khyod kyi pho nya dang srung mas ma sleb pa ma byung bas/ yang na khyod kyang da 'dir ma 'dug par zla ba gsum las mi 'gyang par yul gzhan du song*/ yang na bdag rnams la'ang zas skal dum re sbyin zhes zer ba la/ bdag gis khyed rnams bdud ma mo btsan dang klu'i rigs phyogs 'dir gnas shing*/ mkha' la rgyu ba'i gnod byed du 'dug pa snying rje/ bdag gis byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis kun bde bar bya yi/ deng phyin chad gnod pa dang gdug pa'i sbyor ba ma byed par/ so saur rang rang gi gnas su bde bar 'dug cig ces saugs/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos bshad 'ga' byas pa la/ khong rnams mig 'gros bstun te/ ci yang mi smra bar phyir dengs pa na/ dum tsam song nas mdun nas bdud/ g.yas nas klu/ rgyab nas btsan/ g.yon nas ma mo de rnams kyi gtso byas pa'i dmag gi rigs dpag tu med pa dang*/ thog dang ser ba rbab dang rlung dmar chu dang sa g.yo ba sogs shin tu drag po'i shugs dang ldan pa'i dmag gi dpung lhags te/ pho brang gi mtha' dang steng thams cad du sprin gtib pa tsam byung ba la/ bdag pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyi bskyed rim gyi rnam pa gsal bar bgyis te/ sku la sprul pa'i khro bo grangs med pa spros te/ drag po'i gzir mnan tshar gcod kyi dmigs pa bgyis te/ mthar gang yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang zhig la/ ma rungs pa'i gtso bo bzhi po 'dud pa dang bcas pas/ bdag gi mdun du 'khod nas bdag la cho 'phrul bstan pa la bshags pa'i tshul bgyid cing*/ khong bzhi la gu ru gsang sgrub kyi lung dgos zhes zer ba la/ de'i lung dang*/ bla ma rtsa gsum gyi dbang zhig bgyis pa'i sngags lugs kyis/ gsang mtshan du rdo rje thog rgod rtsal/

rdo rje rlung gshog rtsal/ rdo rje g.yo ba rtsal/ rdo rje bstan ma rnams gsum ming btags/ dam la bzhag nas 'phrin las bsgrub par khas blangs/ rang rang gi gnas su song ba'i snang ba byung ngo*/ ༈ tshes bcu dgu'i nyin mdun gyi sgo mangs rnams bteg pa'i dkar gsal gyi cha thams cad la stong gzugs 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas stong rtsa'i sku'i dbyibs/ de bas kyang mang ba'i nam mkha'i khams thams cad thim 'gags su song ba rnams g.yas phyogs su g.yo ba dang*/ de'i rjes sems dpa'i cha byad can kyang dpag tu med pa gshegs pa dang*/ de'i rjes su sngags kyi lha phyag mang gi rnam pa/ zhal phyag ha cang mi gsal ba mang po yang thogs pa zhig la mthong ngo*// tshes nyi shu'i nub 'khrul snang du kun bzang rang du 'dug pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rin po che las 'phro gling pa nyid sku chas dkar po mdzad phyag phyir nye gnas ma de dang phebs byung nas/ bdag la bka' bkyon pa'i tshul gyis/ kho bos da bar khyod 'ong ngam snyam nas sgug pa yin kyang*/ da dung sleb ma byung snying thag gi ring ba la gsungs nas myur du 'bri gung phyogs su 'gro dgos rgyu'i brda' gnang gin 'dug pa la/ bdag gi da lta phan stod lung dang*/ 'di tshor 'thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan bsed dkrol 'bul gyin 'dug pa la/ da khyod mi 'ong na bdag kyang sgyu lus 'di rgas rang grags 'dug phar phyogs su dam ldan gyi slob mas gsol ba 'debs mkhan ni mi 'dug khong g.yu grong ba rkyang pas sems sems byed par 'dug ste/ mi lag nyung bas phan pa yang ma byung*/ dus snyigs ma'i 'gro phan 'dis kyang tshe'i bar chad min mi yong ba 'dug pas/ nga ni gnas khang gsar pa gcig 'tshol dgos pa 'dug skye ba phyi ma'i mgo 'don khyod la re'o/ khyed sleb tsam byung na/ da dung nged rang gnyis ka la rten 'brel re byed rgyu yod pa yin te gsung*/ rgya ma phyogs rang la thegs pa'i snang ba zhig byung*/

yang nyer gsum gyi nyin/ rang gis rang la bltas tshe sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal zhing bstan pa'i sgor zhugs/ mkhas btsun bzang ba'i bla ma rnams dang mjal/ gdams pa yang phran bu tsam thob/ rang nyams su len zhing gzhan la 'gro phan re'ang yong du re ba la/ skya min ser min gyi lus chas 'di lta bu dang*/ bya bral byas/ gnas nges med du bgrod dgos rgyu la/ sde pa chen po rnams gcig nas gcig rim pa bzhin brgyud pa'i dkor za lugs sam snyam pa'i yi mug cing 'chi ma khong nas 'khrug pa zhig byung bas rkyen byas dum tsam bsnyen sgrub kyang bshol te lus pa'i tshe rje khri srong lde'u btsan yang yin rgyu ba/ res skyob pa rin po che yin rgyu ba'i rgya gar rgyal po'i cha byad can gcig mdun du byon te/ bdag gi sngon gyi skye ba du ma'i skyes rabs du ma gsung ba'i snang bas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad cing*/ khyad par zab chos kyi dpe sgrig dgos pa'i bka' nan kyang phebs pa zhig byung*/ skyes rabs 'dra mang po gcig byung ste/ bris gzhan 'dra bar 'dug lags so/ gcig zhus so/ maṅgalaṃ/// / ༄༅/ dbu skra'i lo rgyus dkyil 'khor gsal rdzogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba la phyag 'tshal lo// ma bcos rang rig rang shar kun byed rgyal po mkha' grol klong yangs bdag gi skye ba'i tshul dang spyod pa'i bye brag ni da lta'i dus 'dir gang zag gang zhig chos dang 'jig rten gyi 'ching ba dam pos dkris shing*/ lta bas bcings pa dag gis lam dman pa rnams sun 'byin zhing*/ nges don yang dag gi snying po la bza' gtad dang bral ba'i rang 'gros gang shar ma bcos ma bslad par bskyang ba la/ gang gi'ang 'ching ba dang bral dgos par bstan pa'i phyir/ dus 'dir spyod pa gang byung du bstan te/ de yang spyir ni/

sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nyid// ces pa ltar/ rang re rnams kyi phung khams skye mched dang bcas pa/ rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor 'di ni rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal rdzogs su ye nas bzhugs par gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa nas gsungs so// de las khyad par bdag gi skra'i lo rgyus zhib par 'khod pa zhig ci nas dgos zhes phebs la/ mi'i dbang po nyid dgyes pa'i phyir du/ rang bzhin brjod par bgyi na/ 'og min bde ba gdal ba ?chen po na// longs spyod sku yi 'gro 'dul ba'i// rig 'dzin ma hā rā dza zhes// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul du bzhugs// de'i thugs rje'i 'od zer las// gling bzhi'i bye brag dpag med du// sprul pa'i rnam pa grangs mang ba// ma nges spyod pa'i tshul du bstan// des na 'das dang ma 'ongs dang*// de lta'i dus gsum rgyal ba rnams// kun 'dus sku'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs// rgyud sde bzhi dang theg pa dgu'i// gsang sngags bye brag ji snyed pa// thams cad gsung gi dkyil 'khor rdzogs// dus gsum dus bzhi dus med kyi// shes dang shes bya'i rnam pa gang*// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs su rdzogs// der ni ston pa dus 'khor dang*// chos dang gnas kyi bye brag kyang*// rang rig byar rdzogs de nyid las// gzhan du g.yos pa rdul tsam med// de ni 'khor ba ltar snang zhing*// mya ngan 'das ltar ston pa dang*// gnyis med snang tshul mtha' yas so// rig pa 'dzin pa chen po de'i// yon tan bgrang zhing gzhal ba ni// bskal par brjod kyang zad mi 'gyur// gnas skabs dbu skra'i cha la'ang*// sku gsum rigs lnga de bzhin gshegs// zhi dang khro bo khro mo dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i// srung ma dam can rgya mtsho ni// ma lus pa yi sku gsung thugs// yon tan 'phrin las bcas par bzhugs// de ni brda' don rtags kyi mtshon// de yang rtse mo skye ba med// bla ma chos sku'i ngo bor bzhugs// sked pa yal ga longs spyod rdzogs// rtsa ba 'gag med sprul pa'i sku// rgyun mi 'chad pas 'gro don byed// de yang dkar ser dmar ljang gnag

/rnam snang rin 'byung 'od dpag med// don yod mi bskyod de bzhin gshegs// sman gyi bla dang mi 'khrug pa// rdo rje sems dpa' 'jam dpal dbyangs// de sogs zhi ba'i lha tshogs ni// bgrang dang gzhal bar mi lang ba'i// lha tshogs dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bzhugs// de bzhin bud+dha badz+ra dang*// rat+na pad+ma karmā sogs// rigs kyi khro bo khro mo yang*// 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gsal// de yi mdangs las chos skyong ba'i// srung ma dam can rgya mtsho yang*// gtso 'khor lhan skyes dpa' bo dang*// dpa' mo gcig pa'i tshul lta bur// thams cad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs// skra yi ngo bo ma 'dres pa// rnam pa sku'i dkyil 'khor la// bkrag mdangs 'od 'bar gsung gi gdangs// rang bzhin brjod bral thugs su chub// gdon bgegs nad gdon zhi ba dang*// tshe dpal longs spyod 'byor pa rgyas// maus bzhis dbang bsdud dgra bgegs 'joms// de ltar yon tan 'phrin las dpal// kun dang ldan par bzhugs pa ste// bdag kyang de'i 'od zer las// don gnyis bsgrub pa'i sgyu lus kyi// phung po 'di la'ang de lta bu'i// rten 'brel cha tsam 'byung ba snyam// rang mthong lags so mi yi bdag ces gab pa dang sgrib pa spangs te// rang nyams chal chol du phul ba 'di ni/ da lta dus snyigs ma'i dbang gis/ gang du yang mi 'phel bar/ nyid rang gi thugs su bstim mo// ak+thaṃ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ ces pa 'di yang snang rtse bas zhus pa'o// lan gcig zhus so/ maṅgalaṃ/// / ༄༅/ rnam thar ji bzhin sgrib bral zhes bya ba yod/ na mo rat+na gu ru pad+ma ka rā ya/ da lta snyigs ma lnga spyod dus 'dir ni// las ngan bsags pa'i sems can tshogs pa las// rigs drug tu kha lhag par myong ba'i rgyu/ khong drang dge sems ldan pa'i bsam sbyor dkon// g.yo khram zol gsog sdig pa'i blo can mang*// des rkyen 'byung rigs sde brgyad cho 'phrul ldang*// dam pa ston pa'i mtshan ldan bla ma la// yid gnyis the tshom dra bas bcings shing dmod/

khong sran can gyi bla ma slob gzugs la// mkhas shing grub pa'i snyan pa phyogs bcur bsgrog /de ltar dam pa dam pa ma yin pa'i// mtshan nyid shes pa'i bsags ldan nyin skar tsam// de dag gis bstan zab rgyas dam chos dang*// chos ltar bcos pa'i chos min log pa'i lam// yang dag yang dag min zhes dpyod ldan dkon// de phyir rgyal sras mi dbang btsun mor bcas// mkhyen rab yangs pa'i spyan bzang sgrib bral bas// bdag cag bstan pa'i sgor zhugs kun la'ang*// snyan mdzes tshig gi rnam par mi gsan par// don ldan drang nges rnam par don dpyad 'tshal// sgos su phyogs kun rgyu ba'i mu to bar// gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa smros phebs don// ji bzhin sgrib bral 'bul ba 'di bzhes 'tshal// sngon bsags kyis thob rigs mthor skyes pa'i mi// ched du dman pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa dang*// ngan sprang dregs pa rgyags pa'i rang mthong can// che khyer ya rabs ngang tshul 'dzin pa gnyis// 'jig rten chos brgyad ngo bor mnyam gyur kyang*// dman cha 'dzin pa drang ba'i rnam thar lags// ngur smrig cha lugs rab byung tshul 'dzin dang*// longs spyod rdzogs chas sna tshogs rgyan 'chang gnyis// dam chos tshul bzhin spyad na bsgrub sla'i phy-ir// gang byung 'chang ba drang ba'i rnam thar lags// sha khrag sdig pa'i zas spangs rdor dkar dang*// gsang sngags nges pa'i gdeng ldan mang sa gnyis// bsag sbyang stobs su gang che ma nges kyang*// gang lcogs bgyid pa drang ba'i rnam thar lags// 'bad pa du mas bsgrubs pa'i ja bzang dang*// sdug bsngal myos par byed pa'i chang btung gnyis// rnal 'byor dam tshig rdzas su ma nges kyang*// dus min mi bsten drang ba'i rnam thar lags// gdug la byams ldan rtsa ltung bshad na'ang*// zhing bcu log par lta ba'i gdug pa can// bstan dang bstan 'dzin khyad gsod ma gtogs pa// mngon spyod mi bgyid drang ba'i rnam thar lags// rang gi bza' btung byin len ma lcogs kyang*// mi yi nor la rku 'phrog gzhogs slong gis// dbang du 'gyur ba'i rlom sems 'bad rtsol can// ma sbyin mi len drang ba'i rnam thar lags// gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba dang*// las ldan 'brel pas bdag gzhan don 'gyur zhing*// lus kyi 'brel pa'i gdul byar gyur na min// mi tshangs mi spyod drang ba'i rnam thar lags// gsang sngags gsang ba'i gnad la reg pa yi// gdul bya yang dag lam la 'god phyir dang*// bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i rgyur 'gyur min// rdzun du mi smra drang ba'i rnam thar lags// gzhan la phan zhing bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur dang*// spang blang gnas la reg pa'i lcag brab phyir// zhi bas ma bstan drang por smra ba las// tshig rtsub mi smra drang ba'i rnam thar lags// sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong zhing spel// gnas dang bsrung la bar gcod log 'dren sde// dbye bskrad gsang sngags 'khor lo'i sbyor ba las// phra ma mi bgyid drang ba'i rnam thar lags// brda' gar phyag rgya glu dang don ldan tshig

/bdag gzhan dge spel sdig spong lam gzud pa'i// chos dang 'jig rten lugs su bshad pa las// ngag kyal spang ba drang ba'i rnam thar lags/ gzhan gyi bde skyid longs spyod snyan grags dang*// 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang kun la yid chags shing*// rang gi dpal 'byor la ni rab sems pa'i// brnab sems mi bgyid drang ba'i rnam thar lags/ lan gcig zhus so/ maṅgalaṃ/// /

༄༅/ dag snang mkhar thog ma zhes bya ba cung zad ma tshang ba'i 'phro/ na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki nī ye/ sprang ban rat+na'i ming can bdag gis rang lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi lon pa chu pho 'brug lo hor zla bcu pa'i nyer bdun gyi nub khar thog gzhis khar gnas pa'i tshe 'khrul pa'i rmi lam du/ bdag nyid kyi lus 'di lo lnga bcu tsam lon pa'i na tshod la/ ral pa se bo rked sor grol ba la dar tshon sna lnga'i tshe skra 'chang ba/ ring 'gag dang sham thabs dkar po gyon pa la/ ska rags rgya ma'i dgrad bcings byas pa'i khrod du/ lcags phur sor brgyad pa dang*/ rwa dung btsugs pa/ skra'i la ba nag po'i steng gos gyon cing*/ ru rak+ṣa'i 'phreng ba 'dren pa zhig tu gyur pa/ grogs zhig dang sdebs te song ba las/ me ri 'bar ba yin zer ba'i dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba/ phyogs bzhir so phag gi rwa ba dbyibs zhi rgyas dbang drag gi tshul du yod pa la/ de dag gi bar bar du dug sbrul gcig gcig la 'khril ba'i shing sdong 'dra ba kha nas rlangs pa byung ba rnams dud pa 'thul ba lta bu dang*/ mi yi keng rus ri bo ltar spungs pa'i khrod du tshang bcas pa'i dur phag dang lce spyang ma bu ltar 'dres te/ phyogs kun tu snom zhing rgyug pa dag gis gang ba/ mgo med pa dang*/ lus phyed zos pa dang*/ nang khrol 'thor ba dang*/ sbram sor gnas pa'i ro yi tshogs la lding ba'i bya rnams ni khrag gi mdog can/ mchu dang sder mo gnam lcags lta bur 'bar bas gtibs pa/ mi ma yin gtum po rgyu ba'i rjes su 'brang ba'i me yis 'phreng ba kun tu rgyug pa/ ro langs 'tshogs pa'i gar yin zhes pa'i/ phyogs zhig tu 'o dod 'bod pa dang rgod pa'i sgras sa g.yo ba tsam du skad 'byin pa'i nag po zing zing ba dag ni gar byed pa'i rnam pa can/ shar gyi so phag gi rwa ba zlum po'i nang du dong gting med du brus pa mang pos gang ba dag mthong te/ 'dir mi klu'i nad can gyi rigs dang*/

'go nad kyis shi ba'i ro bor na/ rjes su nad mi ldang ste/ zhi ba'i dur khang dkar po zhes bya ba yin zer/ lho phyogs kyi rwa ba gru bzhi pa'i nang du/ khron pa gru bzhi chus gang ba mang du 'dug pa'i thog tu/ lo ma skam po dag bor kyang gting du nub ste/ bying bar gyur pa yang mthong ste/ 'dir ni rgyal po dang mi chen gyi ro bor na/ phyis rigs rgyud mi 'chad cing*/ longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas par 'gyur bas rgyas pa'i dur khang ser po zhes bya'o zer/ nub kyi rwa ba zla gam gyi nang du/ bsreg khang gi rnam pa mang du snang ba dag gi nang du/ du ba med pa'i me phung rang 'bar gyis gtams pa mthong ste/ 'dir ni bla ma che btsun rtogs ldan sngags 'chang gi gdung zhugs la zhen na/ shul gyi gdung dang rgyud 'dzin rnams kyi dbang du/ sangs rgyas kyi chos mdzod mkhyen brtse nus mthu dang srid pa gsum gyi sems can dbang du 'du ste/ dbang gi dur khang zla gam zhes bya ba yin zer/ byang gi rwa ba gru gsum gyi nang du/ sha za'i grong khyer dpag tu med pas gang ba la gnas pa'i/ 'jigs pa'i sgra skad sna tshogs sgrog cing*/ mtshon cha rab tu 'bar ba thogs pa'i 'jigs byed rnams kyis/ gsod pa dang gcod pa'i las la 'jigs pa'i smre sngags dang ngu 'bod 'don pa'i mi rnams kyis gang ba phan tshun du blta zhing 'dar ba'i lus bcings te khrid pa rnams yud tsam re la'ang mang du sgrol nus pa'i mthu rtsal can mthong te/ 'dir ni bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin la 'tshe ba'i gdug pa can thams cad 'di rnams kyis bkug nas gsod cing za bar byed pas na/ gsad pa'i dur khang gru gsum zhes bya ba yin zer/ de thams cad kyi nam mkha' la sprin nag 'khrigs shing*/ 'brug sgra tog tog gis gang bar sgrog pa/ thog dang ser ba yun du 'bab pa zhig snang*/ dur khang de rnams kyi dbus su byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi rnam pa/

shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba dag kyang so phag las grub pa la khro chu'i zhun btab pa bar mtshams med pa la/ seng khri la dod sar phyogs bzhir sgo yod pa/ shar ngos su shel/ lho gser/ nub tu byu ru/ byang du g.yu rnams kyi rdo gcal bkram pa la/ 'gro ba pa mtha' dag gi rigs su gyur pa tshogs ste/ g.yon ngos su bskor ba byed pa zhig snang*/ der bdag cag gnyis kyis shar sgo der zhugs te song ba las/ nang de nyid kyang rgya khyon du yangs par sman gyi sbyor ba du ma bgyi ba'i mi mang po ma ṇi'i sgra sgrog pa'i dbus su/ shel khri la gnas pa'i mi dkar po shel bum thogs pa zhig snang ba la/ 'di ni zhi byed rgyal po zer te/ nad dang sdug bsngal zhi bar byed pa'i sman sbyor ba yin zer/ de nas 'thon te lho sgor song ba las/ nang de yang rgya khyon dang ldan la/ der 'khod pa'i mi rnams kyang*/ dkar gong shel du bsgyur ba dang*/ bab la gser du bsgyur ba dang*/ lcags zangs su bsgyur ba dang*/ mu zi nag po las lcags 'byung ba sogs/ mdor na rin po che'i rigs su bsgyur byed kyi rdzas kyis reg pas de dang der 'gyur ba sogs mig 'phrul ltar ston pa dag gi dbus su/ gser khri la gnas pa'i mi ser po gser gyi sgrom bu thogs pa/ a ra pa tsa'i sgra 'don pa zhig snang*/ 'di ni rgyas byed rgyal po zhes zer te nor dang longs spyod kyi spel bsgyur mkhas pa gcig yin zer/ yang song bas nub sgor zhugs pa las/ nang der ni dbang phyug gi sku'i drung du zla gam dmar po'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye ba la me tog dmar pos mchod cing yungs dkar la sngags btab ste/ gang la reg pa kun dbang du byed pa'i btsun pa'i cha byad can gyi mi mang po dag snang ba kun kyang ma hā de wa'i sgra sgrog pa'i dbus su/ zangs kyi khri la gnas pa'i mi dmar po zangs kyi gri khug 'dzin pa zhig snang*/

'di ni dbang bsdud rgyal po zhes bya ste/ rab tu byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa gcig yin zer/ rgyal po de rnams la so so'i 'phrin las kyi gdams pa re zhus na 'byung rung du snang yang*/ blo la 'char ba zhig ma byung*/ de nas byang sgor song ba las/ bar snang la thog gi char bar med du babs te/ lam du 'gro ba'i skabs ma rnyed pa'i tshe/ gzugs med pa'i bar snang nas/ khyed cag la he ru ka'i rgya yod dam/ der bdag gi grogs de na re/ 'di ni shin tu gnyan pa yin te/ he ru ka'i rgya ma lon par nang du mi btong ba 'dug zer/ de la bdag gi he ru ka'i rgya lon pa la dka' ba ji ltar mchi/ he ru ka gang du bzhugs smras pa'i tshe/ de na re/ rang re da lta rgyu ba'i sa 'di rnams ni/ 'phrin las kyi sgrub 08388863(chad)00000000 seng khri yin/ 'di'i steng gi bang rim gdong chen 'di la chos skyong srung ma ma 'dus pa gcig kyang med par yod/ de'i steng gi bang rim bzhi la rgyud sde bzhi yi lha ma lus pa yod 08388863(chad)00000000 pas/ de'i gtso bor he ru ka bzhugs pa yin/ bre dang chos 'khor rnams la grub chen du ma bzhugs/ gdugs dang nor bu la chos sku dbyings kyi yum chen bzhugs/ de rnams mjal ba'i lam du dka' ba rang mi mchi zer/ 'o na rang re gnyis 'deng byas pas/ da lta song na 'di'i bar chad du 'gro bas/ bdag gis he ru ka'i rgya blangs 'ong gis/ phyis nas gong ma rnams mjal ba'i grogs bdag gis bya'o zer mi snang bar gyur pas/ skad cig de nyid la lag g.yon du gtor ma dmar po zhig khyer/ g.yas su tho chen 'bar ba zhig thogs te byung nas/ gtor ma de bsngos/ tho ba des sgo la lan gsum du brdegs pa las/ sgo rang byer gyur ba'i nang nas/ lan gcig zhus so/ shubhaṃ// ༄༅/ gter yig 'bebs pa'i bskul byang byung tshul lo/ ༈ na mo ghu ru dhā+e wa ḍāk+ki nī ye/ kho bo bya bral gnam lcags me 'bar bdag gis zab gter 'di spyan drangs nas lo 'das rjes zhal phye bas chog pa'i lung bstan yod kyang*/

rang gzhan gyi rkyen gyi ya ga sna tshogs phyogs kun tu sgrog pa cig byung bas bdag kyang gting nas skyo bar byung ste/ dad ldan gyi grwa slob kun gyis nan che bar bskul byung kyang zhal ma phye zhing*/ kha byang gi yi ge 'di nyid gter gnas gzhan zhig tu sba bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa la slar g.yeng ba dang*/ rgyu dal gyi bdag rang gi lag tu lus pa zhig byung ba'i tshe/ glang lo hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la dben gnas 'brong ngur rgyud nas bteg gzim khang tshe'u khar gdan chags pa na/ sde brgyad kyi tshub shin tu che ba nas/ bdag kyang srog rlung gi nad ro rnying pa spar ba 'dra bas/ khams kyang ha cang bde bar ma byung ba'i tshe/ ji ltar yin snyam/ gu ru rin po che la nan gyi gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ tshes bzhi'i dus mal du gnas pa na/ 'khrul pa'i snang ba la/ dam can byis pa gzhon nu'i tshul dang*/ ma mo bud med btsun ma'i gzugs can/ drang srong chen po skyes pa dar ma'i tshul can tshigs bzhi mig gis brgyan pa'i skur bstan pa'i 'khor du 'jig rten dregs pa'i 'khor khrom mang du 'du ba ltar mang ba dang bcas te bdag gi mdun du 'dus byung ba dang*/ drang srong yin rgyu ba'i mi des bdag la 'dud de/ rak+ṣa'i 'phreng ba zhig gtad nas 'di skad zer/ sngon dus smon lam dam bcas bden pa'i mthus// da dus rten 'brel mngon du gyur pas na// zab gter snying po 'phrul gyi yi ge can// gsang ba'i yi ge bstan du med pa'i skor// sang gi dus 'dir bri bar rab tu bskul// zhes zer/ bud med des bse'i sgrom bu snying gi gzugs can gyi rin po che du ma'i phras brgyan pa zhig gtad de 'di skad zer/ gter ston lung bstan dus gnad bcas pa dang*// lnga ldan shog bu kun tu ma grags pa'i// zab yig gnad ldan bskyed rdzogs snying po'i skor// gces pa'i man ngag yang tig nyung ngur bcud// 'di nyid dbye ba'i dus la bab pas na// rtsa gsum srung ma'i thugs dam bskong la spyod// ces zer/

byis pa des/ lcags kyi phur bu zhig gtad de/ 'di skad zer/ 'phrul gyi nor bu rin chen lnga las grub/ kha brgya'i 'og tu yab yum byang sems kyi// ril bu dkar dmar gnyis yod rtsi bcud la// sbyangs te bdud rtsi amṛ ta yi ni// ldem bur bcas pa so sor bkod byas la// lnga ldan shog bu'i steng ngos dung shog la// dung yig bris pa mi gsal rak+ta sku// de yi kun 'gres zhu dag legs byas la// ga pur bcud byug dung shog rim par bshu// de 'og gser shog gser yig de yi 'og /zangs shog zangs yig g.yu shog g.yu y-ig dang*// lcags shog lcags yig gong gis shes par bya// kun bcud mchong gi shog bu snying yig bcas// dag par bshus la shog dril ras ma kun// dong bu'i nang gzhug rin chen lngar bcas te// shel sgo dkar po'i dge bsnyen de la gtaud// gter yig brtson bzung gzhan gyis spyod yul min// zhes zer te kun kyang rang rang gi gnas su song ngo*// mtshan phyed kyi dus su/ mi dkar po lag tu shel dkar gyi 'phreng ba bzung ba zhig gis/ bdag la chang thod phor gang byin te 'di skad zer/ bdag ni bsgo ba dge bsnyen dkar po te// rig 'dzin slob dpon pad+ma rgyal po yi// bka' bsgo ji bzhin dus 'dir bab gyur pas// gter shog ras ma dung bur bcas pa ni// slad nas dung sgo nas gzhal 'og gi phyogs// smon lam gcig pa'i klu rgyal 'khor bcas kyi// don phyir nyams med byin brlabs bcud ldan pa// kun gyi spyod yul ma yin bdag la stsol// zhes zer ba la dam bsres te/ log song ba zhig byung*/ tho rangs kyi dus dag pa'i snang ba 'ga' zhig dang bcas te/ lung bstan bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa kun gyi bka' lung nod pa'i nyams snang du ma zhig byung ba lags/ lan gcig zhus so/ shubhaṃ/// / ༄/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las dag snang gdung sel ut+pa la'i dri bsung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ma hā sarba sid+dhi hūm̐/ rtsa gsum bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// 'chi med rje btsun pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal// rigs 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas 'dud// dbang bskur byin rlobs smin grol dngos grub stsol// de yang rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas de nyid kyi/ thugs kyi dgongs pa nam mkha'i klong ltar mtha' yas shing*/ thugs rje tshad bzung ma mchis pas/ phyi rabs 'gro ba rnams kyi don la dgongs/ bod 'dir zab gter ji snyed cig sbas shing*/ dus dang mthun par skyes bu las ldan so sos spyan drangs te/ gdul bya rnams smin grol la 'god par lung bstan pa bzhin/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar thams cad du/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog rim par byon pa rnams kyi bstan pa rin po che gsal bar mdzad pa mtha' yas pa ni da dung srid mtha'i bar du nyams pa mi mnga' 'o// 'dir sprang po snyoms las pa bdag la'ang*/ rtsa ba gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dag snang cung zad la brten/ gzho stod ti sgro brag dkar gyi tshogs khang yang steng*/ ke ru yang rdzong nam mkha'i phug nas/ zab gter phran bu rnyed de dus gnad dang bstun zhal phye ba las/ sngon chad ma grags pa'i shog bu rigs lnga mthong ba las/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi gdams pa 'di dang mjal ba la/ gter byon gyi skor ni/ them byang du bstan pa ltar dang*/ zhal 'phang la/ dbang byin rlabs rnams rtsa tho tsam las/ gter kha gong ma dag gis kha bkang dgos par 'dug pa la/ chu mo yos lo hor zla drug pa spre'u zla'i tshes bdun nas/ bdag cag mched grogs 'ga' zhig dang bcas ti sgro tshogs khang chen mor bdun phrag gcig mtshams kyi bcad rgya la gnas pa na/ tshes bcu'i nub 'khrul pa'i nyams su/ bdag gi mdun du bud med lnga byung ste/ do nub gu ru rin po che dpon slob tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad kyin yod pas 'dongs zhes zer ba la bdag kyang 'gro ba'i 'dun pas de rnams dang sdebs te phyin pas ci zhig na/

lho nub rnga yab kyi gling yin rgyu ba'i/ yul dang grong khyer chen po phun sum tshogs pa'i bkod pa du mas mdzes shing*/ phyogs thams cad du dur khrod kyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan pas 'jigs shing kyi g.ya' ba/ der gnas pa'i mi thams cad kyang*/ rab tu gtum zhing dpa' ba'i cha byad bgo ba dang rgyan 'phreng thams cad dur khrod kyi chas su yod pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod du ma la bag yangs su spyod cing*/ shin tu bag gro la byin chags pa zhig 'dug pa'i dbus/ ri chen po nor bu'i dbyibs lta bu la/ mchod rten gyi dbang rim lta bur yod pa/ de la lha mi'i rig 'dzin brgyad dang*/ rgya bod kyi rig 'dzin grub thob rjes 'bangs nyer lnga la sogs pa'i bzhugs gnas kyang gtsug lag gi 'phreng bas bskor ba'i bar du/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dang skyed mos tshal rang byung gi mchod rten la sogs pas rab tu mdzes pas brgyan pa/ de'i rtse mo phyi rin po che'i rang bzhin la/ nang thod pa'i pho brang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzhal yas khang gi rnam pa/ dbyibs bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum dang mtshungs pa cig 'dug pa la rim par 'dzegs te song ba las/ gzhal yas khang gi 'og khang gi phyi sgo'i nang du phyin pa na/ skyes pa dang bud med kyi tshogs las byed kyi tshul du snang ba dag gis bsu ba dang phyag dang ldang ba sogs dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du 'dug de nas sgo nang ma de phye te phyin pa na/ gung la slob dpon rin po che yin rgyu ba'i/ gu ru rta phag yab yum gyi sku rgyan cha lugs mngon rtogs ltar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su rigs lnga'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yab yum sku la ma bsgrib bzhin rdzogs pa cig bzhugs 'dug g.yas g.yon thams cad du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ sa dang bar snang thams cad gang ba sprin 'thibs pa ltar 'dug pa la/ sku'i g.yas phyogs dar yol gyi nang du dkyil 'khor dang mchod gtor bshams 'dug

bdag the tshom du gyur te/ 'di ni yi dam gyi skur 'dug 'di'i sngon du bla ma la phyag bya dgos/ gu ru rin po che gang du bzhugs snyam pa'i tshe/ rta mgrin yab yum gyi zhal nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun byed rgyal po bla ma'i sku// bla ma dpal ldan he ru kaḥ /zhes gsung zhing sku lus gar gyi rnam 'gyur du shig shig 'dug pa la/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyang*/ rdo rje'i gar dang glu dbyangs kyi rol mos/ bdag gi snang ba 'di yin gtad med du song ste had de lus pa las/ slar rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad kyang rang snang du ngo shes te/ a ti pu ho/ zhes phyag bgyis pas/ thams cad kyi pra ti dza ho/ zhes lan btab te dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhad pa'i gad rgyang ri bsgyel ba tsam mdzad gin gda'/ bdag ni sngar gnas der sdod myong ba la phyis lo shas yul gzhan du song ste 'khor ba 'dra ba cig byung bas 'di yin med par nyams 'ur ba'i rnam pas shin tu gad mo cher shor/ de nas bu mo lnga po des bdag la cung zad dgyes nyams rang ma yin ngo gnong ba'i tshul du/ gser dang shel dang bye ru dang mu men dang g.yu las grub pa'i/ rin po che dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ ral gri'i gzugs lnga byin te/ de rnams phyag rten du phul ba na/ gu ru yab yum gyi zhal nas/ rin chen sna tshogs kyi 'khor lo de mi 'bul lam gsung ba la/ bu mo lnga po des/ bdag lnga ni las dang mthun pa'i smon lam gyi stabs su mchis pa lags kyang*/ khong nyid 'ching ba dam pos dkris te/ gnas dus kyi rten 'brel ma 'grigs pas/ rin po che'i 'khor lo 'bul rgyu ma mchis/ zhes phyag gsum byas te log song bas/ gu ru rin po che'i zhal nas/ nam mkha'i pad+mo/ nam mkha'i pad+mo/ nam mkha'i pad+mo zhes gsung te/ ci yin ni ma go/ snying drang stong ba zhig byung*/ de nas gdan khri dpag tu med pa 'dug pa rnams la/

rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gong ma rnams bzhugs/ yar 'gyu'i dbus der khri rkang bzhi pa stag 'bol dang gos 'bol mang du brtsegs pa'i steng du/ snam 'phrug dang mon dar la bcos pa'i gos mang po dang*/ rgyal po'i la thod cod pan dang bcas pa 'dug pa bdag gi yin rgyu ba'i lugs byas bsal te der 'khod pa na/ thams cad kyi dgyes pa'i nyams su mdzad kyin gda'/ der bzhugs pa'i tshe dri ba dang len 'don pa'i tshul dang*/ skabs su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i glu gar dang rol dbyangs kyi rnam pa dpag tu med pas mchod kyin 'dug de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad zad mi shes pa dbus der bkram pa'i tshe/ rtsa ba gsum gyi las byang bsdus pa 'di mdzad de/ ga na'i skabs su tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po ma tshang ba med pa bskor te/ tshogs dbang gi skabs su/ byin brlabs bla ma'i gtor dbang sogs dang*/ rtsa ba gsum gyi gtor dbang rnams rim par gnang zhing*/ de'i rjes su dam chos dgongs pa yang zab 'di'i spros bcas dang*/ spros med/ rab tu spros med/ shin tu spros med/ kun tu spros med sogs kyi dbang dang*/ bka' srung kyi gtad rgya smon lam dang bcas pa gnang*/ dbang rdzogs rjes gtso 'khor thams cad kyi bka' gtad rab 'byams du bya'o gsung zhing*/ po ti dang sgrub rdzas thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang*/ nam mkha' las kyang dgongs pa yang zab kyi gdams pa phran bu dang bcas pa'i chos kyi sgra yang rgyun mi 'chad par grags so// de nas lhag ma btang zhing chad mdo bstan skyong rta bro nongs bshags bsdu chog smon lam shis pa brjod/ badz+ra muḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin byings thams cad ni nam mkha' dang sa gzhi bar snang thams cad la gzhal yas khang la thogs pa med par bya ma bu 'phur ba bzhin byon song*/ bdag gi mdun der rgyal po'i cha byad du byas pa'i slob dpon zhig byon te/ dgyes dgyes mdzad pa la/

khyed su yin dris pas/ bdag ni sngon bod yul 'dir khyod kyi pha yin mod/ khri srong lde'u btsan yin te/ snyigs dus gdul bya'i don du mnga' ris paṇa chen du ming grags kyang*/ slob ma dam nyams kyi grib phog na ning sprul pa bsdus te da lta 'dir ma hā gu ru'i zhabs drung du yod pa yin gsung ba la/ pha dang bu 'phrad par ltar gyur te rab tu btud nas zhabs la 'chang*/ mchi ma phyung zhing gsol ba btab pas/ bslab bya zhal gdams shin tu mang bar gnang zhing*/ slar gu ru rin po che'i bzhugs khri'i drung du khrid nas byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshe/ pad+ma 'byung gnas zhi ba'i sku ji lta ba mthong*/ ma hā gu ru rin po ches kyang*/ zhal lta bka' gdams man ngag gi skor shin tu mang bar phebs shing*/ lung bstan gnyis kyang gnang*/ yab sras gnyis kyi shis brjod dang smon lam gnang ste/ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma budha ḍāk+ki dza dzaḥ zhes gsung bas ḍa ki'i bud med lnga po de byung nas bdag khrid de phyir thon pas/ yid skyo ba la tshad med pa'i nga rang 'di gang sdod dam sdod dam snyam pa la/ bud med lnga po des nan gyis khrid de yid shin tu skyo ba'i ngang nas rkang gis phyin pa'i lugs yin kyang skad cig gi tshogs khang chen por 'byor byung ste/ bud med lnga po de gar song cha med do// de ka'i 'phro la thang chad pa dang rkang na ba'i nyams yin rgyu ba la/ da res kyi rkang nad 'di 'byung ste/ sgrib pa dag pa'i rtags su mthong ngo*/ de ltar dag snang 'di nyid kyi phyag bzhes dang*/ gtor byon gyi rtsa tho ji lta bar smin byed dbang las byang gi rim pa rnams go rim ma nor zhing*/ phyag len ma 'khrul bar/ gter kha gong ma'i rgyun bzhin tu sdebs par bgyis pa'o/ e ma snyigs ma'i dus skyes sprang ban rat+na la// 08388863(chad)00000000 gnad zab gdams pa'i snying po lags phyin kyang*// da dus skal dang rtsol bar mi ldan pas// rang gi nyams len brtul zhugs chung ba dang*// dam tshig dad ldan theg chen gsang ba'i spyod// blo la shong ba'i skal ldan nyin skar tsam// drang por smras kyang log ltas gzhan du bsgyur// de phyir chos kyi grol ba'i pha rol na// lta ba log pas rdo rje dmyal ba'i rgyur// nges par mthong phyir gzhung bzhin spyod par dka'// de phyir da ni sems bskyed rgya bskyed de// rang gis nyams su gang lon bgyis pa las// rigs dang chos rgyud nam mkha'i pad+mor mnyam// de phyir blo sna thung zhing sba snyam kyang*// skye bar du mar smon pas mtshams sbyar ba'i// mched grogs rnams kyi yang yang bskul ba las// zhal ngo ma chog bri bar dam bcas lags// dge des 'gro kun 'od lus mngon gyur cig
/maṅga laṃ/ dag snang gdung ba sel byed ut+pa la'i dri bsung zhes bya ba/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis dben gnas 'brong ngur du bris pa'o// lan gcig zhus pa'o/ shubhaṃ/// / (pha10)

༄༅/ gsol 'debs kyi skor rnams las thog mar phyag chen chos drug brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ chos dbyings ris med khyab gdal zhing khams na// rigs kun gtso bo rdo rje 'chang chen dang*// mkha' 'gros rjes bzung pra dz+nyā bha dra'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bu la byin gyis rlobs// ma bcos gnyug ma sems kyi dkyil 'khor na// dngos grub mdzod brnyes mkhas grub nā ro pa// skad gnyis gsang sngags sgra bsgyur mar pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bu la byin gyis rlobs// brjod bral ye nas dag pa'i mkha' klong du// rang gzhan don rdzogs rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*// bka' rgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan sgam po'i zhabs/ gsol ba 'debs so bu la byin gyis rlobs// kun khyab gsal 'grib bral ba'i pho brang na// rgyal bas lung bstan phag mo gru pa dang*// sgrub brgyud bstan rtsa 'jig rten gsum mgon zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bu la byin gyis rlobs// rang bzhin lhun grub chen po'i zhing khams su// bsod nams grags pa rdo rje grags pa'i mtshan// rin chen seng ge grags pa bsod nams la// gsol ba 'debs so bu la byin gyis rlobs// mtha' dbus phyogs lhung bral ba'i dkyil 'khor na// rdo rje rin chen rdo rje rgyal po'i mtshan// chos kyi rgyal po don grub rgyal po'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bu la byin gyis rlobs// kun gsal 'gag med 'od 'phro'i zhing mchog na// nam mkha' rgyal mtshan ngag dbang dh+wa dza'i mtshan// ngag gi dbang dang rat+na'i mtshan can la// gsol ba 'debs so bu la byin gyis rlobs// lhan skyes phyag rgya chen po'i pho brang na// bka' don bstan pa gsal ba'i nyi ma rje// chos kyi rgyal po kun dga'i mtshan can la// gsol ba 'debs so bu la byin gyis rlobs// mchog thun 'phrin las 'bad med rang byung na// yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes rang shar 'di// phyogs 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i phyag chen dang*// chos drug rgyud pa'i gsol ba 'debs 'di ni// bya btang rdo rje dpal 'bar gyi bskul ba las/

sna tshogs rang grol gyis bris pa'o/ ༈ /yang phyag chen chos drug rgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru/ rigs kun gtso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i rigs bskrun til+li'i zhabs// sku gsum mngon gyur mkhas mchog nā ro par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sgra skad rgya mtsho'i mthar son mar pa dang*// rtogs pa mngon gyur rje btsun mi la'i zhabs// gangs can bstan pa'i srog shing sgam po par| |gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rnal 'byor ma yis rjes bzu+ung rdo rje rgyal// klu sgrub gnyis pa 'jig rten gsum mgon zhabs// bstan pa'i gsal byed mkhan chen tshul rdor la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gnyis med rtogs pa mngon gyur sangs rgyas dbon// brgyud 'dzin dam pa'i mchog gyur spyan snga'i zhabs// til+li'i rnam 'phrul rdo rje grags pa la// gsol ba= /thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul thog kha ba// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul grol grags pa bsod nams zhabs// sa ra ha yis rjes bzung rdor rin la// gsol ba= /pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul rdo rje rgyal po dang*// thub bstan rgyas mdzad chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs// grub pa'i gtsug rgyan don grub rgyal po la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// phyogs las rnam rgyal bdag po wang gi mtshan// mi yi dbang po chos rgyal rat+na'i zhabs// phyag rdor sprul sku rat+na dh+wa dza la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rin chen chos kyi rgyal// rgyal dbang gnyis pa mtshungs med kun dga'i zhabs// bstan gnyis srol 'dzin rje btsun rat+na la// gsol ba= /man ngag mdzod 'dzin dpal gyi rgya mtsho dang*// bka' drin 'khor med dharma rā dza'i zhabs// rgyal ba'i gdung 'dzin grags pa'i mtshan can la// gsol ba=

/'dren pa zla med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi// bstan pa'i snying po sdom gsum gnad gcig don| |mngon par gsal mdzad dkon mchog rat+na la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gnas lugs rang grol skye med chos sku las// ma g.yos 'dzin bral longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// gang 'dul der ston chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// phyi ltar 'dul mngon thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dzin// nang ltar byang sems 'gro la bu bzhin brtse// rim gnyis zung 'jug 'phrin las rnam rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags ma lus pa// ma nor thugs chud gzhan la ston par mdzad// skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'phrin las bzang po'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs| |gang gis zab gsang smin grol chos kyi sgor// 'gro kun bla med byang chub 'god mdzad pa// bka' drin sum ldan don grub chos rgyal la// gsol ba 'debs so= /rgyal kun ngo bo phyag na pad dkar 'chang*// 'phrin las bzhi yis mkha' khyab byang grol la// 'god mdzad dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul zhabs| |gsol ba 'debs so= /zab gsang phyag rgya chen po'i gnas lugs don// rgyun bzang nyams med rtag par 'bebs mdzad pa// rang rig mngon gyur chos kyi rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so= /nges don zab mo chos kyi mkha' dbyings las// dam pa'i char gyis lus can skye med par// bkri bar mdzad mkhas chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /rang rig skye med chos sku nam mkha' la// 'gag med rang rtsal longs sku me shel khams// gnyis med 'od zer sprul sku pad+ma'i mtshan// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sgrub brgyud rin chen 'byung ldan khyon yangs su// nges don zab gsang nor bus 'gro kun la// 'dod dgu stsol mdzad dharma dh+wa dza'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs=

/skye med 'od gsal chen po'i klong yangs las| |ma 'gags rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos dbang blo gros la// gsol ba 'debs so= /'jam mgon zur phud lnga pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar// drang nges chos kyis 'gro rnams sgrol mdzad pa// mtshungs med dharma ma ṇi'i mtshan can la| |gsol ba= /snying rje'i lha yi sprul pa'i gar mkhan gyis// 'gro rnams byang chub mchog la 'god mdzad pa// dkon mchog kun 'dus thugs rje nyi ma la// gsol ba 'debs so= /ngo mtshar grub pa'i khyu mchog shrī sing*// gangs can bstan 'gro'i dpal du legs byon pa// rig 'dzin grub dbang nus ldan rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= /spangs rtogs yon tan dus gsum rgyal kun dang*// dbyer med nyid kyang sbas pa'i ngang tshul gyis| |'gro 'dul dpa' bo rje btsun chos skyabs rjer// gsol ba= /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i spyan ras kyis// shes bya kun gzigs don gyi rdo rje 'dzin/ khyab bdag bstan 'dzin chos kyi blo gros la// gsol ba 'debs so= /gshegs bzhud skye 'chi spros mtshan ring spangs kyang*// bsam bzhin skye ba'i sgyu 'phrul rmad po ches| |'gro kun 'dren mdzad zhi ba'i blo gros la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'jam mgon bla ma'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul las// bshad sgrub bstan pa nyi ltar gsal mdzad pa// mtshungs med bstan 'dzin chos kyi 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so= /rang rig mngon gyur rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs| |dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam dkyil 'khor lha// bar chad srung mdzad mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de ltar bka' brgyud yid bzhin nor bu la// gus pas gsol btab dge ba 'dis mtshon te// bdag sogs lus can 'gro ba ma lus kun// mchog thun 'bras bu tshe 'dir thob gyur cig

/ces pa 'di sge kha ba dge slong rin chen bkra shis bskul te bgyis so// ༈ //mos gus dran pa'i gsol 'debs/ ༈ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i yon tan dang*// 'phrin las mkhyen brtse ma lus gcig bsdus shing*// srid gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas zla bral ba// bka' rgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal dbang shākya'i spyan sngar li tsa bi// rgya gar 'phags yul mgon po klu sgrub ces// gangs can ri bo'i khrod 'dir rat+na shrī// yang dag lam ston gsum la gsol ba 'debs// snyigs dus lnga bdo'i bskal khams 'di nyid du// gdul bya 'dul phyir slar yang nyid sprul ba// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun kun dga'i zhabs// mi phyed dad pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs// sngon dus 'phags yul sngags 'chang hūm̐ kā ras// ha ra kha bdud dregs tshogs zil gyis mnan// ma rungs sde brgyad kun gyi srog snying blangs// gsang sngags grub pa brnyes la gsol ba 'debs// chos kyi skyong ba'i rgyal bu dge khrims kyis// sdig spyod skye bo lta ngan srog phral nas// yang dag lam bstan dge spyod mchog tu bsngags// 'jig rten skyong kun bstod la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal rigs las byung bslab gsum 'dzin pa yi// bhik+ṣi legs mthong bden smrar gyur pa'i tshe// 'khor rdzas zang zing 'chil ma bzhin du dor// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// 'phags yul byang phyogs 'dod ldan zhing khams su// shan+ta pra bha rigs sngags 'chang ba'i gtso// dhar+m+ma pā la tsa tur+ha ṣ+ta la// grub brnyes rig pa 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs// bod yul kha ba ri yi ljongs dbus su// lha sras mu tig btsan po dge ba'i dpal// bstan gnyis skyong mkhas mtha' bzhi dbang du bsdus// mtshan ldan chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs// mdo khams yul du lha rigs rin chen rgyal// rgyal dbang skyob pa'i chos mdzod kun gyi bdag
