med dam chos bdud rtsi'i dpal spyod cing*/

sa*/lam spangs rtogs yon tan mthar phyin nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang gi myur thob shog ces mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad 'di ni/ mched grogs kyis bskul zhing*/ rang nyid dad mos kyi gdung ba dang bcas pas/ 'bri gung pa rat+nas gter sgrom brag dkar gyi 'dabs su bris pa'o/ ༈ dge slong ngag dbang rin chen gyis bskul ba'i bla ma'i bstod pa/ ༈ na mo ru rak+ṣa ye/ rgyal ba'i bka' lung mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i don// lung dang rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa mthar son zhing*// srung ma dam can rgya mtsho bran khol ba// yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// chos kun dri med mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor cher// rab dga' la sogs sa lam gzugs brnyan rdzogs// don gnyis 'od zer bzang po'i 'phrin las can// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// skye ba kun tu dam pa khyed nyid kyis/ rjes bzung rdo rje theg pa'i nges don gyis// smin grol bskyed rdzogs dgongs pa mthar phyin te// kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang myur bgrod shog /ces pa 'di nyid dge slong ngag dbang rin chen gyis bskul khong rang gi bzhed par ltar/ bla ma'i mtshan dpe'i smon lam dang bcas te/ 'bri gung pa rat+nas gnas chen gter sgrom brag dkar gyi 'dabs su bris pa'o/ ༈ gu ru drag po brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos sku'i ston pa snang mtha' 'od dpag med// longs spyod rdzogs sku 'phags pa thugs rje che// sprul sku thod 'phreng zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// zab gter bdag po mkhas grub pad+ma gling*// rgyal ba'i sras po mchog ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// rje btsun mnyam med bdud 'joms rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// snyigs dus 'dren mchog kun dga' dpal bzang dang*// grub pa'i dbang phyug tshe 'phel bzang po'i zhabs// yongs 'dzin dam pa rje btsun rat+na la// gsol ba 'debs so smin grol dngos grub stsol// zhes pa 'di gu ru drag po sku rjes rdo rje brag logs ma'i dbang lung gi brgyud gsol 'debs su/

rang re'i bstan 'dzin lak+ṣ+mi kīrtis bskul ba las/ bya bral rat+nas 'bri gung spro lung du bris pa'o/ ༈ bla ma o rgyan gling pas bskul ba'i bstod pa sh+lo ka gcig pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi rin chen mdzod// 'gro ba'i re ba bskong ba'i phun tshogs nor// legs par stsol la ngal med chos kyi gter// dpal ldan mtshungs med rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ ༈ bla ma khro phu bas bskul ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam/ ༈ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i rin chen gter// ma lus 'gro la phun tshogs 'bras stsol ba// rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pad la// bla med byang chub mchog bar gsol ba 'debs// ma 'ongs rab 'byams mngon dga'i zhing mchog der// de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba klong yangs tshe// bdag nyid 'khor gyi thog mar rab bzhugs nas// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du 'gyur bar shog ces pa 'di snubs kyi rigs dbon nyi zla phun tshogs grags pas bskul ba la brten/ rang la de lta bu'i yon tan ma mchis kyang*/ bzhed pa dang mthun par/ dbu ru ka tshal gyi lha khang du 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyis bris so/ ༈ byes mchod kyi bskul ba'i bstod pa/ ༈ lha rigs rin chen mchog la legs 'khrungs shing*// mtshan rab phun sum tshogs pas rab tu brgyan// rnam grol chos kyi dga' ston stsol mkhas pa// mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ sku gsum rin chen mchog gi nam mkha' la// don gnyis phun tshogs mthar phyin 'od stong can/ dpal ldan 08388863(chad)00000000 gsol ba 'debs so byin rlobs dngos grub stsol// ces pa 'di bsam mched rin chen mtsho la rgyun gyi gsol 'debs pa gdams pa'o/ spo bo sngags chung gis bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ ༈ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse sprul pa'i sku// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i sems can ma lus pa// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul ba'i 'dren pa mchog

/'brel tshad don ldan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa 'di gsang ba rig pa'i sngags 'chang nā tha maṃ ga la'i rgyun gyi nyams len du bris pa'o/ ༈ mkhar mo bas bskul ba'i ja mchod/ tshogs gnyis ye shes dpal las rab 'khrungs shing*// lung rtogs tsha zer 'od kyi dra ba yis// yang dag bde chen snying po'i lam snang ba// rje btsun mnyam med bla ma rnams la 'dud// rkang gnyis gtso bo rdzogs sangs dam pa'i chos// byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun srung ma'i tshogs// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams ma lus la// zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun// las nyon shes bya'i sgrib sbyangs tshogs rdzogs te// myur du rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i sku 'grub nas// 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed gyur cig /ces pa 'di mkhar mo ba nang pa mgon bkra shis pas bskul ba'i ngor 'bri gung bya bral bas spro lung lcags khrod du sbyar ba'o/ ༈ sgrub chen bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang brgyud/ lha tshogs la mchod pa 'bul ba bzhugs so/ ༈ kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru kaḥ /rdo rje chos dang las kyi dbang mo che// pad+ma 'byung gnas khri srong lde'u btsan la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mnga' bdag yab sras 'gro mgon gnyos zhig dang*// mtshan ldan grub thob gnyos ston grags pa'i zhabs// gnyos ston btsun pa grags pa 'od zer la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grags pa rgyal mtshan tshul khrims 'byung gnas dang*// shes rab rgyal po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs// mkha' klong yangs pa skal ldan rgya mtsho la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ kun dga' dpal bzang bdud 'dul rdo rje dang*// rje btsun chen po rat+na'i mtshan can zhabs// sgrub chen bka' brgyad bka' lung man ngag gi// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

sarba pañca a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi// bdud rtsi yon tan badz+ra he ru kaḥ /'jam dpal gshin rje pad+ma dbang chen dang*// rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs 08388863(chad)00000000 'khor dang bcas pa la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// 'dod yon zag med bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul// zhes pa bdud rtsi sman mchod dang*/ yang ja mchod dang chang mchod pa sogs byed par 'dod na/ rnam dag bdud rtsi'i zhes rkang pa gnyis dang*/ pañca a mṛ'i sngags bzhag la/ sha lo ka de'i rjes su sbyar la 'don pa bsgyur ro/ zhes bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang brgyud dang*/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la mchod 'bum gyi tshigs su bcad pa chad pa gsang sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa kun dga' lhun grub kyi lan mang du bskul ba la brten/ 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyi ma thun bde skyid smin pa thang gi sgar du bris pa'o/ ༈ /'dan ma bsod dpal gyi bskul ba'i gsol 'debs/ lha klu 'jig rten gsum gyi mchod pa'i gnas// srid sgrub la sogs 'gran pa'i zla kun bral// rtag chad lta ba'i dri ma kun sel ba// 'phags mchog dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// dkon mchog rin chen ma lus 'dus pa'i sku// dge legs dpal yon mtha' dag 'byung ba'i gsung*// shes dang shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mkhyen pa'i thugs// rgyal ba 'bri gung pa la gsol ba 'debs// skye 'gro kun dga'i bla med 'bras stsol zhing*// theg mchog rin chen dam chos zab mo'i gter// sa gsum chos kyi rgyal mtshan mngon bsgreng ba// dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mtshan dpe rin chen bye ba'i dpal 'bar zhing*// srid zhi'i phun tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pad la/ bla med byang chub bar du gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa'i 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang*/ skyob pa yab sras dang bcas par gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sho lo ka bzhi pa 'di/

dam pa 'di rnams la mchog tu 'dzin pa'i spong ba pa/ 'dan ma bsod nams dpal gyi bskul ba las/ 'bri gung pa rat+nas spros lung gzhis dkar bris pa'o/ ༈ rgya ston dge slong la gnang ba'i gsol 'debs/ ༈ na mo rat+na gu ru/ thub bstan nam mkha'i khyon yangs dkyil 'khor du// lung rtogs legs pa'i 'od stong mngon 'phro ba// chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa nyin mo'i mgon// dpal ldan bzang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mgon po khyed la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// zhing 'di'i gdul byar gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams// rnam 'dren thugs rjes yal bar mi 'dor phyir// slar yang sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan du gsol// rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du paṇ+ṭi ta// bi bhu ti pa'i mtshan du gyur pa'i tshe// bdag sogs rnams kyang thugs brtses nyer bzung ste// ma 'ongs mngon dga'i zhing du skye ba shog maṅga laṃ/ 'dir brtag pa byas pa la/ dad ldan gdul bya rnams kyis gsol ba drag tu thebs na/ 'di phyogs su sku skye cig 'byon par 'dug cing*/ gsol ba ma thebs na/ rgya gar paṇ+ṭi ta bi bhu ti zhes pa'i mtshan 'dzin par skye ba bzhes/ der rjes mngon dga'i zhing du 'byon pa zhig shar byung bas yid la nges par mdzod// ces pa 'di nang so rgya ston chos rje zhing rjes pa'i dus su/ dge slong blo gros la'o/ lan gcig zhus so/ maṅgalaṃ/// /

༄༅/ bstod pa'i bskor la sangs rgyas kyi skye rabs brgya rtsa mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi go rim dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so/ ༈ /na mo bud+dha ya/ thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das// sngon dus bram zer 'khrungs pa na// stag mo bu bcas nyam thag la// rang gi sha khrag gis tshim mdzad/ 1 shi pa'i rgyal por 'khrungs pa'i tshe// brgya byin bram zer sprul pa yis// rab yangs spyan gnyis slong ba la/ ut+pa la 'dra'i spyan dag byin/ 2 /ko sa'i mi bdag gyur pa'i tshe// sngon dus rab tu byung gang la// zan dron ma byin 'bras thob pa// sbyin pa'i sngags pa brjod par mdzad/ 3 /tshong dpon sbyin par 'khrungs pa'i tshe// bdud kyi dmyal ba'i gnas sprul zhing*// log par lung bstan bar bcad kyang*// snying stobs chen pos bsod nams bsags/ 4 /tshong dpon zil gyis mi gnon par// gyur tshe sbyin gtong chen po yis/ 'byor pa zad mthong ma zhum pas// lha yi dbang pos gus par mchod/ 5 ri bong 'khrungs tshe sram dang ni// spre'u lce spyang grogs bcas kyis/ rang rang 'byor pas bram ze mchod// nyid kyi sku lus stsal bar mdzad/ 08388863(chad)00000000 rgyal po byams pa'i stobs gyur tshe// gdug pa'i sems ldan gnod sbyin lngar// snying brtses bskul bas rang lus kyi// sha dang khrag gis tshim par mdzad// thams cad grol zhes sbyin la dpas// glang chen byin nyes yab kyi spangs// nags khrod gnas bcas shing rta dang*// sras dang btsun mo'ang sbyin par mdzad// mchod sbyin byed ces sa skyong cher// gyur tshe thabs mkhas phul phyin pas// nyes spyod khyim gyi skrag mdzad cing*// legs par spyod la sbyin pas skyangs/ 10 /sbyin pa'i le'u ste bcu tshan dang po'o// lha yi dbang por gyur pa na// mkha' lding tshang la snying brtse bas// g.yul bshams pa las shing rta bsgyur/ lha min ma lus pham par gyur/ 11

/dpyod ldan bram zer 'khrungs pa na// 'dod chen brtags phyir slob dpon gyis// log par bstan kyang ma g.yos pas// slad nas mchod cing bsngags pa brjod/ 12 /shing pa'i rgyal por gyur pa na// myos byed ma la sngags pa'i yid// nongs par gyur pa khrel ldan gyis// bgo ba brtan pa nyid du mdzad/ 13 /gru yi kha lo rab bsgyur ba'i// legs par pha rol phyin zhes pas// 'thor rlung gis bskyed gru chen ni// bden stobs brjod pas slar la log /nya yi rgyal por gyur pa na// rigs mthun dge ba'i lam bkod cing*// tsha zer gyis gdungs bkod ma'i mtshor// bden pa'i gsung gi char rgyun phab// sreg pa'i phrug gur 'khrungs pa'i tshe// nags tshal me yis 'jigs pa las// bden pa'i gsung gis bka' bogs pas// 'bar ba'i me lce rab tu zhi// lha dbang gyur tshe bag med pa'i// dbang gyur rgyal khams bzlog bya'i phyir// tshangs dbang gzugs kyi chang gi ni// nyes pa yongs su bsgral bar mdzad// rgyal rigs 'byor ldan 'khrungs pa na// mi rtag dge bskul sbyin la spro// rab byung dben par bsam gtan mdzad// las kyi bye brag so sor bstan// nu bo drug dang sring bcas pa'i// bram zer 'khrungs tshe bsam gtan zas// sad rtsa sbed pa'i brgya byin la// 'dod pa'i nyes pa rgya cher bstan// kun nas bag yod tshong dpon gyis// tshig gi 08388863(chad)00000000 khab dang bcas pa rab byung la// dka' thub brtag phyir rgyal po yis// chung ma 'phrogs kyang bzod pas bzlog 21 /ngang pa'i rgyal po yul 'khor bsrung*// blon po bzhin bzang bcas mthong ste// pho brang nang du spyan drangs pas// phan bde'i gsung gi dge bar mdzad/ 22 /kun tu rgyu ba byang chub ces// yongs la brtse bar 'khrungs pa na// lta ngan grags pa sun phyung te// yang dag lta ba mchog la bkod/ 23 /nags tshal mchog gi bsti gnas su// spre'u dbang por gyur pa'i tshe// gcong rong lhung ba'i mi skyabs shing*// drin lan log la'ang brtse bar mdzad/

24 /lus stobs ldan pa'i sha ra bha// gshed ma rgyal pos brdeg brtson kyang*// g.yang sa che las rab bton cing*// bde bar lam yang bstan par mdzad/ 25 /gser mdog ldan pa'i ru rur 'khrungs// mgon med chus khyer skam sar ston// byas pa mi bzo'i rnam smin mthong*// mi bdag 'khor bcas lam la bkod/ 26 /spra yi dbang por gyur pa na// shing tog la sred rgyal po yis// rab tu gtsos kyang ma pham pas// mi dbang po mgu ba skyes/ 27 /bzod par smra zhes bram zer gyur// phrag dog gis dkrugs mi dbang gis// mtshon cha bsnun la khro spangs kyang*// las kyi 'bras bu dngos su mthong*/ 28 /tshangs rigs bdag por 'khrungs pa na// bshes gnyen log pa'i dbang gyur pa// rgyal 'bangs bcas la rab brtse ba'i// yang dag lam bzang mchog la bkod/ 29 /glang chen dam par gyur pa'i tshe// sdug bsngal gyur pa'i skye bo la// byams pa'i gsung gi lam bstan zhing*// sha dang khrag gis tshim par mdzad/ 30 /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u bcu tshan gsum pa'o// rgyal bu zla bar 'khrungs pa'i tshe// brtson 'grus chen pos bden smra ba'i// brtul zhugs mchog la rab gnas shing*// rkang khra'i gdug sems zhi bar mdzad/ 31 /rab gtses lcags kyi khang pa ni// bskyed bsrings rgyal por gyur pa na// longs spyod rtse gar sgyu ma ltar// gzigs te nags khrod dka' thub gnas/ 32 /stobs ldan khyu mchog dbang por ni// bltams tshe ma rungs spre'u yis// bklags skabs tshol kyang bzod mdzad pas// nags kyi gnod byin dag gis bstod/ 33 /'dab bzang shing rta mor 'khrungs tshe// rus gzeb gre bar zug pa yi// seng ge'i zug ngu bsal bsal ba la// drin mi bzo yang bzod par mdzad/ 34 /gdong lnga'i dbang por gyur pa na// tshul ltar bcos pa'i rngon pa yis// dug mdas bsnun kyang khro med cing*// rang gi lpags pa yongs su btang*/

35 /brtson 'grus cher ldan ded dpon du// gyur tshe rgya mtshor gru zhig pas// rang gi 'tsho ba yongs phral te// tshong pa lnga brgya'i srog kyang bton/ 36 /gser mdog rgyal por 'khrungs pa na// 'dzam gling longs spyod kyis bskyangs shing*// rang rgyal bsod snyoms phul ba'i 'bras// zas nor longs spyod char du phabs/ 37 /gcan gzan kun dga' gser mdog tu// skye ba bzhes tshe rngon pa yi// srog skyabs phyir du nyid kyi ni// pags pa mchog kyang stsol bar mdzad/ 38 /gdol pa stobs chen rigs 'khrungs tshe// rgyal srid mchog la mnga' mdzad cing*// log par spyod pa tshar bcad de/ sbyin dang dge ba'i khrims kyis 'tsho/ 39 /sangs rgyas don yod gshegs pa'i drung*// dge slong grags pa'i 'od gyur tshe// mchod pa chen po mthar dbyung phyir/ rang lus mar me'i 'od kyis mchod/ 40 /brtson 'grus kyi le'u ste bcu tshan bzhi pa'o// dben pa 'dod ces khyim bdag tu// gyur tshe mkha' las lung bstan thos// sangs rgyas 'od zer dpag med drung*// skye ba med pa'i don rab thob/ 41 /sa skyong sgrol ma snang byed ces// rgyal srid spangs nas dka' thub brten// ded dpon zla ba 'khor bcas la// phyag gi sgron mes 'dam rab bstan/ 42 /ri bong mchog tu 'khrungs pa'i tshe// bram ze la ni rab mos pas// bsnyen bkur la gzhol rang lus kyang*// ltos med bsregs par rab tu zhugs/ 43 /rgyal po kun tu dge byed ni// btsun mo brgyad khri'i tshogs bcas la// dge ba'i las kyi lam bstan pas// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mchog la bkod/ 44 /khye'u mchog zung gyur pa na// dben par bsam gtan gnas pa la// rgyal po mos dang the tshom gyi// dra ba bsal zhing las 'bras mthong*/ 45 /sa bdag brtan pa byin zhes pa// lnga brgya'i sras bcas rgyal ba mchod// khab nas byung ste rab tu byung*// kun kyang bsam gtan mthu rab brnyes/

46 /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs byin gyi// mchod rten kun gyis rab mchod kyang*// dge slong bde ba sbyin pa'i phyag /mar me sbar bas zil gyis mnan/ 47 /dge slong snyan pa'i 'od gyur tshe// 'gro kun ting 'dzin la bkod cing*// phrag dog dbang gyur dge sbyong gi /mtshon cha me tog sprin du 'khrigs/ 48 /rgyal po lkugs 'phyer bstan pa na// mi rtag skyong bas khab nas byung*// rang byung nyid kyi dben par gnas// byang chub zhi bde'i bsam gtan brnyes/ 49 /rgyal po 'jig rten sna tshogs la// mngon par dga' bar gyur pa na// 'khor 'bangs zang zing bcas spangs te// nags su gshegs nas yon tan brnyes/ 50 /bsam gtan gyi le'u ste bcu tshan lnga pa'o// rgyal po tshangs byin du gyur tshe// skye dgu sbyin pas yongs bskyangs shing*// brgya byin gnod sbyin sprul pa'ang*// bu dang chung ma sbyin la gzhol/ 51 /gzhon nu chos tshol gyur pa na// 'dod chen pa la nor sbyin zhing*// chos ldan gtam phyir g.yang mchongs kyang*// gnod 'tshe med pas slar yang dad/ 52 /bu mo ye shes ldan gyur tshe// lha yi lung bstan ji bzhin du// rang gi sha yi g.yos sbyar te// dge slong du ma'i nad kun bsal/ 53 /ded dpon khye'u chu 'bebs kyis// mgon med nya yi tshogs bskyabs te// bza' ltung sbyin zhing rgyal ba'i mtshan// sna bar bsgrags pas lha gnas bkod/ 54 /shes rab che mnga' me long gdong*// nyes bral bram ze rab bskyangs zhing*// las kyi 'bras bu yongs bstan de// snyan pa'i grags pas 'jig rten khyab/ 55 /bram ze chen po gnag lhas skyes// rgyal srid bstan phyir sa chen 'bangs// dum drug dbyes te tshangs pa grub/ rang byung zhi ba mchog la gzhol/ 56 /rgyal po zhi ba'i blo gros ky-i/ mi zad spobs pa mchog gi mthus// lta ba ngan pa phan mdzad cing*// rkang gnyis gtso yi don rab bstan/ 57 /klu yi rgyal po lnga dang ni// gcung po nye lnga dong ba la// rnga sgras khros pa'i tshig smras kyang*// gdugs pa'i sems kyi yongs ma gos/

58 /mu stegs dbang por 'khrungs pa na// rigs mthun sdig pa'i g.yo can gyis// 'khor la nye bar 'tshe ba yang*// shes rab mthu yi gzhan du byer/ 59 /ston pa shes rab sna tshogs kyi// chog shes ting 'dzin la rmongs pa'i// dmyal bar lhung gyur sems can rnams// thugs rje'i 'od kyis bsil bar mdzad/ 60 /shes rab kyi le'u bcu tshan drug pa'o// ded dpon snying rje cher gyur tshe// rgya mtsho lha yi lung bstan bzhin// rang bde yal bar dor nas ni// thabs kyi 'gro ba sgrol bar mdzad/ 61 /gzhon nu snying rje cher sems kyis/ gzhan don rang gi byang chub dor// rgyal po dge ba bkod pa ni// sras bcas byang chub mchog la bkod/ 62 /bram ze khye'u skar ma yis// gzhan don brtse bas rjes gzung phyir// rang gi brtul zhugs yongs btang zhing*// slar yang khyim spangs rab byung brnyes/ 63 /mig stong ldan par snang ba na// rab khro gnod sbyin gzugs can gyis// ma rungs skye bo bsgral tshul bstan// kun kyang nyes par spyod las log 64 /drang srong ston pa lkugs phye yis// lhag pa'i yo byad bcangs pa'i nyes// 'khor la thabs kyis bstan gyur te/ bla med byang chub la reg mdzad/ 65 /gar mkhan slob dpon 'gro ba'i gtso// sras mo 'gro ba'i dpal gyis ni// theg gsum zab yang chos kyis glus// 'gro ba'i rna dbang mchog la sbyar/ 66 /spyir skyes rgyal chen nga la nus// gling bzhi lha gnas dbang bsgyur zhing*// bsod nams bsod nams ma yin pa'i// las kyi 'bras bu so sor bstan/ 67 /'dzam bu gling mchog bha dra'i shing*// rab tu skye bar klu'i dbang po// gter bton 'khrungs tshe 'gro mang la// gter gyi sbyin pas rab tu bskyangs/ 68 /yan lag ma smad seng ge la// spre'u phrug bskyabs gsol ma rungs pa'i// 'dab chags spu gris khyer ba la// rang lus gtong zhugs sems dpa' che/ 69 /bram ze'i khye'u sprin gyi ni// de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i phyir// ut+pal lnga bzhed bram ze mo'i// gdung ba rab gsal thabs kyi mchog

70 /thabs kyi le'u ste bcu tshan bdun pa'o// 'od ldan rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe// glang po 'dod pas myos pa las// brtsam ste sems gdul smon lam bcas// bstan pa med pa'i mchod 08388863(chad)00000000 zhes bya yis// mchod pa'i phyir du sbyin pa gyis// smon lam dag pas gter thon zhing*// rgyal po rgyal ba'i ngo mtshar bstan/ 73 /lha dbang brgya byin mig bzang gis// srog chags des par mngon sprul te// mkha' las lung bstan sha khrag gis// mi bzad nad las yongs su bsgral/ 74 /glang chen dbang por gyur pa na// sdig ldan rgyal pos bskul ba yis// rngon par gnad du mda' bsnun kyang*// ngur smrig la dmigs mche ba bstsal/ 75 /yongs su rung ba 'char ka zhes// byang chub sems dpar 'khrungs pa'i tshes// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal cher gzigs te// kun kyang byang chub mchog la bkod/ 76 /'khor los bsgyur ba nor can gyis// yongs su gtong ba cher mdzad cing*// de bzhin gshegs mchod rang lus bor// sha dang khrag gi nyam thag bskyangs/ 77 /bram ze'i khye'u zla dga' yis// sbyin pa rgya chen yongs btang zhing*// rgyal ba 'khor bcas zhag bdun du// bsnyen bskur mya ngan 'da' lung bstan/ 78 /'khor los bsgyur ba nam mkha' yis// nor dang rgyal srid rang lus kyis// dbang po yan lag bcas sbyin te// byang chub dam par smon lam btab/ 79 /stobs chen rgyal po dpal gyi sdes// longs spyod 'byor pa du ma dang*// rang gi lus kyang btang nas slar// 'gyod med bden pas gzugs bzang grub/ 80 /smon lam gyi le'u ste bcu tshan brgyad pa'o// rgyal bu snying stobs chen po yis// stag mo'i phrug gu bkren lhan tshogs// rang lus sha khrag sbyin mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub chen por bsngos/ 81 /rgyal po zla 'od zhes bya bar// gyur tshe sbyin gtong cher mdzad cing*// bram ze drag po'i mig ces pas// dbu bslangs pa la re ba bskangs/

82 /shi pa'i rgyal pos 'phongs pa yis// nongs pa kun gsal rang gi khrag /zla drug nang pa'i tshogs la bstsal/ 83 /drin mi bzo la las 'bras mthong*/ bram ze'i rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis// lnga brgya'i 'khor bcas rab byung ste// mi rtag bdag med nga ro yis// bsam gtan tshad med don rab mthong*/ 84 /sangs rgyas mi 'jigs sgra dbyangs kyis// rgyal po mchog gi bstan pa la// rtag tu brnyas zhes gyur pa na// gshe yang mi khro dam chos ston/ 85 /seng ge dbang po glang chen bcas// rang gi 'tshe ba yongs btang nas// dug can ltos 'gro srog phral te// mgon med tshong 'gron bde bar btong*/ 86 /ded dpon slong ldan gyur pa'i tshe// sbyin la spro bas rgya mtshor zhugs// klu yi nor bu 08388863(chad)00000000 la// lha yi lung bstan gnod med par// yab yum phyir du rang lus dor// lha dbang mgu zhing nyams med sems// bsod nams cher ldan bsod nams stobs// zang zing mi 'jigs chos byams pas// 'khor 'bangs bde bar rab mdzad cing*// 'dzam bu gling la mnga' yang bsgyur// stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i le'u ste bcu tshan dgu pa'o// drang srong 'od bzang chen po ni// ye shes tshol la rab zhugs par// ston pa kun rig mchog gi gsung*// lte bar bzung bas rin chen brnyes/ 91 /phyi ma'i mtha' bsgrub la mkhas zhes// drang srong chen por 'khrungs pa na// zab cing rgya che'i chos kyi char// 'gro ba kun la snyoms par phob/ 92 /rgyal po tog gi blo gros ni// yang dag ye shes snang ba ches// 'jig rten kun tu chos 'gro bas// bstan la mos pa kun gyis bkur/ 93 /drang srong snang ba mngon shes kyi// lo grangs nyi ma zhag bdun bar// n+ya gro dha yi 'dab grangs pa// sngo sangs chen pos skad cig rtogs/ 94 /bram ze chen po nyes 'phreng gdong*// zhes byar skye ba yongs bzung tshe// lan tshwa'i ri la sman bstan zhing*// 'tshams pa'i chos kyi nye spangs brtson/

95 /dka' thub mchog grub rnga bong gi /lha klu drang srong gza' rgyu skar// mdun du bkod de so so'i 'bras// ji ltar bshad pa kun gyi rtogs/ 96 /rgyal po chen po mu khyud ldan// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro skyabs shing*// ngo mtshar lha yi spyan drangs te// slar yang 'dzam gling bde bar mdzad/ 97 /sa yi bdag po ut+pal gdong*// rgyal po 'od zhi spos snang la// mchod cing rab byung bar gcod pa'i// shor ba gzhon nu 'khor bcas btul/ 98 /byang chub sems dpa' dpa' ba'i stobs// ting 'dzin mchog gis khyi ro yi// rgyan sprul slu byed bdud kyi sde// shugs 'chang 'khor bcas gdul bar mdzad/ 99 /sangs rgyas 'od mtha' yas pa'i drung*// sems dpa' gzi brjid drag pa yis// zhing khams kun tu kun snang zhing*// 'od kyis khyab pa'i cho 'phrul bstan/ 100 /stobs kyi le'u ste bcu tshan tha ma'o// dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang*// lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang*// bzo dang rol rtsed mngon par 'byung*// dka' ba spyad dang shing drung gshegs// bdud btul ba dang mngon byang chub// chos 'khor bskor zhing mya ngan 'das// pha rol phyin bcu mthar son pa'i// mi yi seng ge skyes chen ni// dam pa tog dkar tshul bzung nas// dga' ldan gnas nas dam chos ston/ 1 /rgyal tshab ma pham mgon bzhag cing*// gzigs pa rnam bzhis yongs gzigs te// glang chen tshul gyi zas gtsang khab// lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums su zhugs/ 2 /bltams pa'i dus la bab pa na// lim+bi'i tshal chen dam par ni// yum la gnod med btsas gyur cing*// lha mir bcas pas mchod cing bsngags/ 3 /rim gyis bskyed cher gyur pa na// yi ge ral gri phongs gyang sogs// sgyu rtsal bye brag du ma dang*// bsam gtan la ni mnyam bzhag brten/ 4 /kha na ma tho'i dri spangs phyir// btsun mo'i 'khor la dgyes rol cing*// rgyal srid skyong ba'i tshul bstan te// kun kyang byang chub la nges mdzad/

5 /rol mo'i sgra dang pho brang phyogs// mi rtag tshul gzigs khab nas byung*// mchod rten rang byung rnam dag dang*// rang byung nyid kyi rab tu byung*/ 6 /'dod pa'i yon tan du ma yis/ g.yeng bar gyur nas bsam gtan gyi// bar du gcod pa yongs gzigs nas// lo drug dka' ba spyod tshul bstan/ 7 /chog shes med dang dka' thub kyis// gdung ba'i mtha' gnyis rab bsal phyir// zhal zas rags pas sku brtas shing*// byang chub shing drung mnyam par gzhag 8 /bdud kyi sde chen dpa' bkong phyir// sna tshogs 'od zer rab bkye nas// zhi dang khro bo'i snang brnyan gyis// nag po'i tshogs rnams rab tu pham/ 9 /nam gyi mtho rangs bab pa na// de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul gyi// ting 'dzin mchog gi mngon gyur te// byang chub yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ 10 /'dus pa'i nyan thos dgra bcom dang*// byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs bcas la// bden bzhi mtshan med nges pa'i don// gsang ba sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor/ 11 /mi rtag rtag par rab 'dzin pa'i// blo gros rmongs pa'i skye bo rnams// byang chub mchog tu bskul ba'i phyir// mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul rab bstan/ 12 /zhes mnyam med shākya'i dbang po'i skyes pa'i rabs brgya rtsa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi go rim dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcas pa 'di nyid/ lcang gcig pa dpon mgon bkra shis pas bris sku bzhengs pa'i dus su dgos zhes bskul ba la/ 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyis spro lung dbang ldan pho brang du bkod pa'o// gcig zhus/ maṅgalaṃ/// /

༄༅/ 'bri gung du gdung rin po che la na bza' phul ba'i tshigs bcad bzhugs so/ ༈ oṃ swa sti/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad dang*// rgyud sde bzhi dang rim dgu'i dkyil 'khor lha// thar lam mchog gyur bka' lung rgyud man ngag /mdo sde mi zad rgya mtsho mchog gi gter// zhing rab legs pa'i mchog stsol zla bral ba// skar tshogs dbus na rgyu skar bdag po ltar// 'dren pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan dam pa'i drung*// 'bangs kyi tha chung rat+na lak+ṣa mis// mar gad mdog mtshungs tsha zer gzi 'phrog pa'i// srab 'jam yang mdzes lha rdzas dang mtshungs 'di// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin tshogs mchod sprin 'bul// 'dis mtshon bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba rnams// 'gro kun bsags sbyangs sa lam mthar phyin nas// rgyal ba nyid ltar srid gsum ma stongs par// 'phrin las 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad gyur cig /shu bh+ma mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ ༈ bsam yas bar khang gi dus gsum sangs rgyas la snyan dar dar chen yug gcig gi kha yig phyogs bcu dus bzhi bla ma yi dam lha// sangs rgyas chos dang byang sems dge 'dun tshogs// rgyal ba'i bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho la// 'phrin las bzhi 'grub sku lnga yongs rdzogs phyir// rin chen margad mdog mtshungs chu zheng can// dri med lha rdzas cod pan 'di phul bas// sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du gnas pa dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams ni zhabs brtan cing*// chos 'khor gnyan rnams yun du mi nyams shing*// 'gro kun bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs te// rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ ༈ sprul sku rin po che zhwa dmar 'dzam gling rnam rgyal grags pa gshegs dus lha sar snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig na mo bud+dha ya/ rkang gnyis gtso bo rnam mkhyen dam pa'i tog /rgyal ba shākya saiṅga gnyis pa'i drung*// rab mdzes bsil zer mdangs phrog snyan shal 'di// phul ba'i dge bas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku// thugs kyi dgongs pa dbyings su rdzogs pa dang*// zhing 'dir gdul bya'i tshogs la nyer dgongs te// slar yang sprul sku'i snang ba mi dman par// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i dpal du snang ba la// gegs kyi bar du gcod pa nyer zhi zhing*// sku tshe mdzad 'phrin mchog tu rgyas gyur te// bdag gzhan 'gro kun rnam mkhyen go 'phang mchog

/myur du thob pa'i bka' drin bstsal du gsol// bkra shis kha thag 'doms bskor ma zhig la'o/ ༈ chos bdag bkra shis 'od 'bar la snyan dar kha yig sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes shing*// mthu rtsal chen po'i 'phrin las rmad byung ba// chos bdag chen po bkra shis 'od 'bar la// snyan shal 'di phul bstan dang bstan 'dzin rje// yon mchod 'bangs bcas phyi nang 'tshe bas dben// tshe srings dpal skyed 'byor pa mtha' dag spel// log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs dpung bcas// skad cig nyid du rdul du rlog pa dang*// dad ldan sgrub po rnams ni bu bzhin skyongs// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di ni snye mo smon mkhar du chos bdag chen po bkra shis 'od 'bar la'o/ ༈ /bsam yas lcog tu mda' dar zhig gi kha yig la/ sngon dus rig 'dzin pad ma'i drung du// chos rgyal yab sras gter bsrungs bcas pa// lhan cig tshogs pa'i smon lam mthu las// da lta'i dus 'dir pha nor bus len// de la phyi dang nang gi bar chad/ mi mthun zhi phyir 08388863(chad)00000000 bsam yas bu tshal kun gzigs pho brang du chos skyong chen po la mdung dmar ru dar zhig la kha yig brtan bzhugs/ ༈ dpal ldan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal// chos dbyings ngang las sgyur mar sku sprul pa// sangs rgyas bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba po// gnod sbyin drag po rtsi dmar bran khol bcas// sngon gyi rgyal ba'i bka' dang dam bzhin du// lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi// bstan dang bod kyi sems can ma lus pa'i// nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur chos rgyal rgyud par bcas// phyi nang gsang ba'i bdud dang log 'dren bsrungs// tshe dpal longs spyod 'byor pa rab rgyas shing*// mos pa rnam bzhis srid gsum dbang du bsdus// bstan la 'tshe dang rgyal rgyud dmangs su 'bebs// 'gras zhugs 'khon 'tshol log 'dren ru tra'i sde// lo zla zhag dang za mar ma bzhag sgrol// zab yangs chos 'khor byang phyogs sham bha la'i// phun tshogs bkod pa dang bcas dus kun gzigs// lha yi pho brang gnas 'dir chos skyong che// sku gsung thugs mtshon mdung zhags ru dar gyi// rten 'dir bzhugs la deng nas ji srid bar// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa yi// gang bcol 'phrin las yid bzhin ma lus pa// bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i tshul bzhin sgrubs// sa ma ya dam las ma 'da'// dam tshig ma za/

i dan te na rak+kan/ bsam yas byang chub chen po'i snyan dar la/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo'i tshogs kyis mchod pa ltar// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// gus pa'i yid kyi 'bri gung rat+nas phul// dge bas 'gro kun tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang zhing*// sa bcu lam bgrod bdag don mthar phyin nas/ khams gsum sems can srid pa ma stongs bar// mi zad 'khor los bsgrol ba'i gnyen gyur cig ༈ bsam yas su chos skyong gi sku chas zhal mig la/ ༈ sngon tshe kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan snga sogs// tshe rabs du mar las smon gyis sbrel ba'i// gnod sbyin drag po stobs ldan rdzul 'phrul can// sprul 'khor nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa yi// rnal 'byor bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas la// ji bzhin 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang*// yun gyi pho nyar gtan du grogs mdzod cig /rmog la/ sprin dkar dum bu phung por dpungs pa bzhin// thabs shes byang bur bsdebs pa'i rmog bzang pos// slad nas gangs kyi ri las rngam pa la// sna tshogs phod kyi brgyan pa khyod la 'bul// bdag cag yon mchod mi nor 'khor bcas kyi// ston pa'i chab srid srid mtha'i bar dag tu// kun gyi gtsug rgyan rab tu gsal bar ni// ring lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsor sgrubs shig khrab la/ gnam lcags babs kyang 'bigs par mi bzod cing*// pha rol rigs sngags mtshon dbal nyams par byed// rdo rje'i lus kun mi shigs bsrung ba yi// dngul chu'i mdog 'tsher bsra ba'i go 'di 'bul// bdag cag bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'khor bcas la// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bgegs bsrung zhing*// log 'dren dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar gcod pa'i// 'phrin las ma lus myur du grub par mdzod/ ༈ chos skyong gnod sbyin chen po'i bstod pa bzhugs so/ ༈ hūm̐ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// las smon mthu las grub pa'i dam tshig can// chos skyong gnod sbyin chen po zhes grags pa'i// bka' sdod stobs ldan khyod la bdag bstod do// rab 'jigs bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i sku// khro gnyer bzhin bsdus am gtsigs sdang mig bsgrad// mdung dmar zhags pas ru tra 'ching zhing sgrol// dam nyams gshan pa khyod la bdag bstod do// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i rjes 'bangs spyan snga ru// ji ltar zhal bzhes thugs dam mi g.yel bzhin// dpal gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur bar khang du/

smon lam gcig bsdus lha sras 'dus pa'i tshe// bka' yi thugs dam gnyan po ji bzhin du// rig 'dzin bdag dang rgyud par bcas pa yi// dam chos sgrub la bu bzhin skyong ba dang*// gtan gyi dgra lhar chos skyong khyod bsten na// sangs rgyas bstan srungs bstan dang bstan 'dzin spel// bar chad bgegs thul sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol// chos 'khor gnyan skyong mtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod// ces bstod pa 'di ni chos skyong gnod sbyin chen po phebs pa'i thog mar mjal dus/ bsam yas dbu rtse'i bar khang g.yu zhal du/ 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyi sbyar ba'o// lan gcig zhus/ maṅgalaṃ/ ༄༅/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed bdag zhal gzigs su bstod pa bzhugs so/ ༈ ai/ thabs mchog bde chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// ye shes zhi ba'i dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// rab 'jig khro rgyal phyag rgya zil gnon sku// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum gar// dpal gyi chas brgyan mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'phen/ khros pa'i bzhin can me dpung 'bar ba'i klong*// ma he pad+ma chu glang nyi zla'i steng*/ gshin rje dregs byed pho mo'i gdan la 'gying*// shes rab mkha' dbyings stong pa'i dbyings rum du// gnyis med sbyor yum ma mo khrag mig ma// dmar nag gcer bu brkyang bskum khro mo'i tshul// lcags kyus 'gugs shing don snying khrag la rol// bde stong gnyis med rol pa'i mkha' klong las// thugs rje'i dbyings sprul ya ma rā tsa ni// khrag rul mdog mtshungs gshan gris dgra bgegs sgrol// khros pa'i zhabs brdabs dgra snying dmar la rol// yab yum sras bcas sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs la// 'du 'bral med pa'i don gyi phyag 'tshal zhing*// rang rtsal ye shes mchog gis mchod par bgyi/ thugs kyi dam skong mchog thun dngos grub stsol// 'khor ba'i mun rum gnas pa'i bdag 'dra yis// 'phags pa'i thugs rje'i cha yi zer mthong nas// gus pas bstod 'dis byang chub mchog thob ste// rang don mthar phyin gzhan don lhun 'grub mdzod// ces pa 'di 'bri gung spro lung gzhis kar 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag gi srung bzlog zhig bgyis pa'i dus/

glang lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer brgyad kyi nyi ma rtse shar la/ 'jam dpal yab yum sras gsum gyi sku'i snang ba mthong ba las/ 'bri gung pa mkha' grol klong yangs kyis bris pa'o/ ༈ 'jam dpal king kang zhal gzigs dus bstod pa/ ༈ ai bskal pa me rlung 'khrug pa'i dkyil 'khor na// rnal 'byor bdag gi bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha// lha mchog ya mān+ta ka mthu bo che// 'jigs byed king kang nag po sku kha yengs mig yengs dang ku re kyal ka dang mi bsre/ 'don zlos kyi bar du'ang*/ chags sdang dang zur za spangs pa'i chos spyod kyi 'bel gtam tsam ma gtogs/ tha mal gyi logs gtam skad shugs che chung gang yang mi bya/ bza' btung gi bye brag kyang*/ spyod lam mdzes pas tshod yod du longs spyad/ mdo bsngo ba tshar nas zhal bsil brims la mal nas bzhengs te/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ 'du khang la bskor ba dang bcas/ khams gseng zhing rnam g.yeng phran bu'i kha don byung na/ chos khrims par zhus la phyi rol du brel ba bcad/ slar bsam gtan khar bur 'dus la/ snga dro'i bar kha ton dang chos spyod bslab sbyang gi rim pa bya/ gung gi gdan len byung nas/ chos spyod kyi rim pa ji ltar rigs pa dang sbyar/ gdan grol nas/ bsam gtan khang bur 'dus pa'i bar sngar bzhin bca' legs pas/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi dge sbyor la 'bad/ dgong gi 'khar rnga byung nas phyag chen gyi sngon 'gro nas gzhag thabs bar bskyang zhing*/ nyi grib ri sked slebs pa'i dus/ phyi nang gi gtor ma dang*/ bsrung bzlog gi rnal 'byor bya/ srod thun gyi brda byung nas/ gcod yul gyi gdams pa dang*/ ku sā li'i tshogs bsogs bya zhing*/ chos skyong gi bskyed rim bzlas brjod bya/ gung la 'od gsal dang rmi lam gyi gdams pa nyams su blang*/ tho rangs kyi thun brda byung nas/ ā li ka li'i sgras bskul bar mos la/ skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshe sgrub rtsa rlung gi nyams len/ lus sbyong gzhan yang bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa 'chag med kun bya/ dus kun tu sgar dang gling khrod du/ skad chen pos 'bod pa/ glo dang glal sbrid sogs bag med kyis byung rgyal mi btang bar kun kyang bag dang ldan pas klag cor chung bar bya/ lan gcig zhus so/ maṅgashaṃ/// /

༄༅/ rwa bsgreng 'od 'jo gdan sa shes rab nyi ma la gdams pa'i rdor dkar gyi phan yon/ dus gsum bde gshegs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying gyur pa'i// lus can 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyi// sgo gsum spyod lam phal cher nyes skyon mang*// gtso bor bgrangs pas mi dge rnam bcu la// 'dod chags sgo nas srog bcad nyes can sha /rgyal ba'i bka' lung mdo dang rgyud sde las// gnod 'gyur gzigs pas 'di nyid bkag par mdzad// de yang mdo sde lang kar gshegs pa las// lus sems bskyed pa'i drin can pha ma ni// bsad de sha khrag bu yis bzar mtshungs shing*// rnam smin ngan song sdug bsngal myong bar gsungs// byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed gnas skabs su// gzhan la gnod spong phan bde bsgrub rgyu la// srog gcod gnod pa byang sems ltung ba'i rgyu// gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud 'grel las// sha lnga bdud dam tshig rdzas gsungs kyang*// rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor mi ldan par// gsang sngags dam tshig 08388863(chad)00000000 dges/ gnas skabs tshe ring nad med bde ba 'phel// bgegs dang logs 'dren 'byung po'i 'tshe ba bral// lus kyi kun spyod legs pas 'gro ba thul// ngag gi bzlas brjod gsang sngags nus pa 'phel// yid kyi dug lnga'i rtog 'joms ting 'dzin gsal// mthar thug sangs rgyas sku lnga'i ye shes 'grub// de phyir rdor dkar la gnas legs pa'i spyod// legs lam gnas pa rnams kyi brtul zhugs bzang*// dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes pa 'di dpal bka' gdams rin po che dri ma med pa'i gdan sa chen po'i bstan pa'i khur 'dzin pa/ 'od 'jo gdan sa ba shes rab nyi mas bskul ba las/ 'bri gung bya bral bas gnas chung gi sgar du bris pa'o/ lan gcig zhus so/ maṅgalaṃ/// / ༄༅/ ka kha'i tshig bcad rang gi spyod lugs/

ka ra bu ram ro la mi sred cing*/ kha ru gang byung bza' bas lus 'tsho la// ga ru yang ni gtan du 'dug blo spang*// nga yi spyod lugs yin no mched grogs kun// ca co mang pos gzhan sun mi 'byin cing*// cha lugs dkar dmar bgo ba nges med la// ja chang med tshol rtsol sgrub mi byed par// nya ltar chu yi btung bar yid spro 'o// ta ra'i grangs tsam bgrang gis mi lang ba'i// tha dad snang ba'i mar gyur 'gro ba la// da nas snying por mchis par dge tshogs kun// na med gcig tu bsngo ba nyams len yin// pa por 'dod pa'i khengs pa rabs spangs nas// pha rol yul rnams byams sam sdang na yang*// ba glang bzhin du nyal bar mi 'dor ro// ma rgan gdon gyis brlams ltar brtse ba'i sems// tsa na'i 'bru tsam gzhan skyon mi rtog par// tsha zer 'od bzhin kun snyoms bla ma la// dza lang gsar 'grogs spyod pas mi bster par// wa ltar dman cha 'dzin pa nga yi spyod// zha ma lha rje'i gdams pa mi bdog kyang*// za hor yul khams stong pa'i pad 'byung chos// 'a cag chos kyi skal ba mi pham pas// ya ki kun bzang sa la phyin par byed// ra la ro la'i 'khor 'dabs spangs nas kyang*// la ba pa ltar gcig pur 'od gsal bsgoms// sha za smyo byed gdon spyod ma yin par// sa ra ha ltar gnas lugs shugs 'gro skyong*// ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrogs pa'i 'byung po yang*// a la la zhes ngo mtshar bstod pa 'di// rje btsun mtshan ldan bla ma'i bka' drin te// mi 'bral snying gi thig ler sa ma ya// lan gcig zhus shing gtan la bab bo/ yi ge bzhi e pa bsod nams bkra shis so/ maṅgalaṃ/// /
